title: 模块_Calculator_大型强子对撞机
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/大型强子对撞机/doc创建 local p = {} -- ===================== 物理常数 ===================== local TICK_TIME = 20 local keV_PER_EU = 0.1 / 1000 local ALPHA = 1.3 local V_BASE = 524288 local CV = TICK_TIME * V_BASE * keV_PER_EU local MAX_ENERGY_keV = 2000000000 local RATE_NERF_CUTOFF = 5000 local RATE_NERF_POWER = 0.5 local MASSLESS_THRESHOLD = 0.5 local VOLTAGE_TIERS = { UV = 524288, UHV = 2097152, UEV = 8388608, UIV = 33554432, UMV = 134217728, UXV = 536870912, MAX = 2147483647, } -- ===================== 粒子数据 ===================== local PARTICLE_DATA = { ["光子 (γ)"] = { mass = 0.000, weight = 1000 }, ["电子 (e⁻)"] = { mass = 0.511, weight = 800 }, ["μ子 (μ ⁻)"] = { mass = 105.66, weight = 300 }, ["质子 (p⁺)"] = { mass = 938.27, weight = 600 }, ["Ω粒子 (Ω ⁻)"] = { mass = 1672.45, weight = 60 }, ["τ子 (τ ⁻)"] = { mass = 1776.89, weight = 100 }, ["W玻色子 (W⁻)"] = { mass = 80369.20, weight = 110 }, ["电子中微子 (ν e)"] = { mass = 0.000, weight = 250 }, ["μ子中微子 (ν μ)"] = { mass = 0.000, weight = 200 }, ["τ子中微子 (ν τ)"] = { mass = 0.000, weight = 150 }, ["η介子 (η)"] = { mass = 547.86, weight = 400 }, ["中子 (n⁰)"] = { mass = 939.57, weight = 500 }, ["λ粒子 (Λ ⁰)"] = { mass = 1115.68, weight = 80 }, ["Jψ介子 (Jψ)"] = { mass = 3096.92, weight = 50 }, ["Y粒子 (Υ)"] = { mass = 9460.30, weight = 40 }, ["Z玻色子 (Z⁰)"] = { mass = 91188, weight = 110 }, ["希格斯玻色子 (H⁰)"] = { mass = 125110, weight = 15 }, ["引力子 (G)"] = { mass = 0.000, weight = 50 }, } -- Item 模板图标映射（解决部分带符号名称的图标缺失问题） local ITEM_ICON_ALIAS = { ["μ子 (μ ⁻)"] = "μ子", ["τ子 (τ ⁻)"] = "τ子", ["Ω粒子 (Ω ⁻)"] = "Ω粒子", ["λ粒子 (Λ ⁰)"] = "λ粒子", ["Jψ介子 (Jψ)"] = "@gtnhlanth:particle:16", } local MODULES = { CMS = { label = "CMS（电磁相互作用 E）", particles = { "光子 (γ)", "电子 (e⁻)", "μ子 (μ ⁻)", "质子 (p⁺)", "Ω粒子 (Ω ⁻)", "τ子 (τ ⁻)", "W玻色子 (W⁻)" }, }, ATLAS = { label = "ATLAS（弱相互作用 W）", particles = { "电子中微子 (ν e)", "μ子中微子 (ν μ)", "τ子中微子 (ν τ)", "电子 (e⁻)", "μ子 (μ ⁻)", "η介子 (η)", "质子 (p⁺)", "中子 (n⁰)", "λ粒子 (Λ ⁰)", "Ω粒子 (Ω ⁻)", "τ子 (τ ⁻)", "Jψ介子 (Jψ)", "Y粒子 (Υ)", "W玻色子 (W⁻)", "Z玻色子 (Z⁰)", "希格斯玻色子 (H⁰)" }, }, ALICE = { label = "ALICE（强相互作用 S）", particles = { "η介子 (η)", "质子 (p⁺)", "中子 (n⁰)", "λ粒子 (Λ ⁰)", "Ω粒子 (Ω ⁻)", "Jψ介子 (Jψ)", "Y粒子 (Υ)" }, }, LHCb = { label = "LHCb（引力相互作用 G）", particles = { "引力子 (G)", "希格斯玻色子 (H⁰)" }, }, } local SOURCE_PRESETS = { ["钨杆"] = { particle = "电子 (e⁻)", e0_keV = 1000, r0 = 20, focus = 98 }, ["长六硼化镧杆"] = { particle = "电子 (e⁻)", e0_keV = 5000, r0 = 60, focus = 99 }, ["氢气"] = { particle = "质子 (p⁺)", e0_keV = 1000000, r0 = 40, focus = 99 }, ["不稳定粉"] = { particle = "Ω粒子 (Ω ⁻)", e0_keV = 1700000, r0 = 60, focus = 99 }, } -- ===================== 格式化 ===================== local function addThousands(s) local sign, str = "", tostring(s) if str:sub(1,1) == "-" then sign = "-"; str = str:sub(2) end local out = str while true do local n2, k = out:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") out = n2 if k == 0 then break end end return sign .. out end local function fmtInt(v) return addThousands(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 0) + 0.5)) end local function fmtEnergy(keV) if keV >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.2f TeV", keV / 1e9) elseif keV >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.2f GeV", keV / 1e6) elseif keV >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.2f MeV", keV / 1e3) else return string.format("%.2f keV", keV) end end local function fmtPower(eut) if eut >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.2f TEU/t", eut / 1e12) elseif eut >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.2f GEU/t", eut / 1e9) elseif eut >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.2f MEU/t", eut / 1e6) elseif eut >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.2f kEU/t", eut / 1e3) else return string.format("%.0f EU/t", eut) end end local function fmtAmps(eut, tierName) local v = VOLTAGE_TIERS[tierName] or VOLTAGE_TIERS.MAX local amps = eut / v if amps >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.2f MA %s", amps / 1e6, tierName) elseif amps >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.2f kA %s", amps / 1e3, tierName) else return string.format("%.2f A %s", amps, tierName) end end -- ===================== 加速器模拟 ===================== local function simulate_one_cycle(energy_keV, rate, cycleIndex, target_keV) local out_energy, out_rate = energy_keV, rate if out_energy <= target_keV then out_energy = out_energy + CV * (cycleIndex + 1) * (cycleIndex + 1) if out_energy > MAX_ENERGY_keV then out_energy = MAX_ENERGY_keV end else if out_rate < RATE_NERF_CUTOFF then out_rate = math.ceil(out_rate * ALPHA - 1e-9) else out_rate = out_rate + math.ceil((out_rate * (ALPHA - 1)) ^ RATE_NERF_POWER - 1e-9) end end return out_energy, out_rate end local function simulate_full(e0_keV, r0, target_keV, maxCycles) local result = {} local cur_energy, cur_rate = e0_keV, r0 for M = 1, maxCycles do cur_energy, cur_rate = simulate_one_cycle(cur_energy, cur_rate, M - 1, target_keV) if cur_energy > MAX_ENERGY_keV then cur_energy = MAX_ENERGY_keV end local pwr = V_BASE * M * M * cur_rate local eff = cur_rate / M table.insert(result, { M = M, energy_keV = cur_energy, rate = cur_rate, power = pwr, efficiency = math.floor(eff * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000, }) end return result end local function find_K(e0_keV, target_keV) if e0_keV > target_keV then return 0 end for n = 1, 10000 do local sum_sq = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) / 6 if e0_keV + CV * sum_sq > target_keV then return n end end return 10000 end -- ===================== 粒子概率计算 ===================== local function calc_probabilities(module_key, collisionEnergy_keV) local mod = MODULES[module_key] if not mod then return {} end local collisionEnergy_MeV = collisionEnergy_keV / 1000.0 local totalWeight = 0.0 local weights = {} for _, name in ipairs(mod.particles) do local data = PARTICLE_DATA[name] if data then local threshold = math.max(data.mass, MASSLESS_THRESHOLD) local w = (collisionEnergy_MeV >= threshold) and data.weight or 0 weights[name] = { data = data, threshold = threshold, w = w } totalWeight = totalWeight + w end end local probs = {} for _, name in ipairs(mod.particles) do local w = weights[name] if w then probs[name] = { mass = w.data.mass, weight = w.data.weight, threshold = w.threshold, probability = (totalWeight > 0 and w.w > 0) and (w.w / totalWeight) or 0, } end end return probs end -- ===================== ECharts 折线图 ===================== local function build_chart_option(sim_data, K, tierName) local tierVoltage = VOLTAGE_TIERS[tierName] or VOLTAGE_TIERS.MAX local xdata, energy_s, rate_s, power_s = {}, {}, {}, {} for _, row in ipairs(sim_data) do table.insert(xdata, tostring(row.M)) table.insert(energy_s, math.floor(row.energy_keV * 100 + 0.5) / 100) table.insert(rate_s, row.rate) table.insert(power_s, math.floor(row.power / tierVoltage * 100 + 0.5) / 100) -- 转换为安培 end local markLine = {} if K > 0 and K <= #sim_data then markLine = {{ silent = true, label = { formatter = "K=" .. K, position = "end" }, xAxis = tostring(K), lineStyle = { type = "dashed", color = "#ff6b6b" }, }} end return { tooltip = { trigger = "axis" }, legend = { data = { "粒子能量", "粒子通量", "电流 (" .. tierName .. ")" }, top = 0 }, grid = { left = 70, right = 70, top = 40, bottom = 40 }, xAxis = { name = "循环次数 M", type = "category", data = xdata }, yAxis = { { name = "能量 (keV)", type = "value" }, { name = "通量 / 电流 (A)", type = "value" }, }, series = { { name = "粒子能量", type = "line", data = energy_s, smooth = true, yAxisIndex = 0, markLine = { data = markLine }, itemStyle = { color = "#5470c6" } }, { name = "粒子通量", type = "line", data = rate_s, smooth = true, yAxisIndex = 1, itemStyle = { color = "#91cc75" } }, { name = "电流 (" .. tierName .. ")", type = "line", data = power_s, smooth = true, yAxisIndex = 1, lineStyle = { type = "dashed" }, itemStyle = { color = "#ee6666" } }, }, } end -- ===================== 主函数 ===================== function p.calculate(frame) local function num(n, d) local v = frame.args[n]; return (v and v ~= "") and tonumber(v) or d end local function str(n, d) local v = frame.args[n]; return (v and v ~= "") and tostring(v) or d end local UNIT_TO_EV = { eV = 1, keV = 1e3, MeV = 1e6, GeV = 1e9, TeV = 1e12 } local target_val = num("target_val", 1) local target_unit = str("target_unit", "GeV") local target_eV = target_val * (UNIT_TO_EV[target_unit] or 1e9) local target_keV = target_eV / 1000.0 local source = str("source", "长六硼化镧杆") local preset = SOURCE_PRESETS[source] or SOURCE_PRESETS["长六硼化镧杆"] local e0_keV = preset.e0_keV local r0 = preset.r0 local src_label = source .. " → " .. preset.particle local module_key = str("module", "CMS") local maxCycles = math.min(math.max(num("max_cycles", 60), 1), 256) local display_voltage = str("display_voltage", "MAX") local prob_cycle = str("prob_cycle", "opt") -- 模拟 local sim_data = simulate_full(e0_keV, r0, target_keV, maxCycles) local K = find_K(e0_keV, target_keV) local best_M, best_eff = 0, -1 for _, row in ipairs(sim_data) do if row.efficiency > best_eff then best_eff = row.efficiency best_M = row.M end end local best = sim_data[best_M] or sim_data[#sim_data] -- 选择概率计算基准圈数 local prob_source local prob_label if prob_cycle == "max" then prob_source = sim_data[#sim_data] -- 最后一圈 prob_label = "最大圈数 M=" .. prob_source.M else prob_source = best -- 最优循环 prob_label = "最优循环 M=" .. best.M end local collisionEnergy_keV = prob_source.energy_keV * 2 local probs = calc_probabilities(module_key, collisionEnergy_keV) -- ===== 构建结果 ===== local result = {} -- 摘要 result.summary = string.format( '%s | E₀ = %s | R₀ = %d | 目标 = %s | K = %d', src_label, fmtEnergy(e0_keV), r0, fmtEnergy(target_keV), K) -- 最优参数（独立字段，由模板 calc-table 展示） result.opt_M = tostring(best.M) result.opt_energy = fmtEnergy(best.energy_keV) result.opt_collision = fmtEnergy(best.energy_keV * 2) result.opt_rate = fmtInt(best.rate) result.opt_power_display = fmtAmps(best.power, display_voltage) .. ' (' .. fmtPower(best.power) .. ')' result.opt_eff = string.format("%.2f", best.efficiency) -- 折线图 local option = build_chart_option(sim_data, K, display_voltage) result.chart_html = '
{"option":' .. mw.text.jsonEncode(option) .. '}
' -- 概率表头 local mod_label = (MODULES[module_key] and MODULES[module_key].label) or module_key result.prob_header = string.format( '%s  |  碰撞能量：%s  |  基准：%s  |  通量：%s', mod_label, fmtEnergy(collisionEnergy_keV), prob_label, fmtInt(prob_source.rate)) -- 概率表行（Lua 生成完整表格 HTML，使用 calc-table 类） local parts_prob = {} table.insert(parts_prob, '') table.insert(parts_prob, '') for _, name in ipairs(MODULES[module_key].particles) do local p = probs[name] if p then local prob_pct = string.format("%.2f%%", p.probability * 100) local out_rate = math.floor(prob_source.rate * p.probability + 0.5) local active = p.probability > 0 local style = active and "" or ' style="color:#999;"' local mass_str = (p.mass > 0) and (string.format("%.2f", p.mass) .. ' MeV') or '0' local th_str = string.format("%.2f", p.threshold) .. ' MeV' -- 这个，不需要了 -- local item_icon = ITEM_ICON_ALIAS[name] local item_args = item_icon and { name, icon = item_icon } or { name } local item_html = frame:expandTemplate{title = 'Item', args = item_args} table.insert(parts_prob, string.format( '', style, item_html, mass_str, fmtInt(p.weight), th_str, prob_pct, active and fmtInt(out_rate) or "—")) end end table.insert(parts_prob, '
粒子静止质量LHC 权重能量阈值概率输出通量
%s%s%s%s%s%s
') result.prob_table = table.concat(parts_prob, '\n') -- 组装响应 local parts = {} table.insert(parts, '
') for key, value in pairs(result) do local dv = (type(value) == 'table') and mw.text.jsonEncode(value) or tostring(value) table.insert(parts, string.format('
%s
', key, dv)) end table.insert(parts, '

title: 模块_Calculator_大型硅岩反应堆
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/大型硅岩反应堆/doc创建 local p = {} local fuelBase = { ["钍基流体燃料(激发态)"] = 2200, ["铀基流体燃料(激发态)"] = 12960, ["钚基流体燃料(激发态)"] = 32400, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkI"] = 975000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkII"] = 2300000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkIII"] = 9511000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkIV"] = 88540000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkV"] = 399576000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkVI"] = 2077795200, } local fuelHeat = { ["钍基流体燃料(激发态)"] = 1100000, ["铀基流体燃料(激发态)"] = 1296000, ["钚基流体燃料(激发态)"] = 4860000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkI"] = 58500000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkII"] = 161000000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkIII"] = 760880000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkIV"] = 8854000000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkV"] = 63932160000, ["硅岩基流体燃料-MkVI"] = 498670848000, } local coolantData = { ["无"] = { mul = 1, rate = 0 }, ["IC2冷却液"] = { mul = 1.05, rate = 1000 }, ["超级冷却液"] = { mul = 1.5, rate = 1000 }, ["极寒之凛冰"] = { mul = 2.75, rate = 1000 }, ["富快子时间流体"] = { mul = 5, rate = 20 }, } local exciterData = { ["无"] = { mul = 1, rate = 0 }, ["熔融铯"] = { mul = 2, rate = 180 }, ["熔融铀-235"] = { mul = 3, rate = 180 }, ["熔融硅岩"] = { mul = 4, rate = 20 }, ["熔融原子分离催化剂"] = { mul = 16, rate = 20 }, ["扩大化空间流体"] = { mul = 64, rate = 20 }, } local tierVoltage = { ["ULV"] = 8, ["LV"] = 32, ["MV"] = 128, ["HV"] = 512, ["EV"] = 2048, ["IV"] = 8192, ["LuV"] = 32768, ["ZPM"] = 131072, ["UV"] = 524288, ["UHV"] = 2097152, ["UEV"] = 8388608, ["UIV"] = 33554432, ["UMV"] = 134217728, ["UXV"] = 536870912, ["MAX"] = 2147483648, } function p.main(frame) local args = frame.args local function itemName(name) if name == "无" then return "" end return frame:expandTemplate{title = "Item", args = {name}} end local function fmt(v, dec) local f = string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v) local intPart, fracPart = f:match("^(%d+)%.?(%d*)$") local s = tostring(tonumber(intPart)) local k = #s % 3 local parts = {} if k > 0 then table.insert(parts, s:sub(1, k)) end for i = k + 1, #s, 3 do table.insert(parts, s:sub(i, i + 2)) end local r = table.concat(parts, ",") if dec > 0 and fracPart ~= "" then r = r .. "." .. fracPart end return r end local fuel = args.fuel or "硅岩基流体燃料-MkI" local coolant = args.coolant or "极寒之凛冰" local exciter = args.exciter or "熔融原子分离催化剂" local machineCount = tonumber(args.machine_count) or 1 machineCount = math.max(1, math.floor(machineCount)) local ampTier = args.amp_tier or "MAX" local base = fuelBase[fuel] or 0 local cd = coolantData[coolant] or coolantData["无"] local ed = exciterData[exciter] or exciterData["无"] local heat = fuelHeat[fuel] or 1 local power = base * cd.mul * ed.mul local tierV = tierVoltage[ampTier] or tierVoltage["MAX"] local ampSingle = power / tierV local ampTotal = ampSingle * machineCount local baseFuelLps = (base * 20) / heat local fuelConsumeSingle = baseFuelLps * ed.mul local fuelConsumeTotal = fuelConsumeSingle * machineCount local singlePowerStyle = machineCount > 1 and { display = "table-row" } or { display = "none" } local html = '

title: 模块_Calculator_并行计算
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/并行计算/doc创建 local p = {} local TIER_VOLTAGE = { ULV = 8, LV = 32, MV = 128, HV = 512, EV = 2048, IV = 8192, LuV = 32768, ZPM = 131072, UV = 524288, UHV = 2097152, UEV = 8388608, UIV = 33554432, UMV = 134217728, UXV = 536870912, MAX = 2147483640, } local function toNumber(v, default) local n = tonumber(v) if n == nil then return default end return n end local function addThousands(intStr) local sign = "" local s = intStr if s:sub(1,1) == "-" then sign = "-" s = s:sub(2) end local out = s while true do local n2, k = out:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") out = n2 if k == 0 then break end end return sign .. out end local function fmtInt(v) return addThousands(tostring(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 0) + 0.5))) end local function calcForParallel(basePower, ratioPercent, par, totalPower, rateMul) local perRecipe = basePower * (ratioPercent / 100) if perRecipe <= 0 or par <= 0 then return {ok = false, reason = "invalid_input"} end local needBase = perRecipe * par if totalPower < needBase then return {ok = false, reason = "insufficient_power", baseNeed = needBase} end local k = 0 local cur = needBase while (cur * 4) <= totalPower do cur = cur * 4 k = k + 1 end local indicator = par * (rateMul ^ k) local powerPerRate = cur / indicator return { ok = true, parallel = par, overclock = k, power = cur, indicator = indicator, powerPerRate = powerPerRate, perRecipe = perRecipe, } end function p.calculate(frame) local args = frame.args local basePower = toNumber(args.basePower, 480) local ratioPercent = toNumber(args.ratio, 90) local maxParallel = math.floor(toNumber(args.maxParallel, 84)) local tier = tostring(args.tier or "UMV") local ocType = tostring(args.ocType or "4/2") local ampCount = math.floor(toNumber(args.amps, toNumber(args.hatches, 16))) if maxParallel < 1 then maxParallel = 1 end if ampCount < 1 then ampCount = 1 end local voltage = TIER_VOLTAGE[tier] or TIER_VOLTAGE.UMV local totalPower = voltage * ampCount local rateMul = (ocType == "4/4") and 4 or 2 local best = nil for par = 1, maxParallel do local r = calcForParallel(basePower, ratioPercent, par, totalPower, rateMul) if r.ok then if best == nil or r.indicator > best.indicator or (r.indicator == best.indicator and r.powerPerRate < best.powerPerRate) or (r.indicator == best.indicator and r.powerPerRate == best.powerPerRate and r.parallel > best.parallel) then best = r end end end local maxR = calcForParallel(basePower, ratioPercent, maxParallel, totalPower, rateMul) local result = { totalPower = fmtInt(totalPower), bestParallel = best and fmtInt(best.parallel) or "无法运行", maxParallelOut = fmtInt(maxParallel), bestIndicator = best and fmtInt(best.indicator) or "--", maxIndicator = maxR.ok and fmtInt(maxR.indicator) or "无法运行", bestPower = best and fmtInt(best.power) or "--", maxPower = maxR.ok and fmtInt(maxR.power) or "--", bestEff = best and fmtInt(best.powerPerRate) or "--", maxEff = maxR.ok and fmtInt(maxR.powerPerRate) or "--", } local function sr(values) local parts = {} for k, v in pairs(values) do local dv = (type(v) == "table") and mw.text.jsonEncode(v) or tostring(v) table.insert(parts, '
' .. dv .. '
') end return '
' .. table.concat(parts) .. '
' end return sr(result) end return p 复制展开

title: 模块_Calculator_异星铸造塔
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/异星铸造塔/doc创建 local p = {} -- 电压等级映射 local VOLTAGE_TIERS = { "LV", "MV", "HV", "EV", "IV", "LuV", "ZPM", "UV", "UHV", "UEV", "UIV", "UMV", "UXV" } local VOLTAGE_TIER_INDEX = { LV=1, MV=2, HV=3, EV=4, IV=5, LuV=6, ZPM=7, UV=8, UHV=9, UEV=10, UIV=11, UMV=12, UXV=13 } -- 能源仓等级 local STAGE_TIER = { UEV=10, UIV=11, UMV=12, UXV=13 } local UEV_TIER = 10 -- 无 H.R 或 U.C 模块时的配方电压上限 -- 缩写↔图标数据（名称、缩略图 URL） local ABBR_DATA = { ["S.C.B"] = { name = "超致密铸造盆机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/2/29/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_8.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_8.png" }, ["P.V.S"] = { name = "原型电压稳定机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/5/5b/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_6.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_6.png" }, ["S.L.C"] = { name = "流线型铸造机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/4/47/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_10.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_10.png" }, ["H.C"] = { name = "超级冷却机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/0/06/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_9.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_9.png" }, ["H.R"] = { name = "日耀投射强化机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/8/80/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_7.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_7.png" }, ["S.O.C"] = { name = "感知超频机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/e/e1/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_5.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_5.png" }, ["U.C"] = { name = "宇宙坍缩者机械方块", icon = "https://huiji-thumb.huijistatic.com/gtnh/uploads/thumb/0/09/Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_4.png/18px-Icon_gregtech_gt.foundrycasings_4.png" }, } -- 将单个缩写展开为带图标的 wiki 标记（对齐到 4 字符） local function expandAbbr(abbr) local data = ABBR_DATA[abbr] if not data then return abbr end -- 目标长度设为4：H.C (3字符) 将获得 1 个空格；S.C.B (5字符) 不补空格 local padLen = 4 - string.len(abbr) local padStr = "" if padLen > 0 then -- 使用   防止 HTML 渲染折叠空格 padStr = string.rep(" ", padLen) end return "[[File:" .. data.name .. ".png|16px|link=" .. data.name .. "]]'''" .. abbr .. "'''" .. padStr end -- 对齐方案名：将每个缩写填充到固定宽度，使同列模块纵向对齐 -- 各方案 { name, P, S_EF, EU_EF, extraOC, OC_F, hatch, allowsUIVPlus, entropyModules } -- entropyModules 仅用于 3/4 个 H.R 的熵增核心；其各项随机值彼此独立。 -- 按相同模块组合分组排列，同模块方案上下相邻 local CONFIGS = { UEV = { { "S.C.B + S.L.C", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 0, 2.0, 61, false }, { "S.C.B + P.V.S", 28, 1.5, 0.72, 0, 2.0, 61, false }, { "P.V.S + S.L.C", 16, 3.0, 0.72, 0, 2.0, 25, false }, }, UIV = { { "S.C.B + S.L.C + H.C", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 1, 2.0, 61, false }, { "S.C.B + S.L.C + H.R", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 0, 2.0, 61, true }, { "S.L.C + H.C + H.R", 16, 3.0, 1.0, 1, 2.0, 25, true }, { "H.R + H.R + H.R", 16, 1.5, 1.0, 0, 2.0, 25, true, 3 }, }, UMV = { { "S.C.B + S.L.C + S.O.C", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 0, 2.4, 61, false }, { "S.L.C + H.C + S.O.C", 16, 3.0, 1.0, 2, 2.4, 25, false }, { "P.V.S + H.C + S.O.C", 16, 1.5, 0.32, 2, 2.5, 25, false }, { "S.C.B + S.L.C + H.R", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 0, 2.0, 61, true }, { "H.R + H.R + H.R", 16, 1.5, 1.0, 0, 2.0, 25, true, 3 }, }, UXV = { { "S.L.C + H.C + S.O.C + U.C", 16, 24.0, 8.0, 3, 2.4, 10, true }, { "S.C.B + H.C + S.O.C + U.C", 28, 12.0, 8.0, 3, 2.4, 46, true }, { "S.C.B + S.L.C + H.C + U.C", 36, 30.4, 8.0, 3, 2.0, 46, true }, { "S.C.B + S.L.C + H.C + S.O.C", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 2, 2.4, 61, false }, { "S.C.B + S.L.C + H.R + H.C", 36, 3.8, 1.0, 2, 2.0, 61, true }, { "H.R + H.R + H.R + H.R", 16, 1.5, 1.0, 0, 2.0, 25, true, 4 }, }, } local function fmtNum(val, digits) digits = digits or 1 if type(val) ~= "number" then return "0" end if val >= 10000 then local str = string.format("%." .. digits .. "f", val) local int_part, frac_part = string.match(str, "^(-?%d+)%.(%d+)$") if not int_part then return str end local formatted = int_part while true do local k formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") if k == 0 then break end end return formatted .. "." .. frac_part end return string.format("%." .. digits .. "f", val) end local function fmtSci(val) if type(val) ~= "number" or val == 0 then return "0" end return string.format("%.2e", val) end local function fmtRange(minValue, maxValue, formatter) if math.abs(maxValue - minValue) < 1e-9 then return formatter(minValue) end return formatter(minValue) .. "–" .. formatter(maxValue) end local function getConfigBounds(cfg) local _, P, S_EF, EU_EF, extraOC, OC_F, _, _, entropyModules = unpack(cfg) if not entropyModules then return P, P, S_EF, S_EF, EU_EF, EU_EF, extraOC, extraOC, OC_F, OC_F end local maxExtraOC = entropyModules == 4 and 3 or 0 return P, P + 8 * entropyModules, S_EF, S_EF + entropyModules, EU_EF - 0.15 * entropyModules, EU_EF, extraOC, extraOC + maxExtraOC, OC_F, OC_F + 0.05 * entropyModules end -- 对随机配置枚举独立离散取值，供曲线显示组合平均吞吐量。 local function expectedEntropyThroughput(cfg, M, R) local _, P, S_EF, _, extraOC, OC_F, _, _, entropyModules = unpack(cfg) if not entropyModules then local N_eff = M + extraOC - R if N_eff < 0 then return 0 end return P * M * S_EF * math.pow(OC_F, N_eff) end local maxExtraEntropy = entropyModules == 4 and 3 or 0 local total, count = 0, 0 for parallelEntropy = 0, entropyModules do for speedEntropy = 0, entropyModules do for ocEntropy = 0, entropyModules do for extraEntropy = 0, maxExtraEntropy do local N_eff = M + extraOC + extraEntropy - R if N_eff >= 0 then local parallels = P + 8 * parallelEntropy local speed = S_EF + speedEntropy local ocFactor = OC_F + 0.05 * ocEntropy total = total + parallels * M * speed * math.pow(ocFactor, N_eff) end count = count + 1 end end end end return total / count end -- 判断方案能否执行该配方 local function canRun(allowsUIVPlus, N, R) if N < 0 then return false end if not allowsUIVPlus and R > UEV_TIER then return false end return true end -- MS 模拟器：对齐 ProcessingLogic.js imperfect OC 逻辑 local function simulateMS(M, R, amps) local P_ms, S_ms, EU_mod, OC_F = 10, 3.0, 0.8, 2.0 local totalParallels = P_ms * M local V = 32 * math.pow(4, M - 1) local machinePower = V * amps local recipeEUT = 32 * math.pow(4, R - 1) * (15 / 16) * EU_mod local ocUnitEUT = math.max(recipeEUT, 32) local basePower = totalParallels * ocUnitEUT if basePower > machinePower then totalParallels = math.floor(machinePower / ocUnitEUT) basePower = totalParallels * ocUnitEUT end if totalParallels <= 0 then return 0 end local tierOC = M - R if tierOC < 0 then return 0 end local powerOC = math.floor(math.log(machinePower / basePower) / math.log(4)) local actualOCs = math.min(powerOC, tierOC) return totalParallels * S_ms * math.pow(OC_F, actualOCs) end local function doCalculate(args) local stage = args.stage or "UEV" local recipeVoltage = args.recipe_voltage or "IV" local M = STAGE_TIER[stage] or 10 local R = VOLTAGE_TIER_INDEX[recipeVoltage] or 5 local configs = CONFIGS[stage] or CONFIGS["UEV"] local result = {} for idx, cfg in ipairs(configs) do local name, _, _, _, _, _, hatch, allowsUIVPlus = unpack(cfg) local PMin, PMax, SMin, SMax, EUMin, EUMax, extraOCMin, extraOCMax, OCFMin, OCFMax = getConfigBounds(cfg) -- 并行 = P × M（源码：parallelScaleAdj × getTier(getMaxInputVoltage)） -- 超频次数 = M + extraOC - R（extraOC 来自冷却剂，提升 OC 上限但不提升并行基数） local N_eff_min = M + extraOCMin - R local N_eff_max = M + extraOCMax - R local prefix = "cfg" .. idx .. "_" result[prefix .. "name"] = name -- 原始名，供 gsub 匹配 result[prefix .. "name_html"] = name -- 占位，p.main 中展开 result[prefix .. "P"] = fmtRange(PMin, PMax, function(v) return string.format("%.0f", v) end) result[prefix .. "S"] = fmtRange(SMin, SMax, function(v) return string.format("%.0f%%", v * 100) end) result[prefix .. "EU"] = fmtRange(EUMin, EUMax, function(v) return string.format("%.0f%%", v * 100) end) result[prefix .. "extraOC"] = "+" .. fmtRange(extraOCMin, extraOCMax, function(v) return string.format("%.0f", v) end) result[prefix .. "OCF"] = fmtRange(OCFMin, OCFMax, function(v) return string.format("%.2f", v) end) if not canRun(allowsUIVPlus, N_eff_max, R) then result[prefix .. "throughput"] = "—" result[prefix .. "power"] = "—" result[prefix .. "equiv"] = "—" result[prefix .. "hatch"] = tostring(hatch) result[prefix .. "row_style"] = mw.text.jsonEncode({ opacity = "0.35" }) else -- EF 总并行 = P × M（非 M_eff） local ef_tp_min = PMin * M * SMin * math.pow(OCFMin, N_eff_min) local ef_tp_max = PMax * M * SMax * math.pow(OCFMax, N_eff_max) -- 熵的并行、能耗与额外超频掷骰彼此独立，因此范围取各自端点。 local ef_power_min = PMin * M * EUMin * math.pow(4, extraOCMin) * (15 / 16) local ef_power_max = PMax * M * EUMax * math.pow(4, extraOCMax) * (15 / 16) -- MS 吞吐量：模拟器（64A，15/16A配方，有损超频+功率约束） local ms_tp = simulateMS(M, R, 64) local equiv_min = ef_tp_min / ms_tp local equiv_max = ef_tp_max / ms_tp result[prefix .. "throughput"] = fmtRange(ef_tp_min, ef_tp_max, function(v) return fmtNum(v, 0) end) result[prefix .. "equiv"] = fmtRange(equiv_min, equiv_max, function(v) return string.format("%.1f", v) end) result[prefix .. "power"] = fmtRange(ef_power_min, ef_power_max, function(v) return fmtNum(v, 0) end) result[prefix .. "hatch"] = tostring(hatch) result[prefix .. "row_style"] = mw.text.jsonEncode({ display = "table-row", opacity = "1" }) end end -- 隐藏不在本阶段的方案行 for idx = #configs + 1, 7 do result["cfg" .. idx .. "_row_style"] = mw.text.jsonEncode({ display = "none" }) end result["stage_display"] = stage result["recipe_display"] = recipeVoltage -- 图数据 local chart_series = {} local colors = { "#5470c6", "#91cc75", "#fac858", "#ee6666", "#73c0de", "#FFB6C1", "#3ba272" } for idx, cfg in ipairs(configs) do local name, _, _, _, _, _, _, allowsUIVPlus, entropyModules = unpack(cfg) local chartMax = allowsUIVPlus and M or math.min(M, UEV_TIER) local data = {} for tier_idx = 1, chartMax do local r_i = tier_idx local equiv = 0 local ef_tp_i = expectedEntropyThroughput(cfg, M, r_i) if ef_tp_i > 0 then local ms_tp_i = simulateMS(M, r_i, 64) if ms_tp_i > 0 then equiv = ef_tp_i / ms_tp_i end end table.insert(data, equiv) end table.insert(chart_series, { name = entropyModules and (name .. "（期望）") or name, type = "line", data = data, smooth = true, symbol = "circle", symbolSize = 4, lineStyle = { color = colors[idx] }, itemStyle = { color = colors[idx] }, }) end -- x 轴取最宽范围 local chartXMax = M local chart_x_labels = {} for tier_idx = 1, chartXMax do table.insert(chart_x_labels, VOLTAGE_TIERS[tier_idx]) end local chart_opt = { height = 400, option = { customization = { sciFormattedAxis = false }, color = colors, tooltip = { trigger = "axis" }, legend = { top = 5, textStyle = { fontSize = 11 } }, grid = { left = 60, right = 25, top = 55, bottom = 35 }, xAxis = { type = "category", name = "配方电压", nameLocation = "end", nameGap = 12, data = chart_x_labels, }, yAxis = { type = "value", name = "等价32仓大固化 (台)", nameLocation = "end", nameGap = 15, }, series = chart_series, } } result["chart_html"] = '
' .. mw.text.jsonEncode(chart_opt) .. '
' return result end function p.main(frame) local response = doCalculate(frame.args) -- 展开 name_html：先用对齐名替换缩写，再展开为 [[File:]] wiki 标记 local sorted_abbrs = {} for abbr, _ in pairs(ABBR_DATA) do table.insert(sorted_abbrs, abbr) end table.sort(sorted_abbrs, function(a, b) return #a > #b end) for idx = 1, 7 do local name = response["cfg" .. idx .. "_name"] if name then local out = name for _, abbr in ipairs(sorted_abbrs) do local pattern = abbr:gsub("([%.%-])", "%%%1") out = out:gsub(pattern, function(m) return expandAbbr(m) end) end response["cfg" .. idx .. "_name_html"] = out end end local parts = {} table.insert(parts, '
') for key, value in pairs(response) do local displayValue if type(value) == "table" then displayValue = mw.text.jsonEncode(value) else displayValue = tostring(value) end table.insert(parts, string.format('
%s
', key, displayValue)) end table.insert(parts, '
') return table.concat(parts, '\n') end return p 复制展开

title: 模块_Calculator_数据库
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/数据库/doc创建 local p = {} -- 数据库基准耗电（EU/t） -- master：单数据库，结构内不包含任何装配线接收接口 -- slave ：多数据库（从库），结构内包含至少一个装配线接收接口 local BASE_EU = { master = 2048, slave = 32768, } local tierVoltage = { ["ULV"] = 8, ["LV"] = 32, ["MV"] = 128, ["HV"] = 512, ["EV"] = 2048, ["IV"] = 8192, ["LuV"] = 32768, ["ZPM"] = 131072, ["UV"] = 524288, ["UHV"] = 2097152, ["UEV"] = 8388608, ["UIV"] = 33554432, ["UMV"] = 134217728, ["UXV"] = 536870912, ["MAX"] = 2147483648, } -- 千分位 + 保留小数格式化 local function fmt(v, dec) local f = string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v) local intPart, fracPart = f:match("^(%d+)%.?(%d*)$") local s = tostring(tonumber(intPart)) local k = #s % 3 local parts = {} if k > 0 then table.insert(parts, s:sub(1, k)) end for i = k + 1, #s, 3 do table.insert(parts, s:sub(i, i + 2)) end local r = table.concat(parts, ",") if dec > 0 and fracPart ~= "" then r = r .. "." .. fracPart end return r end function p.main(frame) local args = frame.args local receive = tonumber(args.receive) or 0 local da = tonumber(args.data_access) or 0 local sender = tonumber(args.sender) or 0 receive = math.max(0, math.floor(receive)) da = math.max(0, math.floor(da)) sender = math.max(0, math.floor(sender)) -- 结构内含至少一个装配线接收接口时视为多数据库（从库） local base = (receive >= 1) and BASE_EU.slave or BASE_EU.master -- EU/t = 基准耗电 × (1 + 数据访问仓 × 数据库发送接口) local multiplier = 1 + da * sender local total = base * multiplier local ampTier = tostring(args.amp_tier or "ZPM") local tierV = tierVoltage[ampTier] or tierVoltage["ZPM"] local amps = total / tierV local modeLabel = (receive >= 1) and "多数据库（从库）" or "单数据库" local html = '
' html = html .. '
' .. modeLabel .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(base, 0) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(multiplier, 0) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(total, 0) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. string.format("%.2f", amps) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. ampTier .. '
' html = html .. '
' return html end return p 复制展开

title: 模块_Calculator_无线信号增幅器
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/无线信号增幅器/doc创建 local p = {} local function fmt(v, dec) local f = string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v) local intPart, fracPart = f:match("^(%d+)%.?(%d*)$") local s = tostring(tonumber(intPart)) local k = #s % 3 local parts = {} if k > 0 then table.insert(parts, s:sub(1, k)) end for i = k + 1, #s, 3 do table.insert(parts, s:sub(i, i + 2)) end local r = table.concat(parts, ",") if dec > 0 and fracPart ~= "" then r = r .. "." .. fracPart end return r end function p.calculate(frame) local cards = tonumber(frame.args.cards) or 0 cards = math.max(0, math.min(64, cards)) local unit = frame.args.unit or "AE" local radius = 16 + cards ^ 1.5 local powerAE = 10 * (80 + 10 * cards ^ (1 + cards / 64)) local power, unit_label if unit == "EU" then power = powerAE / 2 unit_label = "EU" else power = powerAE unit_label = "AE" end local efficiency = power / radius -- ECharts: 升级卡数量 vs 每米耗电 local chart_data = {} for n = 0, 64 do local r = 16 + n ^ 1.5 local pAE = 10 * (80 + 10 * n ^ (1 + n / 64)) local pwr = (unit == "EU") and (pAE / 2) or pAE local e = pwr / r table.insert(chart_data, { value = { n, e }, tooltipText = string.format("升级卡: %d
每米耗电: %s %s/m", n, fmt(e, 2), unit_label), }) end -- Optimal point at 10 cards (for reference lines) local r10 = 16 + 10 ^ 1.5 local pAE10 = 10 * (80 + 10 * 10 ^ (1 + 10 / 64)) local p10 = (unit == "EU") and (pAE10 / 2) or pAE10 local e10 = p10 / r10 local chart_opt = { height = 300, option = { customization = { tooltipText = true }, color = { "#5470c6" }, tooltip = { trigger = "axis" }, grid = { left = 65, right = 80, top = 40, bottom = 32 }, xAxis = { type = "value", name = "升级卡数量", nameLocation = "end", nameGap = 12, nameTextStyle = { fontSize = 12, fontWeight = "bold" }, min = 0, max = 66, }, yAxis = { type = "value", name = "每米耗电 (" .. unit_label .. "/m)", nameLocation = "end", nameGap = 12, nameTextStyle = { fontSize = 12, fontWeight = "bold" }, }, series = {{ name = "每米耗电", type = "line", data = chart_data, smooth = true, symbol = "none", lineStyle = { color = "#5470c6" }, markLine = { silent = true, symbol = "none", label = { show = false }, lineStyle = { type = "dashed", color = "#e65100" }, data = { { xAxis = 10 }, { yAxis = e10 }, }, }, }}, }, } local chart_html = '
' .. mw.text.jsonEncode(chart_opt) .. '
' local html = '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(radius, 1) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(power, 0) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(efficiency, 2) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. unit_label .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. chart_html .. '
' html = html .. '
' return html end return p 复制展开

title: 模块_Calculator_无线接入器
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/无线接入器/doc创建 local p = {} local function fmt(v, dec) local f = string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v) local intPart, fracPart = f:match("^(%d+)%.?(%d*)$") local s = tostring(tonumber(intPart)) local k = #s % 3 local parts = {} if k > 0 then table.insert(parts, s:sub(1, k)) end for i = k + 1, #s, 3 do table.insert(parts, s:sub(i, i + 2)) end local r = table.concat(parts, ",") if dec > 0 and fracPart ~= "" then r = r .. "." .. fracPart end return r end function p.calculate(frame) local distance = tonumber(frame.args.distance) or 0 distance = math.max(0, distance) local unit = frame.args.unit or "AE" local powerAE = 10 + distance * math.log(distance * distance + 3) powerAE = tonumber(string.format("%.1f", powerAE)) local power, unit_label if unit == "EU" then power = powerAE / 2 unit_label = "EU" else power = powerAE unit_label = "AE" end -- ECharts: 距离 vs 耗电 local max_chart = math.max(64, math.ceil(distance * 1.2)) local chart_data = {} -- 0~100: step 1 for d = 0, math.min(max_chart, 100) do local pAE = 10 + d * math.log(d * d + 3) local p = (unit == "EU") and (pAE / 2) or pAE table.insert(chart_data, { value = { d, p }, tooltipText = string.format("距离: %d m
耗电: %s %s/t", d, fmt(p, 1), unit_label), }) end -- 100~max_chart: step 10 if max_chart > 100 then for d = 110, max_chart, 10 do local pAE = 10 + d * math.log(d * d + 3) local p = (unit == "EU") and (pAE / 2) or pAE table.insert(chart_data, { value = { d, p }, tooltipText = string.format("距离: %d m
耗电: %s %s/t", d, fmt(p, 1), unit_label), }) end end local chart_opt = { height = 300, option = { customization = { tooltipText = true }, color = { "#5470c6" }, tooltip = { trigger = "axis" }, grid = { left = 65, right = 80, top = 40, bottom = 32 }, xAxis = { type = "value", name = "距离 (m)", nameLocation = "end", nameGap = 12, nameTextStyle = { fontSize = 12, fontWeight = "bold" }, min = 0, max = max_chart, }, yAxis = { type = "value", name = "耗电 (" .. unit_label .. "/t)", nameLocation = "end", nameGap = 12, nameTextStyle = { fontSize = 12, fontWeight = "bold" }, }, series = {{ name = "耗电", type = "line", data = chart_data, smooth = true, symbol = "none", lineStyle = { color = "#5470c6" }, markLine = { silent = true, symbol = "none", label = { show = false }, lineStyle = { type = "dashed", color = "#e65100" }, data = { { xAxis = distance } }, }, }}, }, } local chart_html = '
' .. mw.text.jsonEncode(chart_opt) .. '
' local html = '
' html = html .. '
' .. fmt(power, 1) .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. unit_label .. '
' html = html .. '
' .. chart_html .. '
' html = html .. '
' return html end return p 复制展开

local function norm_quantile(p)

end
if p < p_low then
-- 左尾有理近似

local num = ((((a[1]*r + a[2])*r + a[3])*r + a[4])*r + a[5])*r + a[6]
local den = ((((b[1]*r + b[2])*r + b[3])*r + b[4])*r + b[5])*r + 1
return q * num / den
else return -norm_quantile(1-p)
end

end

local maxOut = maxSuccess * out
local bestOut=math.floor(batch * prob + math.sqrt(batch * prob * (1 - prob)) * norm_quantile(1-confidence) + 0.5)
local expOut = batch * prob * out
res.batch = tostring(batch)
res.max_out = formatNum(maxOut)
res.min_out = formatNum(bestOut)
res.exp_out = formatNum(expOut)
res.target_out_show = '-'
res.need_batch = '-'
res.need_input = '-'
res.prob_at_target = '-'
return res
end
function p.calcForParallel(input)
return calculateCore(input or {})
end
function p.main(frame)
local input = frame and frame.args or {}
local res = calculateCore(input)
return mw.text.jsonEncode(res)
end
return p

(p or 2) .. "f", v) end -- 获取线圈基础温度 local function getCoilTemp(coil) if coil == "白铜线圈" then return 1801 elseif coil == "坎塔尔合金线圈" then return 2701 elseif coil == "镍铬合金线圈" then return 3601 elseif coil == "钛铂钒合金线圈" then return 4501 elseif coil == "高速钢-G线圈" then return 5401 elseif coil == "高速钢-S线圈" then return 6301 elseif coil == "硅岩线圈" then return 7201 elseif coil == "硅岩合金线圈" then return 8101 elseif coil == "三元金属线圈" then return 9001 elseif coil == "通流琥珀金线圈" then return 9901 elseif coil == "觉醒龙锭线圈" then return 10801 elseif coil == "无尽线圈" then return 11701 elseif coil == "海珀珍线圈" then return 12601 elseif coil == "永恒线圈" then return 13501 else return nil end end local function sr(values) local parts = {} for k, v in pairs(values) do local dv = (type(v) == "table") and mw.text.jsonEncode(v) or tostring(v) table.insert(parts, '
' .. dv .. '
') end return '
' .. table.concat(parts) .. '
' end -- 主计算函数 function p.calculate(frame) local args = frame.args -- 1. 解析输入参数 (对应 HTML 表单的 name 属性) -- 机器及线圈 local coilBaseKelvin = toNumber(getCoilTemp(args.coil), 5401) -- 能源仓 local hatchTier = args.hatchTier or "IV" local hatchAmps = toNumber(args.hatchAmps, 2) -- 配方信息 local recipeEu = toNumber(args.recipeEu, 480) local recipeSeconds = toNumber(args.recipeSeconds, 60) local recipeKelvin = toNumber(args.recipeKelvin, 1700) -- 2. 计算机器基础属性 local hatchVoltage = TIER_VOLTAGE[hatchTier] or TIER_VOLTAGE.IV local totalMachinePower = hatchVoltage * hatchAmps -- 3. 检查配方是否可执行 -- 炉温不足 local actualTemp = coilBaseKelvin if actualTemp < recipeKelvin then return sr({ oneToCLabel = "未触发", coilTemp = fmtInt(coilBaseKelvin), actualRecipePower = 0, actualLossyOcs = 0, actualPerfectOcs = 0, bestParallel = "炉温不足", bestTotalPower = 0, bestThroughput = 0, }) end -- 错误检查：功率不足 if totalMachinePower < recipeEu then return sr({ oneToCLabel = "未触发", coilTemp = fmtInt(coilBaseKelvin), actualRecipePower = 0, actualLossyOcs = 0, actualPerfectOcs = 0, bestParallel = "功率不足", bestTotalPower = 0, bestThroughput = 0, }) end if hatchVoltage * 4 < recipeEu then return sr({ oneToCLabel = "未触发", coilTemp = fmtInt(coilBaseKelvin), actualRecipePower = 0, actualLossyOcs = 0, actualPerfectOcs = 0, bestParallel = "电压等级不足", bestTotalPower = 0, bestThroughput = 0, }) end -- 4. 计算热力加成系数 local tempExcess = actualTemp - recipeKelvin -- 4.1 功率折扣：每900K温差，能耗 x0.95 local discountSteps = math.floor(tempExcess / 900) local powerFactor = 0.95 ^ discountSteps -- 炽焰高炉固有能耗系数叠加 powerFactor = powerFactor * 0.9 local actualRecipePower = recipeEu * powerFactor -- 4.2 无损超频计数：每1800K温差，+1次无损 local maxPerfectOcs = math.floor(tempExcess / 1800) -- 5. 判定是否发生 1tOC local maxParallel = 8 local otocFactor = 1 -- 求最大有损超频次数 -- 按最大并行来判定 1tOC local maxLossyOcs = math.max(math.floor(math.log(totalMachinePower / actualRecipePower / maxParallel) / math.log(4)), 0) -- 计算实际的无损和有损超频次数 local actualLossyOcs = math.max(0, maxLossyOcs - maxPerfectOcs) local actualPerfectOcs = maxLossyOcs - actualLossyOcs -- 计算最终配方耗时 local finalRecipeTime = recipeSeconds / (2 ^ actualLossyOcs * 4 ^ actualPerfectOcs) / 2.2 -- 触发 1tOC 超频 local flag = false if finalRecipeTime < 0.05 then flag = true -- 1tOC 倍率：配方时间压缩到 1tick 的倍率 otocFactor = math.ceil(0.05 / finalRecipeTime) -- 最大并行乘上 1tOC 超频因子 maxParallel = math.min(8 * otocFactor, math.floor(totalMachinePower / actualRecipePower)) -- 配方时间固定为 1 tick finalRecipeTime = 0.05 end -- 5. 遍历寻找最优并行 local best = nil if flag == false then maxParallel = math.min(8, math.floor(totalMachinePower / actualRecipePower)) end for par = 1, maxParallel do -- 求最大有损超频次数 maxLossyOcs = math.max(math.floor(math.log(totalMachinePower / actualRecipePower / par) / math.log(4)), 0) -- 计算实际的无损和有损超频次数 actualLossyOcs = math.max(0, maxLossyOcs - maxPerfectOcs) actualPerfectOcs = maxLossyOcs - actualLossyOcs -- 计算最终总功率和耗时 if flag == false then finalRecipeTime = recipeSeconds / (2 ^ actualLossyOcs * 4 ^ actualPerfectOcs) / 2.2 end -- 炽焰高炉固有加速 local throughput = par / finalRecipeTime local finalPower = math.floor(par * actualRecipePower * 4 ^ (actualLossyOcs + actualPerfectOcs)) local result = { parallel = par, time = finalRecipeTime, power = finalPower, throughput = throughput, lossy = actualLossyOcs, perfect = actualPerfectOcs, } -- 吞吐量越大越好 if best == nil or result.throughput >= best.throughput then best = result end end -- 7. 构建输出 if best == nil then return sr({ bestParallel = "无法运行" }) end local oneToCLabel = flag and (fmtInt(otocFactor) .. "x") or "未触发" local resultJson = { oneToCLabel = oneToCLabel, coilTemp = fmtInt(coilBaseKelvin), actualRecipePower = fmtFloat(actualRecipePower, 2), actualLossyOcs = fmtInt(best.lossy), actualPerfectOcs = fmtInt(best.perfect), bestParallel = fmtInt(best.parallel), bestTotalPower = fmtInt(best.power), bestThroughput = fmtFloat(best.throughput, 4), } return sr(resultJson) end return p 复制展开

此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/砖高炉/doc创建 local p = {} local UNIT_STEP = 2 local MAX_RENDER_FURNACES = 400 local COLORS = { wall = '#b98252', chamber = '#e8edf2', controller = '#4c83c3', empty = '#f8f5f0', } -- 紧凑基本块点阵：除以 2 后，基本块的平移向量为 (-2,1)、(1,2)， -- 行列式为 5。每个基本块含 4 座炉；其四个炉膛中心在粗坐标中是 -- (0,0)、(1,0)、(0,1)、(1,1)，而不是把四座炉强行围在同一个空心点外侧。 local TILE_V1 = { x = -4, y = 2 } local TILE_V2 = { x = 2, y = 4 } local TILE_REPS = { { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = 1, y = 0 }, { x = 0, y = 1 }, { x = 1, y = 1 }, } -- 固定 perfect-code 点阵上的有限搜索样本。每行是 -- {粗坐标 y, 最小 x, 最大 x}；行内只保留 -- (x + 2y) mod 5 ~= 4 的四炉点阵位置。它们是逐格检查过的可行 -- 排布，专门覆盖临界区的几个输入，不代表任意台数的全局最优。 local SEARCH_ROWS = { [104] = { { -1, -3, -2 }, { 0, -5, -2 }, { 1, -7, -1 }, { 2, -9, -1 }, { 3, -9, 0 }, { 4, -8, 0 }, { 5, -9, 1 }, { 6, -9, 1 }, { 7, -9, 2 }, { 8, -9, 2 }, { 9, -8, 2 }, { 10, -8, 2 }, { 11, -7, 1 }, { 12, -4, -1 }, }, [108] = { { -2, -6, -3 }, { -1, -8, -2 }, { 0, -9, -2 }, { 1, -9, -1 }, { 2, -9, -1 }, { 3, -10, 0 }, { 4, -10, 0 }, { 5, -10, 1 }, { 6, -10, 1 }, { 7, -9, 2 }, { 8, -9, 2 }, { 9, -8, 0 }, { 10, -8, -2 }, { 11, -7, -4 }, }, [112] = { { 1, -2, 1 }, { 2, -4, 2 }, { 3, -6, 2 }, { 4, -7, 3 }, { 5, -7, 3 }, { 6, -7, 4 }, { 7, -7, 4 }, { 8, -6, 5 }, { 9, -6, 5 }, { 10, -5, 5 }, { 11, -5, 5 }, { 12, -4, 4 }, { 13, -4, 2 }, { 14, -3, 0 }, }, [116] = { { -1, -3, 0 }, { 0, -5, 1 }, { 1, -7, 1 }, { 2, -8, 2 }, { 3, -8, 2 }, { 4, -8, 3 }, { 5, -8, 3 }, { 6, -7, 4 }, { 7, -7, 4 }, { 8, -6, 5 }, { 9, -6, 5 }, { 10, -5, 3 }, { 11, -5, 1 }, { 12, -4, -1 }, { 13, -4, -3 }, }, } local function positionKey(x, y) return tostring(x) .. ',' .. tostring(y) end local function holeKey(i, j) return tostring(i) .. ',' .. tostring(j) end local function addSet(set, x, y) set[positionKey(x, y)] = true end local function calculateBrickCount(count) if count <= 3 then return 24 * count + 12 end if count % 2 == 0 then return 20 * count + 20 end return 20 * count + 24 end local function getStandardCenters(count) local centers = {} local function add(column, row) table.insert(centers, { x = column * UNIT_STEP + 1, y = row * UNIT_STEP + 1, }) end if count == 1 then add(0, 0) elseif count == 2 then add(0, 0) add(0, 1) elseif count == 3 then add(0, 0) add(1, 0) add(0, 1) else local columns = math.ceil(count / 2) for index = 0, count - 1 do add(index % columns, math.floor(index / columns)) end end return centers end local function chooseStandardControllers(centers) local centerMap = {} local controllers = {} for _, center in ipairs(centers) do centerMap[positionKey(center.x, center.y)] = true end local candidates = { { cellX = 0, cellY = 1, neighbourX = 0, neighbourY = 2 }, { cellX = 0, cellY = -1, neighbourX = 0, neighbourY = -2 }, { cellX = 1, cellY = 0, neighbourX = 2, neighbourY = 0 }, { cellX = -1, cellY = 0, neighbourX = -2, neighbourY = 0 }, } for _, center in ipairs(centers) do for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do local neighbourKey = positionKey(center.x + candidate.neighbourX, center.y + candidate.neighbourY) if not centerMap[neighbourKey] then addSet(controllers, center.x + candidate.cellX, center.y + candidate.cellY) break end end end return controllers end local function countFootprint(centers) local occupied = {} for _, center in ipairs(centers) do for dy = -1, 1 do for dx = -1, 1 do addSet(occupied, center.x + dx, center.y + dy) end end end local count = 0 for _ in pairs(occupied) do count = count + 1 end return occupied, count end local function addTileFurnace(centers, centerMap, controllers, controllerMap, coarseX, coarseY) local cx = coarseX * 2 local cy = coarseY * 2 local residue = (coarseX + 2 * coarseY) % 5 if residue < 0 then residue = residue + 5 end -- 空心点取 residue=4。每个炉子的主机朝向它唯一相邻的空心点。 local direction if residue == 0 then direction = { x = -1, y = 0 } elseif residue == 1 then direction = { x = 0, y = -1 } elseif residue == 2 then direction = { x = 0, y = 1 } else direction = { x = 1, y = 0 } end local centerKey = positionKey(cx, cy) local controllerX = cx + direction.x local controllerY = cy + direction.y local controllerKey = positionKey(controllerX, controllerY) if centerMap[centerKey] or controllerMap[controllerKey] then return false end table.insert(centers, { x = cx, y = cy, controllerX = controllerX, controllerY = controllerY, }) centerMap[centerKey] = true controllerMap[controllerKey] = true addSet(controllers, controllerX, controllerY) return true end local function tilePosition(tileI, tileJ, rep) return tileI * (TILE_V1.x / 2) + tileJ * (TILE_V2.x / 2) + rep.x, tileI * (TILE_V1.y / 2) + tileJ * (TILE_V2.y / 2) + rep.y end local function integerSqrt(value) local root = math.floor(math.sqrt(value)) while (root + 1) * (root + 1) <= value do root = root + 1 end while root * root > value do root = root - 1 end return math.max(1, root) end local function getTileCandidate(count) -- 目前先对完整的四炉单元做可复现构造；1～3 座余数炉的边界 -- 优化仍作为开放问题，不在这里用未证明的组合搜索冒充最优。 if count < 4 or count % 4 ~= 0 then return nil end local fullTiles = count / 4 local remainder = 0 local a = integerSqrt(fullTiles) local b = math.floor(fullTiles / a) local extraTiles = fullTiles - a * b local tileMap = {} for i = 0, a - 1 do for j = 0, b - 1 do tileMap[holeKey(i, j)] = { i = i, j = j } end end for j = 0, extraTiles - 1 do tileMap[holeKey(a, j)] = { i = a, j = j } end local function build(extraTile, extraReps) local centers = {} local centerMap = {} local controllers = {} local controllerMap = {} for _, tile in pairs(tileMap) do for _, rep in ipairs(TILE_REPS) do local coarseX, coarseY = tilePosition(tile.i, tile.j, rep) if not addTileFurnace(centers, centerMap, controllers, controllerMap, coarseX, coarseY) then return nil end end end if extraTile and extraReps then for _, rep in ipairs(extraReps) do local coarseX, coarseY = tilePosition(extraTile.i, extraTile.j, rep) if not addTileFurnace(centers, centerMap, controllers, controllerMap, coarseX, coarseY) then return nil end end end if #centers ~= count then return nil end local _, occupied = countFootprint(centers) return { centers = centers, controllers = controllers, occupied = occupied, } end local best = build(nil, nil) if not best then return nil end best.fullTiles = fullTiles best.remainder = remainder best.a = a best.b = b best.extraTiles = extraTiles best.bricks = best.occupied * 4 return best end local function getSearchCandidate(count) local rows = SEARCH_ROWS[count] if not rows then return nil end local centers = {} local centerMap = {} local controllers = {} local controllerMap = {} for _, row in ipairs(rows) do local coarseY, minX, maxX = row[1], row[2], row[3] for coarseX = minX, maxX do local residue = (coarseX + 2 * coarseY) % 5 if residue < 0 then residue = residue + 5 end if residue ~= 4 then if not addTileFurnace(centers, centerMap, controllers, controllerMap, coarseX, coarseY) then return nil end end end end if #centers ~= count then return nil end local _, occupied = countFootprint(centers) return { centers = centers, controllers = controllers, occupied = occupied, bricks = occupied * 4, searched = true, } end local function buildLegend(mode, truncated) local function swatch(color) return '' end local note = truncated and '
台数较大，仅截取局部示意；计数仍按完整排布计算。' or '' return table.concat({ '
', '
', swatch(COLORS.wall), 'F：耐火砖块', swatch(COLORS.controller), 'B：砖高炉主机', swatch(COLORS.chamber), 'L：岩浆（炉膛）', '' .. mode .. note .. '', '
', '
', }) end local function buildGrid(centers, controllers, mode, isDense, truncated) local centerCells = {} local owners = {} local minX, minY, maxX, maxY for _, center in ipairs(centers) do centerCells[positionKey(center.x, center.y)] = true minX = math.min(minX or center.x - 1, center.x - 1) minY = math.min(minY or center.y - 1, center.y - 1) maxX = math.max(maxX or center.x + 1, center.x + 1) maxY = math.max(maxY or center.y + 1, center.y + 1) for dy = -1, 1 do for dx = -1, 1 do local key = positionKey(center.x + dx, center.y + dy) owners[key] = (owners[key] or 0) + 1 end end end local cellSize = isDense and 12 or 20 local gridWidth = maxX - minX + 1 local gridHeight = maxY - minY + 1 local parts = { '
', '
', } for y = minY, maxY do for x = minX, maxX do local key = positionKey(x, y) local color = COLORS.empty if centerCells[key] then color = COLORS.chamber elseif controllers[key] then color = COLORS.controller elseif owners[key] then color = COLORS.wall end table.insert(parts, '
') end end table.insert(parts, '
') table.insert(parts, buildLegend(mode, truncated)) table.insert(parts, '
') return table.concat(parts) end local function limitRenderCenters(centers, controllers) if #centers <= MAX_RENDER_FURNACES then return centers, controllers, false end local limited = {} local limitedControllers = {} for index = 1, MAX_RENDER_FURNACES do local center = centers[index] table.insert(limited, center) if center.controllerX and center.controllerY then addSet(limitedControllers, center.controllerX, center.controllerY) end end if next(limitedControllers) == nil then limitedControllers = chooseStandardControllers(limited) end return limited, limitedControllers, true end local function buildLayout(count, dense) if dense then local centers, controllers, truncated = limitRenderCenters(dense.centers, dense.controllers) return buildGrid(centers, controllers, '紧凑基本块点阵（当前已知可行构造）', true, truncated) end local centers = getStandardCenters(count) local controllers = chooseStandardControllers(centers) local renderCenters, renderControllers, truncated = limitRenderCenters(centers, controllers) return buildGrid(renderCenters, renderControllers, '常规共用排布', false, truncated) end function p.calculate(frame) local count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(frame.args['bbfs']) or 1)) local standardBricks = calculateBrickCount(count) local tile = getTileCandidate(count) local searched = getSearchCandidate(count) local dense = searched or tile local useDense = dense and dense.bricks < standardBricks local bricks = useDense and dense.bricks or standardBricks local formula if useDense then formula = '4 × ' .. dense.occupied .. ' = ' .. bricks .. '（紧凑点阵可行构造）' .. (dense.searched and '
该边界值来自固定点阵的有限搜索样本。' or '
完整基本块：' .. dense.fullTiles .. '；当前候选的常规排布为 ' .. standardBricks .. ' 块。') elseif count <= 3 then formula = '24 × ' .. count .. ' + 12 = ' .. bricks .. '（' .. count .. ' 座）' elseif count % 2 == 0 then formula = '20 × ' .. count .. ' + 20 = ' .. bricks .. '（偶数座常规共用）' else formula = '20 × ' .. count .. ' + 24 = ' .. bricks .. '（奇数座常规共用）' end if count % 4 ~= 0 and count >= 4 then formula = formula .. '
点阵候选目前只覆盖完整四炉单元；本输入含余数台，暂按常规排布。任意台数的全局最优仍未证明。' elseif not useDense and tile then local difference = tile.bricks - standardBricks formula = formula .. '
紧凑基本块候选为 ' .. tile.bricks .. ' 块，与常规相差 ' .. difference .. ' 块；当前采用常规排布。' end l

'"}' end function p.calculate(frame) local mode = tostring(frame.args.mode or "single") if mode ~= "single" and mode ~= "multi" then mode = "single" end local isSingle = (mode == "single") -- switch 只切换模式；两组输入始终都会提交，所以模块必须按模式忽略不适用的那一组 local mineral = tostring(frame.args.mineral or "") local minerals = parseList(frame.args.minerals) local valueText if isSingle then valueText = mineral ~= "" and mineral or "（未选择）" else valueText = #minerals > 0 and table.concat(minerals, "、") or "（未选择）" end local function r(name, value) return '
' .. value .. '
' end return '
' -- 用 form-style 控制左侧两组输入的可见性：只有当前模式的那一组显示 .. r("single_field_style", displayStyle(isSingle and "block" or "none")) .. r("multi_field_style", displayStyle(isSingle and "none" or "block")) .. r("mode_result", "当前模式（switch）：" .. (isSingle and "单矿石" or "多矿石") .. "") .. r("value_result", "参与计算的值：" .. mw.text.nowiki(valueText) .. (isSingle and "" or ("（共 " .. tostring(#minerals) .. " 项）"))) .. '
' end return p 复制展开

此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/编辑按钮/doc创建 --[=[ 供 模板:Calculator 系列的计算器在自己的标题栏内引用的辅助模块。 用法：在计算器模板的 calc-header 内写 {{#invoke:Calculator/编辑按钮|link|Calculator/XXX}} 第二个参数是该计算器使用的模块名，与卡片上的 data-module 一致；省略时按 “模块: + 模板子页面名”推导。模块输出“编辑模板”和“编辑模块”两个按钮， 分别指向计算器模板页与模块页，再由 零件:AsyncRequester.js 指向 action=edit。 ]=] local p = {} local MODULE_NAMESPACE = 828 -- Module local function moduleNamespaceName() local ns = mw.site.namespaces[MODULE_NAMESPACE] return ns and ns.name or 'Module' end --[[ 调用链：计算器模板 → {{#invoke:...}} 逐级向上查找，跳过模块自身，返回最近的宿主页面标题。 ]] local function resolveHostTitle(frame) local current = frame and frame:getParent() or nil local depth = 0 while current and depth < 4 do local name = current:getTitle() local title = name and mw.title.new(name) or nil if title and title.namespace ~= MODULE_NAMESPACE then return title end current = current:getParent() depth = depth + 1 end return nil end -- 省略模块参数时，按 模板:Calculator/XXX → 模块:Calculator/XXX 推导。 local function defaultModuleTitle(hostTitle) return mw.title.new(moduleNamespaceName() .. text:

local p = {}
local TIER_INDEX = {
ULV = 0, LV = 1, MV = 2, HV = 3, EV = 4, IV = 5,
LuV = 6, ZPM = 7, UV = 8, UHV = 9, UEV = 10,
UIV = 11, UMV = 12, UXV = 13, MAX = 14,
}
local DRILL_MIN_TIER = {
["1"] = "MV",
["2"] = "HV",
["3"] = "EV",
["4"] = "IV",
}
local ENDLESS_KEY = "无尽钻机"
local ENDLESS_MIN_ENERGY = "UHV"
local ENDLESS_BASE_FOR_SPEED = "EV"
local CHUNKS_TIER = {
["1"] = 1,
["2"] = 4,
["3"] = 16,
["4"] = 64,
[ENDLESS_KEY] = 64
}
local function toNumber(v, d)
local n = tonumber(v)
if n == nil then return d end
return n
end
local function addThousands(intStr)
local sign, s = "", intStr
if s:sub(1,1) == "-" then
sign = "-"
s = s:sub(2)
end
local out = s
while true do
local n2, k = out:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
out = n2
if k == 0 then break end
end
return sign .. out
end
local function fmtInt(v)
local n = math.floor((tonumber(v) or 0) + 0.5)
return addThousands(tostring(n))
end
local function fmtDec(v, dec)
local n = tonumber(v) or 0
local scale = 10 ^ dec
local rounded = math.floor(n * scale + 0.5) / scale
local pat = "%0." .. tostring(dec) .. "f"
local s = string.format(pat, rounded)
local intPart, fracPart = s:match("^([%-]?%d+)%.(%d+)$")
if fracPart then
return addThousands(intPart) .. "." .. fracPart
end
return addThousands(s)
end
local function compute(input)
local reserve = math.max(1, toNumber(input.reserve, 509))
local drillTier = tostring(input.drillTier or "2")
local energyTier = tostring(input.energyTier or "EV")
local baseCycleTicks = 8
local curIdx = TIER_INDEX[energyTier] or 4
local delta, speed, minTier
local chunks = CHUNKS_TIER[drillTier]
if drillTier == ENDLESS_KEY then
local endlessMinIdx = TIER_INDEX[ENDLESS_MIN_ENERGY] or 9
local baseIdx = TIER_INDEX[ENDLESS_BASE_FOR_SPEED] or 4
minTier = ENDLESS_MIN_ENERGY
if curIdx < endlessMinIdx then
return {
ok = false,
chunks = chunks,
reason = "无尽钻机最低能源仓等级为" .. ENDLESS_MIN_ENERGY,
}
end
delta = curIdx - baseIdx
speed = 0.50 + 0.25 * delta
else
minTier = DRILL_MIN_TIER[drillTier] or "HV"
local minIdx = TIER_INDEX[minTier] or 3
if curIdx < minIdx then
return {
ok = false,
chunks = chunks,
reason = "能源仓等级低于该钻机最低需求（" .. minTier .. "）",
}
end
delta = curIdx - minIdx
speed = 0.50 + 0.25 * delta
end
local cycleTicks = baseCycleTicks / (2 ^ delta)
if cycleTicks < 1 then cycleTicks = 1 end
local extractPerCycle = math.floor(reserve * speed)
local maxRate = extractPerCycle / cycleTicks * 20
local avgRate = maxRate / 2
local totalOutput = 500 * reserve * reserve * chunks
local consumePerCycle = speed / 1000
local lifeCycles = reserve / consumePerCycle
local lifeTicks = lifeCycles * cycleTicks
return {
ok = true,
totalOutput = totalOutput,
avgRate = avgRate,
currentRate = maxRate,
totalRate = maxRate * chunks,
lifeTicks = lifeTicks,
minTier = minTier,
chunks = chunks,
speed = speed,
cycleTicks = cycleTicks,
isEndless = (drillTier == ENDLESS_KEY),
}
end
function p.calculate(frame)
local r = compute(frame.args or {})
if not r.ok then
return mw.text.jsonEncode({
chunks = r.chunks,
speed = "无法运行",
cycleTicks = "无法运行",
totalOutput = "无法运行",
avgRate = "无法运行",
totalRate = "无法运行",
currentRate = "无法运行",
lifetime = r.reason or "无法运行",
})
end
return mw.text.jsonEncode({
chunks = r.chunks,
speed = fmtDec(r.speed, 2),
cycleTicks = fmtInt(r.cycleTicks, 1),
totalOutput = r.isEndless and "-" or fmtInt(r.totalOutput),
avgRate = r.isEndless and "-" or fmtDec(r.avgRate, 2),
totalRate = fmtDec(r.totalRate, 2),
currentRate = fmtDec(r.currentRate, 2),
lifetime = r.isEndless and "-" or fmtDec(((tonumber(r.lifeTicks) or 0) / 20 / 3600), 1),
})
end
return p

local p = {}
-- 自定义舍入函数：以 0.2 为单位向下取整，且最小值为 0.2
local function floorToPointTwo(n)
if n == nil or n <= 0 then return 0.2 end
-- 以 0.2 为步长向下取整
local floored = math.floor(n / 0.2) * 0.2
-- 确保不得为 0
return math.max(0.2, floored)
end
-- 格式化输出
local function formatNum(n)
if n == nil then return "0.20" end
-- 统一保留两位小数，因为是以 0.2 为单位
local LLONG_MAX = 9223372036854775807
-- 判断是否超过最大值
if n > LLONG_MAX then
return ">2^63"
end
return string.format("%.2f", n)
end
function p.main(frame)
local args = frame.args
local res = {}
-- 获取输入参数
local f = tonumber(args['f_factor']) or 1
local has_stem = (args['has_stem'] == "是" or args['has_stem'] == "1")
local has_sefcp = (args['has_sefcp'] == "是" or args['has_sefcp'] == "1")
local has_cnti = (args['has_cnti'] == "是" or args['has_cnti'] == "1") and has_sefcp
local has_ndpe = (args['has_ndpe'] == "是" or args['has_ndpe'] == "1") and has_cnti
-- STEM 修正系数
local stem_multiplier = has_stem and 0.8 or 1.0
-- 1. 超维度残留: f * 300 * 1.15^f
local val1 = f * 300 * math.pow(1.15, f) * stem_multiplier
res["res_1"] = formatNum(floorToPointTwo(val1))
-- 2. 浓缩原始恒星等离子体混合物: f * 2 * 1.08^f
local val2 = f * 2 * math.pow(1.08, f) * stem_multiplier
res["res_2"] = formatNum(floorToPointTwo(val2))
-- 3. 磁流体约束恒星物质: f / 25
local val3 = (f / 25) * stem_multiplier
res["res_3"] = formatNum(floorToPointTwo(val3))
-- 炉温
local function calculateHeat(base)
return 12601 + (math.log(f) / math.log(base) * 1000)
end
local function calculateHeatEff(heat, exp)
local heat_eff
if heat <= 15000 then
heat_eff = heat
elseif heat <= 30000 then
if has_cnti then
heat_eff = heat
else
heat_eff = 15000
end
else
if has_ndpe then
heat_eff = 30000 + (heat - 30000)^exp
elseif has_cnti then
heat_eff = 30000
else
heat_eff = 15000
end
end
return heat_eff
end
local base_hpf = has_sefcp and 1.12 or 1.5
local base_other = has_sefcp and 1.18 or 1.5
local exp_hpf = 0.85
local exp_other = 0.8
local heat_hpf = calculateHeat(base_hpf)
local heat_eff_hpf = calculateHeatEff(heat_hpf, exp_hpf)
local heat_other = calculateHeat(base_other)
local heat_eff_other = calculateHeatEff(heat_other, exp_other)
res["heat_hpf"] = tostring(math.floor(heat_hpf))
res["heat_eff_hpf"] = tostring(math.floor(heat_eff_hpf))
res["heat_other"] = tostring(math.floor(heat_other))
res["heat_eff_other"] = tostring(math.floor(heat_eff_other))
res["cnti_style"] = has_sefcp and {display= "initial"} or {display= "none"}
res["ndpe_style"] = has_cnti and {display= "initial"} or {display= "none"}
return mw.text.jsonEncode(res)
end
return p

text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/超维校准矩阵/doc创建 local p = {} local voltageRankTable = { ["UHV"] = 1, ["UEV"] = 2, ["UIV"] = 3, ["UMV"] = 4, ["UXV"] = 5, ["MAX"] = 6 } local catalystTierTable = { ["激发的粗制超维度催化剂"] = 14514983, ["激发的平凡超维度催化剂"] = 66768460, ["激发的光辉超维度催化剂"] = 269326451, ["激发的异星超维度催化剂"] = 1073007393, ["激发的恒星超维度催化剂"] = 4276767520, } local function log4floor(n) if n <= 0 then return 0 end return math.floor(math.log(n) / math.log(4)) end local function calculate(totalEu, basicVoltage, catalystTier, inputCurrent, inputVoltage, inputCatayst) local basicRank = voltageRankTable[basicVoltage] or 1 local inputRank = voltageRankTable[inputVoltage] or basicRank local voltageOverclock = math.max(inputRank - basicRank, 0) local amperageOverclock = log4floor(inputCurrent) local overclockTimes = voltageOverclock + amperageOverclock local euMultipleOverclock = 2 ^ overclockTimes local totalEuOverclock = totalEu * euMultipleOverclock local extraEuOverclock = totalEuOverclock - totalEu local catalystEu = catalystTierTable[catalystTier] local otherCatayst = extraEuOverclock / catalystEu local totalCatayst = otherCatayst + inputCatayst local halfotherCatayst = otherCatayst / 2 local halftotalCatayst = totalCatayst / 2 local response = {} response.otherCatayst = otherCatayst response.totalCatayst = totalCatayst response.halfotherCatayst = halfotherCatayst response.halftotalCatayst = halftotalCatayst return response end function p.main(frame) local args = frame.args local totalEu = tonumber(args.totalEu) or 0 local basicVoltage = args.basicVoltage local catalystTier = args.catalystTier local inputCurrent = tonumber(args.inputCurrent) or 1 local inputVoltage = args.inputVoltage local inputCatayst = tonumber(args.inputCatayst) or 0 local response = calculate(totalEu, basicVoltage, catalystTier, inputCurrent, inputVoltage, inputCatayst) return "
" .. mw.text.jsonEncode(response) .. "
" end return p 复制展开

title: 模块_Calculator_进阶装配线
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:Calculator/进阶装配线/doc创建 local p = {} -- ========== 千分位格式化 ========== local function addThousands(intStr) local sign = "" local s = intStr if s:sub(1, 1) == "-" then sign = "-" s = s:sub(2) end local out = s while true do local n2, k = out:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") out = n2 if k == 0 then break end end return sign .. out end local function fmtInt(v) local n = tonumber(v) or 0 -- 用 %.0f 展开完整十进制，避免 tostring 在数值过大时输出科学计数法 return addThousands(string.format("%.0f", math.floor(n + 0.5))) end local function fmt2(v) local n = tonumber(v) or 0 local rounded = math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100 local intPart, fracPart = string.format("%.2f", rounded):match("^([%-]?%d+)%.(%d%d)$") return addThousands(intPart) .. "." .. fracPart end local function fmt4(v) local n = tonumber(v) or 0 local rounded = math.floor(n * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000 local intPart, fracPart = string.format("%.4f", rounded):match("^([%-]?%d+)%.(%d%d%d%d)$") return addThousands(intPart) .. "." .. fracPart end -- 去掉小数末尾的 0（"0.40" → "0.4"，"5.00" → "5"） local function trimZeros(s) s = s:gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1") s = s:gsub("%.$", "") return s end -- ========== 时间单位：tick / s（对应模板 form-config 的 time_unit 选项）========== local function normalize_time_unit(raw) local s = tostring(raw or 'tick'):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') if s == 's' or s == '秒' then return 's' end return 'tick' end -- ========== 电压等级（本维基约定：UXV = 536,870,912，MAX = 2^31）========== local TIER = { 'ULV', 'LV', 'MV', 'HV', 'EV', 'IV', 'LuV', 'ZPM', 'UV', 'UHV', 'UEV', 'UIV', 'UMV', 'UXV', 'MAX' } local VOLT = { 8, 32, 128, 512, 2048, 8192, 32768, 131072, 524288, 2097152, 8388608, 33554432, 134217728, 536870912, 2147483648, } -- 能源仓等级选项 -> 电压表下标（本表不含基础 ULV=8） local HATCH_INDEX = { LV = 2, MV = 3, HV = 4, EV = 5, IV = 6, LuV = 7, ZPM = 8, UV = 9, UHV = 10, UEV = 11, UIV = 12, UMV = 13, UXV = 14, MAX = 15, } -- 配方基础电压等级：取第一个 ≥ 功率的电压等级（GTNH getTierOf 规则） local function tierOf(power) for i, v in ipairs(VOLT) do if power <= v then return i end end return #VOLT end -- 激光超频功率倍率：第 n 次 ×(4+0.3n) local function laserMult(N) local m = 1 for k = 1, N do m = m * (4 + 0.3 * k) end return m end -- 半衰减 k 次后的单片耗时（tick）：≥1t 时按游戏取整，<1t 返回小数（1toc 参考） local function durAt(T0, k) local d = T0 / (2 ^ k) if d >= 1 then return math.max(1, math.floor(d)) else return d end end local function buildResponse(result) local parts = {} table.insert(parts, '
') for key, value in pairs(result) do local displayValue = (type(value) == 'table') and mw.text.jsonEncode(value) or tostring(value) table.insert(parts, string.format('
%s
', key, displayValue)) end table.insert(parts, '
') return table.concat(parts, '\n') end function p.calculate(frame) local P0 = tonumber(frame.args['power']) or 0 local T0in = tonumber(frame.args['duration']) or 0 local L = tonumber(frame.args['pieces']) or 1 local hatch = tostring(frame.args['hatch'] or '') local mode = tostring(frame.args['mode'] or '') local targetTin = tonumber(frame.args['target_time']) or 0 local currentIn = tonumber(frame.args['current_in']) or 0 -- 输入框按计算模式互斥显示：模式1(超频到设定值所需的电流)显示目标耗时、模式2(输入功率计算最终耗时)显示输入电流 local showTargetTime = (mode ~= '输入功率计算最终耗时') local target_time_style = { display = showTargetTime and "block" or "none" } local current_in_style = { display = showTargetTime and "none" or "block" } -- 时间单位：tick / s（配方耗时固定为秒，仅目标耗时与单片耗时按所选单位计） local tu = normalize_time_unit(frame.args['time_unit']) local unitLabel = (tu == 's') and 's' or 'tick' local tMult = (tu == 's') and 20 or 1 local T0t = T0in * 20 -- 配方耗时固定为秒 → tick local targetTt = targetTin * tMult -- 目标耗时（tick） local Tbase = math.floor(T0t / L) -- 单片基础耗时 = 配方耗时 ÷ 片数（向下取整） if Tbase < 1 then Tbase = 1 end local function fmtDur(dur) if dur >= 1 then if tu == 's' then return trimZeros(fmt2(dur / 20)) .. ' 秒' else return fmtInt(dur) .. ' tick' end else -- 小于 1t（1tOC 区域）：保留更多小数位 if tu == 's' then return trimZeros(fmt4(dur / 20)) .. ' 秒' else return trimZeros(fmt4(dur)) .. ' tick' end end end local function err(msg) local result = { status_info = '' .. msg .. '', current_info = "-", current_input_info = "-", current_drawn_info = "-", lossy_info = "-", laser_info = "-", piece_power_info = "-", total_power_info = "-", duration_info = "-", toc_info = "-", run_tier_info = "-", unit_label_info = unitLabel, current_required_style = { display = "table-row" }, current_input_style = { display = "none" }, current_drawn_style = { display = "none" }, toc_style = { display = "none" }, target_time_style = target_time_style, current_in_style = current_in_style, } return buildResponse(result) end -- 参数校验 if not HATCH_INDEX[hatch] then return err('请选择有效的能源仓等级') end if P0 <= 0 or T0t <= 0 then return err('配方功率与配方耗时需大于 0') end if L < 1 then return err('配方片数需 ≥ 1') end local hatchIdx = HATCH_INDEX[hatch] local VH = VOLT[hatchIdx] local recipeIdx = tierOf(P0) local V0 = VOLT[recipeIdx] local tierGap = hatchIdx - recipeIdx if tierGap < 0 then return err('配方电压等级（' .. TIER[recipeIdx] .. '）高于能源仓（' .. TIER[hatchIdx] .. '），无法执行') end local n_oc, N, dur, mode2 if mode == '输入功率计算最终耗时' then -- ========== 模式2：输入电流 → 最终耗时 ========== if currentIn <= 0 then return err('输入电流需大于 0') end local perPieceAvail = VH * currentIn / L if perPieceAvail < P0 then return err('单片分到的功率（' .. fmt2(perPieceAvail) .. ' EU/t）不足配方基础功率（' .. fmtInt(P0) .. ' EU/t），无法开始工作') end -- 先有损超频到仓电压（受功率限制，可越过 1t 触发 1tOC） local kPower = math.floor(math.log(perPieceAvail / P0) / math.log(4)) n_oc = math.min(tierGap, kPower) if n_oc < 0 then n_oc = 0 end -- 多余功率再激光超频（可越过 1t 触发 1tOC） local PLossy = P0 * (4 ^ n_oc) N = 0 while true do local nN = N + 1 if PLossy * laserMult(nN) > perPieceAvail then break end N = nN end dur = durAt(Tbase, n_oc + N) mode2 = true else -- ========== 模式1：目标耗时 → 所需电流 ========== if targetTt <= 0 then return err('目标耗时需大于 0') end local k if targetTt >= 1 then -- 找最小半衰减次数使单片耗时 ≤ 目标（无需越过 1t） k = 0 while durAt(Tbase, k) > targetTt do k = k + 1 if k > 64 then break end end else -- 目标小于 1t：继续半衰减并触发 1tOC k = math.ceil(math.log(Tbase / targetTt) / math.log(2)) k = math.max(k, 0) end -- 先有损后激光（损失超频电流更省，尽可能多用） n_oc = math.min(tierGap, k) N = k - n_oc dur = durAt(Tbase, n_oc + N) mode2 = false end -- ========== 汇总 ========== local m = laserMult(N) local perPiecePower = P0 * (4 ^ n_oc) * m local totalPower = L * perPiecePower local requiredCurrent = totalPower / VH local runIdx = recipeIdx + n_oc local runVolt = VOLT[runIdx] -- 1tOC 补偿倍率（单片耗时 < 1t 时触发） local tocMult = nil if dur < 1 then tocMult = math.ceil(1 / dur) end -- 单片耗时显示（按所选时间单位） local durText = fmtDur(dur) -- 状态提示 local status = '' local statusClass = 'calc-num-success' if dur < 1 then status = '已触发 1tOC：单片耗时 ' .. fmtDur(dur) .. '，实际以 1 tick 执行配方并补偿并行 ×' .. fmtInt(tocMult) .. '。' statusClass = 'calc-num-warning' elseif mode2 and requiredCurrent < currentIn then status = '实际消耗 ' .. fmt2(requiredCurrent) .. ' A，输入电流富余 ' .. fmt2(currentIn - requiredCurrent) .. ' A。' statusClass = 'calc-num-neutral' end local result = { status_info = (status ~= '') and ('' .. status .. '') or '', current_info = fmt2(requiredCurrent), current_input_info = fmt2(currentIn), current_drawn_info = fmt2(requiredCurrent), lossy_info = fmtInt(n_oc), laser_info = fmtInt(N), piece_power_info = fmtInt(perPiecePower), total_power_info = fmtInt(totalPower), duration_info = durText, toc_info = tocMult and ('×' .. fmtInt(tocMult)) or '-', unit_label_info = unitLabel, run_tier_info = TIER[runIdx] .. '（' .. fmtInt(runVolt) .. ' V）', -- 行显示切换 current_required_style = (not mode2) and { display = "table-row" } or { display = "none" }, current_input_style = mode2 and { display = "table-row" } or { display = "none" }, current_drawn_style = mode2 and { display = "table-row" } or { display = "none" }, toc_style = (dur < 1) and { display = "table-row" } or { display = "none" }, -- 输入框显示切换：目标耗时（模式1）↔ 输入电流（模式2） target_time_style = target_time_style, current_in_style = current_in_style, } return buildResponse(result) end return p 复制展开
