此模块的文档可以在模块:Grid/AllAspectCombination/doc创建 local p = {} local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs -- 默认布局配置项 (可以通过传入模板的 args 覆盖) local DEFAULT_CONFIG = { slotSize = 36, -- Grid/Item 标准格位宽/高 arrowWidth = 40, -- 进度条(箭头)宽度 unitGap = 4, -- 单元内，组件之间的横向空隙 rowGap = 6, -- 列内，上下两个合成单元之间的行间距 colGap = 20, -- Chunk 内，列与列之间的横向空隙 labelSpace = 24, -- 每列顶部留给 "Lv X" 标签的高度 chunkGap = 30, -- 大块换行时，上一个 Chunk 和下一个 Chunk 之间的纵向间距 maxRowsPerCol = 10, -- 一列最多排布的合成行数 maxColsPerRow = 6, -- 一行(Chunk)最多排布几列，超出则大换行 pieSize = 32, -- 分解饼图大小 } local PRIMAL_ORDER = {"Aer", "Terra", "Ignis", "Aqua", "Ordo", "Perditio"} local PRIMAL_COLORS = { Aer = "#ffff7e", -- 黄 Terra = "#56c000", -- 绿 Ignis = "#ff3c01", -- 红 Aqua = "#3cd4fc", -- 蓝 Ordo = "#d5d4ec", -- 白/浅灰 Perditio = "#444444" -- 深灰 } -- 递归计算组合成分（在 getAspectData 中调用） local function getCompositionMap(parsedRecipes) local composition = { Aer = {Aer=true}, Terra = {Terra=true}, Ignis = {Ignis=true}, Aqua = {Aqua=true}, Ordo = {Ordo=true}, Perditio = {Perditio=true} } local changed = true while changed do changed = false for _, r in ipairs(parsedRecipes) do if not composition[r.out] and composition[r.in1] and composition[r.in2] then local combined = {} for k in pairs(composition[r.in1]) do combined[k] = true end for k in pairs(composition[r.in2]) do combined[k] = true end composition[r.out] = combined changed = true end end end return composition end -- 获取原始神秘要素组合数据并计算 Level (模拟构建DAG) local function getAspectData() -- 1. 尝试从数据库获取 JSON local pipeline = { { ["$match"] = { ["_id"] = "Data:Recipes/Thaumcraft/AspectCombinationHandler_null.json" } }, -- 【修改点 2】：参考你的范例，直接在管道中将 recipes 展开并提权为根节点 { ["$unwind"] = "$recipes" }, { ["$replaceRoot"] = { ["newRoot"] = "$recipes" } } } -- 此时 rawRecipes 已经是一个纯粹的配方数组了 local rawRecipes = mw.huiji.db.aggregate(pipeline) if type(rawRecipes) ~= "table" then rawRecipes = {} end -- mw.logObject(rawRecipes) local baseAspects = {"Aer", "Perditio", "Ignis", "Ordo", "Aqua", "Terra"} local levels = {} for _, aspect in ipairs(baseAspects) do levels[aspect] = 1 end local parsedRecipes = {} -- 2. 解析 JSON 里的配方结构 for _, r in ipairs(rawRecipes) do local in1, in2, out if r.inputAspects then local tempIns = {} for k, count in pairs(r.inputAspects) do for i = 1, count do table.insert(tempIns, k) end end in1 = tempIns[1] in2 = tempIns[2] or tempIns[1] -- 兼容需要2个相同要素的情况 end if r.outputAspects then for k, _ in pairs(r.outputAspects) do out = k break end end if in1 and in2 and out then table.insert(parsedRecipes, {in1 = in1, in2 = in2, out = out}) end end -- 3. DAG 层级计算 (Level = max(in1.lvl, in2.lvl) + 1) local changed = true while changed do changed = false for _, r in ipairs(parsedRecipes) do if not levels[r.out] and levels[r.in1] and levels[r.in2] then levels[r.out] = math.max(levels[r.in1], levels[r.in2]) + 1 changed = true end end end -- 4. 组装最终的分组数据 local grouped = {} local maxLevel = 1 -- 手动注入 Lv 1 (原始要素：空 + 空 -> 要素) grouped[1] = {} for _, aspect in ipairs(baseAspects) do table.insert(grouped[1], {in1 = nil, in2 = nil, out = aspect}) end -- 分配其它所有要素到对应 Level for _, r in ipairs(parsedRecipes) do local lvl = levels[r.out] or 99 if not grouped[lvl] then grouped[lvl] = {} end table.insert(grouped[lvl], r) if lvl > maxLevel and lvl < 99 then maxLevel = lvl end end local compMap = getCompositionMap(parsedRecipes) return grouped, maxLevel, compMap end function p.render(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) -- 初始化配置 (允许通过维基调用传参覆盖 DEFAULT_CONFIG) local conf = {} for k, v in pairs(DEFAULT_CONFIG) do conf[k] = tonumber(args[k]) or v end -- 单位宽高度预计算 local unitWidth = (conf.slotSize * 4) + conf.arrowWidth + (conf.unitGap * 4) local unitHeight = conf.slotSize + conf.rowGap local grouped, maxLevel, compMap = getAspectData() mw.logObject(grouped) -- 渲染状态和计数器 local gmpArgs = {} local gridContentTable = {} -- 必须保证全局递增的格位索引 local globalInputCounter = 1 local globalOutputCounter = 1 -- 用于计算最终的背景长宽 local maxGlobalRight = 0 local maxGlobalBottom = 0 -- 全局布局追踪指针 local absCol = 0 -- 当前处于整个图表的第几列 local rowInCol = 0 -- 当前列的第几行 -- 开始遍历 Level for lvl = 1, maxLevel do if grouped[lvl] and #grouped[lvl] > 0 then -- 为同一Level内的产物排序(字典序)，确保UI每次展示一致 table.sort(grouped[lvl], function(a, b) return a.out < b.out end) -- 逻辑：新的 Level 强制换到新的一列起步 if rowInCol > 0 then absCol = absCol + 1 rowInCol = 0 end for _, recipe in ipairs(grouped[lvl]) do -- 逻辑：如果当前列满了，自动开启下一列 if rowInCol >= conf.maxRowsPerCol then absCol = absCol + 1 rowInCol = 0 end -- 计算 Chunk 位置 (大组的行与列) local chunkRow = math.floor(absCol / conf.maxColsPerRow) local chunkCol = absCol % conf.maxColsPerRow -- 绝对坐标计算起点 local x0 = chunkCol * (unitWidth + conf.colGap) + 16 -- 16为左侧基础留白 local y0 = chunkRow * (conf.maxRowsPerCol * unitHeight + conf.labelSpace + conf.chunkGap) + conf.labelSpace + (rowInCol * unitHeight) + 16 -- 16为顶部基础留白 -- 如果是本列的第一行，插入 "Lv X" 的标识文字 if rowInCol == 0 then local labelTop = y0 - conf.labelSpace local labelStr = string.format('
Lv %d
', labelTop, x0, lvl) table.insert(gridContentTable, labelStr) end -- 单元内组件的相对坐标 local in1_x = x0 local in2_x = x0 + conf.slotSize + conf.unitGap local arrow_x = in2_x + conf.slotSize + conf.unitGap local out_x = arrow_x + conf.arrowWidth + conf.unitGap -- 更新背景的最大边界 maxGlobalRight = math.max(maxGlobalRight, out_x + conf.slotSize) maxGlobalBottom = math.max(maxGlobalBottom, y0 + conf.slotSize) -- 1. 挂载：源质输入 1 if recipe.in1 then gmpArgs["源质输入" .. globalInputCounter] = recipe.in1 end gmpArgs["源质输入" .. globalInputCounter .. "-top"] = y0 gmpArgs["源质输入" .. globalInputCounter .. "-left"] = in1_x globalInputCounter = globalInputCounter + 1 -- 2. 挂载：源质输入 2 if recipe.in2 then gmpArgs["源质输入" .. globalInputCounter] = recipe.in2 end gmpArgs["源质输入" .. globalInputCounter .. "-top"] = y0 gmpArgs["源质输入" .. globalInputCounter .. "-left"] = in2_x globalInputCounter = globalInputCounter + 1 -- 3. 挂载：源质输出 1 gmpArgs["源质输出" .. globalOutputCounter] = recipe.out gmpArgs["源质输出" .. globalOutputCounter .. "-top"] = y0 gmpArgs["源质输出" .. globalOutputCounter .. "-left"] = out_x globalOutputCounter = globalOutputCounter + 1 -- 4. 挂载：中间的箭头 ProgressBar (使用 disable 静止动画) local arrowStr = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grid/ProgressBar', args = { 'arrow', width = tostring(conf.arrowWidth), height = tostring(conf.slotSize), top = tostring(y0), left = tostring(arrow_x), direction = 'disable' } } table.insert(gridContentTable, arrowStr) -- 饼图 local comp = compMap[recipe.out] or {} -- 1. 定义配置 local pie_x = out_x + conf.slotSize + conf.unitGap local baseSize = conf.pieSize -- 原本的大小 (如 32) local burstSize = baseSize + 8 -- 突出层的大小 (如 40) local offset = (burstSize - baseSize) / 2 -- 为了居中需要的偏移量 -- 2. 准备底层（突出层） local backgroundLayer = "" if comp["Perditio"] then -- 只在 300deg 到 360deg 渲染 Perditio 的颜色，其余全透明 local bgGradient = string.format("transparent 300deg, %s 300deg 360deg", PRIMAL_COLORS["Perditio"]) backgroundLayer = string.format( '
', y0 - offset, pie_x - offset, burstSize, burstSize, bgGradient ) end -- 3. 准备顶层（主饼图） local segments = {} for i, primal in ipairs(PRIMAL_ORDER) do local color = comp[primal] and PRIMAL_COLORS[primal] or "rgba(20,20,20,0.8)" table.insert(segments, string.format("%s %ddeg %ddeg", color, (i-1)*60, i*60)) end local mainLayer = string.format( '
', recipe.out, y0, pie_x, baseSize, baseSize, table.concat(segments, ", ") ) -- 4. 组合并插入 table.insert(gridContentTable, backgroundLayer .. mainLayer) maxGlobalRight = math.max(maxGlobalRight, pie_x + conf.slotSize) rowInCol = rowInCol + 1 end end end -- 封装给 GeneralMachineProcess 模板的环境参数 gmpArgs["title"] = args["title"] or "要素合成总览" gmpArgs["link"] = args["link"] or "神秘时代" gmpArgs["not-gt"] = "1" gmpArgs["autogen"] = "1" -- 动态设定机器 UI 界面的宽与高（预留 20px 右/下边距） gmpArgs["width"] = tostring(maxGlobalRight + 20) gmpArgs["panel-height"] = tostring(maxGlobalBottom + 20) -- 合并所有手搓的 HTML 与模板生成代码 gmpArgs["grid-content"] = table.concat(gridContentTable, "\n") -- 调用 GMP return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grid/GeneralMachineProcess', args = gmpArgs } end return p 复制展开

local p = {}
-- 计算 Top 坐标
function p.calculatePositionTop(frame)
local args = frame:getParent().args
local index = tonumber(frame.args[1]) or 1 -- 从模板传入的序号
local count = tonumber(frame.args[2])
if count <= 0 or index > count or index <= 0 then
return ''
end
if index == 1 then
return 176;
end
-- 计算弧度：(index/count) * 2 * PI
local angle = ((index - 2) / (count - 1)) * 2 * math.pi
-- math.sin 在 Lua 中使用弧度制
local result = 176 - 90 * math.cos(angle)
return string.format("%.2f", result) -- 保留两位小数
end
-- 计算 Left 坐标
function p.calculatePositionLeft(frame)
local args = frame:getParent().args
local index = tonumber(frame.args[1]) or 1
local count = tonumber(frame.args[2])
if count <= 0 or index > count or index <= 0 then
return ''
end
if index == 1 then
return 170 - 16;
end
local angle = ((index - 2) / (count - 1)) * 2 * math.pi
-- 使用 cos 来配合 sin 形成圆形布局
local result = 170 - 16 + 90 * math.sin(angle)
return string.format("%.2f", result)
end
function p.getSourcePosition(index, count)
local item_width = 41
local items_per_row = 6
local centerX = 170 - 16 -- 居中点的基准 X 坐标
-- 1. 确定所在的行和在该行中的位置
-- row 从 0 开始，col 从 0 到 5
local row = math.floor((index - 1) / items_per_row)
local col = (index - 1) % items_per_row
-- 2. 计算当前行共有多少个元素 (用于计算该行的居中偏移)
local current_row_count
local total_rows = math.ceil(count / items_per_row)
if row < total_rows - 1 then
-- 如果不是最后一行，该行肯定是满的（6个）
current_row_count = items_per_row
else
-- 如果是最后一行，计算剩余的元素数量
current_row_count = count % items_per_row
if current_row_count == 0 then current_row_count = items_per_row end
end
-- 3. 计算 X 坐标
-- 计算该行总宽度的一半，以此算出起始左边界
local row_total_width = current_row_count * item_width
local start_x = centerX - (row_total_width / 2)
-- index 对应的坐标是左边界 + 半个元素的宽度 (即中心点)
local x = start_x + (col * item_width) + (item_width / 2)
-- 4. 计算 Y 坐标
-- 第一行 (row=0) 是 40，以后每行增加 36 (76, 112...)
local y = 352 + (row * 36)
return x, y
end
function p.calculateSourcePositionLeft(frame)
local args = frame:getParent().args
local index = tonumber(frame.args[1]) or 1
local count = tonumber(frame.args[2])
if index > count then return "" end
local x, y = p.getSourcePosition(index, count)
return x
end
function p.calculateSourcePositionTop(frame)
local args = frame:getParent().args
local index = tonumber(frame.args[1]) or 1
local count = tonumber(frame.args[2])
if index > count then return "" end
local x, y = p.getSourcePosition(index, count)
return y
end
return p

local row_width = maxIndex > 81 and 27 or 9

for i = 1, totalSlots do

end
return args

end

-- 假设这些函数在 Lua 中直接返回数值/字符串

'hammer',

-- 返回绘图结果

}

local p = {}

function p.getParentSerializedArgs(frame)
-- 按长度前缀序列化，在 模块:Grid/GeneralMachineProcessPlotter:deserializeArguments 解序列化。
t = frame:getParent().args
local chunks = {}
for k, v in pairs(t) do
-- 格式: 长度k:key内容 长度v:value内容
-- 例如: 3:age2:25 代表["age"]="25"
table.insert(chunks, #tostring(k) .. ":" .. tostring(k))
table.insert(chunks, #tostring(v) .. ":" .. tostring(v))
end
return table.concat(chunks)
end
function p.countItemInputs(frame)
local args = frame:getParent().args
local i = 1
local lastValid = 0
while true do
local paramName = "固体输入" .. i
local paramName1 = "固体输入" .. i.. "-1"
local value = args[paramName] or args[paramName1]
-- 检查参数是否存在且不为空字符串
if value and value ~= "" then
lastValid = i
i = i + 1
else
-- 发现空参数或不存在的参数，停止循环
break
end
end
return lastValid
end
function p.countSourceInputs(frame)
local args = frame:getParent().args
local i = 1
local lastValid = 0
while true do
local paramName = "源质输入" .. i
local value = args[paramName]
-- 检查参数是否存在且不为空字符串
if value and value ~= "" then
lastValid = i
i = i + 1
else
-- 发现空参数或不存在的参数，停止循环
break
end
end
return lastValid
end
-- 辅助函数：尝试获取参数，如果子参数为空，则回退到父参数
local function getArg(args, subPrefix, parentPrefix, suffix)
local val = args[subPrefix .. suffix]
if val == nil or val == "" then
val = args[parentPrefix .. suffix]
end
return val or ""
end
-- 纯 Lua 槽位渲染：
-- 旧逻辑每个槽位都 expandTemplate('Grid/ItemWithSlot')，这里改为直接调用模块函数，
-- 避免模板展开开销在大配方场景（如 200+ 槽位）累积。
local function getSlotTemplate(prefix, parentPrefix, type, args, relative, sync)
local topValue = tonumber(getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-top")) or 0
local baseName = args[prefix] or args[parentPrefix] or ""
local name, imageName
if type == "source" then
name = (baseName ~= "") and ("要素 " .. baseName) or ""
imageName = name
else
name = baseName
local imgArg = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-图片")
imageName = (imgArg ~= "") and imgArg or name
end
-- 通用参数定义
local templateArgs = {
name = name or "",
key = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-key"),
dataVersion = args.version,
image = imageName or "",
framecount = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-帧长"),
framesize = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-帧大小"),
link = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-链接"),
dict = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-矿辞"),
chance = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-几率"),
NC = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-不消耗"),
originalName = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-原名"),
mod = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-模组"),
extra = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-extra"),
tooltext = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-tooltips"),
tooltipsShift = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-tooltipsShift"),
tooltipsCtrl = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-tooltipsCtrl"),
tooltipsShiftAndCtrl = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-tooltipsShiftAndCtrl"),
aspect = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-aspect"),
overlay = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-overlay"),
slotscale = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-slotscale"),
slotless =(args[prefix .. "-slotless"] or args[parentPrefix .. "-slotless"] or args["slotless"]) and '1' or '',
["sync-tooltips-rendering"] = sync and 1 or "",
lang = args.lang
}
if relative then
templateArgs["top"] = tostring(topValue)
templateArgs["left"] = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-left")
else
templateArgs["top"] = 2
templateArgs["left"] = 2
end
-- decode JSON 字符串的 aspect
if templateArgs.aspect and templateArgs.aspect ~= "" then
templateArgs.aspect = mw.text.jsonDecode(templateArgs.aspect)
end
-- 根据类型动态分配 固体(amount) 或 流体(liquid) 字段
if type == "fluid" then
local amount = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-数量")
templateArgs["liquid"] = (amount ~= "" and amount or "") .. "L"
else
templateArgs["amount"] = getArg(args, prefix, parentPrefix, "-数量")
end
-- 直接调用 Module:Grid/Item 的 Lua API，输出与模板 Grid/ItemWithSlot 等价。
return ItemRenderer.renderItemWithSlotByArgs(templateArgs)
end
function p.renderSlots(frame)
local args = {}
local parentArgs = frame:getParent().args
for k, v in pairs(parentArgs) do
args[k] = v
end
-- 0. 应用预定义的样式缩写 --

if pattern and pattern ~= "" then
-- 3调用你之前编写的函数获取布局字典

args[key] = value

-- 兼容旧参数......
-- 1. 简写与旧参数映射表
local aliases = {
-- 简写 -> 标准化名称 (对应 固体输入1/固体输出1/流体输入1)
["输入"] = "固体输入1",

["流体输入"] = "流体输入1",
["流体输出"] = "流体输出1",
}
-- 2. 处理“输入x” -> “固体输入x” 的批量映射
-- 我们先处理这些特殊的简写
for alias, official in pairs(aliases) do
if (args[alias] and args[alias] ~= "") and (not args[official] or args[official] == "") then
args[official] = args[alias]
-- 同时也要搬运相关的后缀参数，例如“输入-数量” -> “固体输入1-数量”
local suffixes = {"-top", "-left", "-图片", "-链接", "-矿辞", "-几率", "-不消耗", "-数量", "-overlay", "-slotscale"}
for _, s in ipairs(suffixes) do
if args[alias .. s] and (not args[official .. s] or args[official .. s] == "") then
args[official .. s] = args[alias .. s]
end
end
end
end
-- 3. 处理数字索引映射：“输入2” -> “固体输入2”
-- 以及 “输出5” -> “固体输出5”
local prefixMap = {
["输入"] = "固体输入",
["输出"] = "固体输出"
}
for i = 1, 243 do
for short, long in pairs(prefixMap) do
local oldBase = short .. i
local newBase = long .. i
-- 如果“输入2”存在且“固体输入2”不存在，则覆盖
if args[oldBase] and args[oldBase] ~= "" then
if not args[newBase] or args[newBase] == "" then
args[newBase] = args[oldBase]
-- 搬运相关后缀
local suffixes = {"-top", "-left", "-图片", "-链接", "-矿辞", "-几率", "-不消耗", "-数量", "-overlay", "-slotscale"}
for _, s in ipairs(suffixes) do
if args[oldBase .. s] and (not args[newBase .. s] or args[newBase .. s] == "") then
args[newBase .. s] = args[oldBase .. s]
end
end
end
end
end
end
-- 兼容参数后的正式逻辑
local results = {}
-- 定义需要遍历的所有类型
-- 格式：{前缀, 是否为流体}
local types = {
{"固体输入", "item"},
{"固体输出", "item"},
{"流体输入", "fluid"},
{"流体输出", "fluid"},
{"源质输入", "source"},
{"源质输出", "source"}
}
-- 生成随机哈希
local instanceHash = mw.hash.hashValue('crc32', tostring(math.random()) .. tostring(os.clock()))
local sync = args["sync-tooltips-rendering"] and true or false
for _, config in ipairs(types) do
local prefixBase = config[1]
local type = config[2]
for i = 1, 243 do
local prefix = prefixBase .. i
-- 检查该组参数是否存在
if args[prefix .. "-top"] and args[prefix .. "-top"] ~= "" then
local length = tonumber(args[prefix .. "-length"])
if length and length > 1 then
-- 利用 instanceHash 和当前的循环变量 prefix 构造唯一的 ID
local uniqueCarouselId = "slot-carousel-" .. instanceHash .. "-" .. prefix
-- 创建轮播容器
local carouselDiv = mw.html.create('div')
:addClass('carousel')
:attr('id', uniqueCarouselId)
:attr('data-ride', 'carousel')
:attr('data-interval', '1000')
:attr('data-pause', 'false')
:css('width', '36px')
:css('height', '36px')
-- 这里的坐标也要应用到容器上，确保容器定位正确
:css('position', 'absolute')
:css('top', (tonumber(args[prefix .. "-top"]) or 0) -2 .. 'px')
:css('left', (tonumber(args[prefix .. "-left"]) or 0) -2 .. 'px')
local innerDiv = carouselDiv:tag('div')
:addClass('carousel-inner')
:css('width', '100%')
:css('height', '100%')
:css('z-index', '4')
for j = 1, length do
local subPrefix = prefix .. "-" .. j
-- 传入 subPrefix 和 parentPrefix (prefix)
local itemHtml = getSlotTemplate(subPrefix, prefix, type, args, false, sync)
local itemWrapper = innerDiv:tag('div')
:addClass('item')
:node(itemHtml)
if j == 1 then itemWrapper:addClass('active') end
end
table.insert(results, tostring(carouselDiv))
else
-- 普通槽位：subPrefix 和 parentPrefix 传同一个即可
table.insert(results, getSlotTemplate(prefix, prefix, type, args, true, sync))
end
end
end
end
return table.concat(results)
end
return p

title: 模块_Grid_GeneralMachineProcessPlotter
text:
为了传递参数，对模板:Grid/GeneralMachineProcess的包装。
local p = {}
function p.deserializeArguments(s)
-- 解除参数的序列化 序列化源于 模块:Grid/GeneralMachineProcess:getParentSerializedArgs
-- 调试示例=mw.dumpObject(p.deserializeArguments("5:name=8:John\nDoe11:complex:key26:value_with_#%&*!@ symbols"))
local t = {}
if type(s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return t end
local i = 1
local len = #s
while i <= len do
-- 使用 () 捕获匹配到的结束位置
-- ^ 在起始位置匹配 数字 接着一个 冒号
local lenK_str, pos_after_colon = s:match("^(%d+):()", i)
if not lenK_str then break end
local lenK = tonumber(lenK_str)
i = pos_after_colon -- 更新 i 到冒号之后的位置
local k = s:sub(i, i + lenK - 1)
i = i + lenK
-- 解析 Value
local lenV_str, pos_after_colon_v = s:match("^(%d+):()", i)
if not lenV_str then break end
local lenV = tonumber(lenV_str)
i = pos_after_colon_v
local v = s:sub(i, i + lenV - 1)
i = i + lenV
t[k] = v
end
return t
end
function p.plot(frame)
local args = frame.args
local parentArgs = p.deserializeArguments(args.parentSerializedArgs)
for k, v in pairs(args) do
parentArgs[k] = v
end
return frame:expandTemplate{
title = 'Grid/GeneralMachineProcess',
args = parentArgs
}
end
return p

Point: 坐标载体 ]] local Point = {} Point.__index = Point function Point.new(pxX, pxY) return setmetatable({ pxX = pxX, pxY = pxY }, Point) end function Point:unpack() return self.pxX, self.pxY end -- [[ 3. Grid: 布局与坐标转换逻辑 ]] local Grid = {} -- 获取指定网格的左上角像素坐标 function Grid.grid(gridX, gridY) local pxX = (gridX * 12 + CONFIG.GRID_OFFSET) * 2 - 18 local pxY = (gridY * 12 + CONFIG.GRID_OFFSET) * 2 - 18 return Point.new(pxX, pxY) end -- 获取指定网格的几何中心点 function Grid.center(gridX, gridY) local p = Grid.grid(gridX, gridY) return Point.new(p.pxX + 18, p.pxY + 18) end -- 获取指定网格边缘的像素坐标 (用于连线对接) function Grid.edge(gridX, gridY, dir) local cp = Grid.center(gridX, gridY) local x, y = cp:unpack() if dir == "N" then y = y - 18 elseif dir == "S" then y = y + 18 elseif dir == "W" then x = x - 18 elseif dir == "E" then x = x + 18 end return Point.new(x, y) end -- [[ 4. LinesBuilder: 像素级路径绘制引擎 ]] local LinesBuilder = {} LinesBuilder.__index = LinesBuilder -- 设置起始点 function LinesBuilder.new(startPoint) local self = setmetatable({}, LinesBuilder) self.curr = startPoint self.html = "" return self end -- 只移动笔尖，但是不绘制 function LinesBuilder:move(point) self.curr = point return self end -- 绘制一条从当前点到参数点的直线 function LinesBuilder:lineTo(point) local p1, p2 = self.curr, point local left, top = math.min(p1.pxX, p2.pxX), math.min(p1.pxY, p2.pxY) local width, height = math.abs(p2.pxX - p1.pxX), math.abs(p2.pxY - p1.pxY) local offset = CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH / 2 if width == 0 then width, left, top = CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH, left - CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH, top - CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH height = height + CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH elseif height == 0 then height, top, left = CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH, top - CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH, left - CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH width = width + CONFIG.LINE_WIDTH end self.html = self.html .. string.format( '
', left, top, width, height ) self.curr = point return self end -- 绘制一条从当前点到参数点的直线，并在末尾添加箭头 function LinesBuilder:addArrow(point) local p1, p2 = self.curr, point local dx, dy = p2.pxX - p1.pxX, p2.pxY - p1.pxY local moveDir = (math.abs(dy) > math.abs(dx)) and ((dy > 0) and "S" or "N") or ((dx > 0) and "E" or "W") self:lineTo(point) local borderStyle, finalT, finalL = "", 0, 0 local s, w = CONFIG.ARROW_SIZE, CONFIG.ARROW_WIDTH local pxX, pxY = p2:unpack() if moveDir == "S" then borderStyle = string.format("border-top: %dpx solid #444; margin-left: -%dpx;", s, w) finalT, finalL = pxY - s, pxX elseif moveDir == "N" then borderStyle = string.format("border-bottom: %dpx solid #444; margin-left: -%dpx;", s, w) finalT, finalL = pxY - s, pxX elseif moveDir == "E" then borderStyle = string.format("border-left: %dpx solid #444; margin-top: -%dpx;", s, w) finalL, finalT = pxX - s, pxY elseif moveDir == "W" then borderStyle = string.format("border-right: %dpx solid #444; margin-top: -%dpx;", s, w) finalL, finalT = pxX, pxY end self.html = self.html .. string.format( '
', finalL - 2, finalT, w, borderStyle ) return self end -- [[ 5. Component: 渲染辅助函数 ]] local Component = {} function Component.renderSlot(frame, res, point, options) options = options or {} local pxX, pxY = point:unpack() -- 旧逻辑是展开模板 Grid/ItemWithSlot；新逻辑直接调用模块函数。 -- 参数字段保持一致，确保显示与旧模板输出语义一致。 return ItemRenderer.renderItemWithSlotByArgs({ ["top"] = pxY, ["left"] = pxX, ["name"] = res and res.translatedName or options.fallbackName or "", ["amount"] = options.amount or 1, ["chance"] = (options.chance and options.chance > 0) and string.format("%.2f", options.chance / 100) or nil, ["originalName"] = res and res.originalName, ["tooltext"] = res and res.tooltips, ["mod"] = res and res.mod, ["liquid"] = options.liquid, ["slotscale"] = options.slotscale }) end -- 处理特殊情况：缺失数据时直接通过材料名构造矿石图 function Component.renderOreSlotByMaterialName(frame, materialName, point) local pxX, pxY = point:unpack() return ItemRenderer.renderItemWithSlotByArgs({ ["name"] = materialName .. "矿石", ["top"] = pxY, ["left"] = pxX, ["slotscale"] = "large" }) end -- 以 (gridX, gridY) 为基准，沿着 dir 方向绘制宽为width高为height的多个连续slot, 最多绘制forceSize个slot. function Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, items, gridX, gridY, width, height, dir, queryResults, forceSize) local dirFactors = { N = {x = 0, y = -1}, S = {x = 0, y = 1}, E = {x = 1, y = 0}, W = {x = -1, y = 0} } local df = dirFactors[dir] or {x = 1, y = 1} local offsetPxX = (df.x - 1) * (width - 1) * CONFIG.SLOT_SIZE / 2 local offsetPxY = (df.y - 1) * (height - 1) * CONFIG.SLOT_SIZE / 2 local baseP = Grid.grid(gridX, gridY) local html = "" local maxIdx = forceSize or (width * height) -- 无论slotgroup的拓展方向如何，从上到下从左到右绘制格子内物品 for j = 0, height - 1 do for i = 0, width - 1 do local idx = i + j * width + 1 if idx <= maxIdx then local item = items and items[idx] local res = queryResults[item and (item.key or item)] local drawP = Point.new(baseP.pxX + offsetPxX + i * CONFIG.SLOT_SIZE, baseP.pxY + offsetPxY + j * CONFIG.SLOT_SIZE) html = html .. Component.renderSlot(frame, res, drawP, { amount = item and item.amount, chance = item and item.chance, liquid = item and item.liquid }) end end end return html end -- 特殊处理：化学浸洗槽（含流体） function Component.renderChemicalBathSlots(frame, recipe, gridX, gridY, dir, queryResults) local fluidKey = recipe.inputFluids and recipe.inputFluids[1] and recipe.inputFluids[1].key local cbItems = {{key = fluidKey, liquid = tostring(recipe.inputFluids[1].amount)}} if recipe.outputItems then for _, it in ipairs(recipe.outputItems) do table.insert(cbItems, it) end end return Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, cbItems, gridX, gridY, 1, 3, dir, queryResults) end -- [[ 6. 主渲染函数 ]] function p.render(frame, data, queryResults) if not data or not data.OreProcessing then return "未找到矿物处理数据。" end local linesLayer = "" local contentLayer = "" local proc = data.OreProcessing -- 助手：绘制机器 local function drawMachine(mKey, gridX, gridY) local p = Grid.grid(gridX, gridY) -- 机器图标同样改为模块直调，避免模板层跳转。 return ItemRenderer.renderByArgs({ ["name"] = MACHINE_NAME_MAP[string.upper(mKey)] or "铁块", ["top"] = p.pxY, ["left"] = p.pxX, ["size"] = 32 }) end ----------------------------------------------------------- -- [[ 逐个绘制可能的处理形态 ]] ----------------------------------------------------------- -- 1. 初始输入：矿石(4,2) 和 粗矿(6,2) local oreKey = data.OrePrefixes and data.OrePrefixes["ore"] if oreKey then local p = Grid.grid(4, 2) if queryResults[oreKey] then contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.renderSlot(frame, queryResults[oreKey], p, {slotscale = "large"}) else -- 数据库中缺失矿石数据，尝试构造图片名字直接显示 contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.renderOreSlotByMaterialName(frame, data.LocalizedName, p) end end -- 粗矿 local rawKey = data.OrePrefixes and data.OrePrefixes["rawOre"] if rawKey then contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.renderSlot(frame, queryResults[rawKey], Grid.grid(6, 2), {slotscale = "large"}) end -- 2. 粉碎机 A: 矿石 -> 粉碎的矿石 (4,2 -> 4,7) if proc.OreToCrushedMacerator then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(4, 2)):addArrow(Grid.edge(4, 7, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("MACERATOR", 4, 5) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.OreToCrushedMacerator[1].outputItems, 4, 7, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end -- 3. 粉碎机 B: 粗矿 -> 粉碎的矿石 (6,2 -> 6,7) -- 并在 (6,7) 汇合回 (4,7) 的逻辑线 if proc.RawOreToCrushedMacerator then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(6, 2)):addArrow(Grid.edge(6, 7, "N")).html linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(4, 7)):lineTo(Grid.center(6, 7)).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("MACERATOR", 6, 5) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.RawOreToCrushedMacerator[1].outputItems, 6, 7, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end -- 4. 洗矿厂: 粉碎的矿石 -> 洗净的矿石 (4,7 -> 8,10) if proc.CrushedToCrushedPurifiedOreWasher then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(4, 7)):lineTo(Grid.center(8, 7)):addArrow(Grid.edge(8, 10, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("ORE_WASHING_PLANT", 8, 8) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.CrushedToCrushedPurifiedOreWasher[1].outputItems, 8, 10, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end -- 5. 粉碎机：粉碎的矿石 -> 含杂粉 (4,7 -> 2,14) if proc.CrushedToDustImpureMacerator then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(4, 7)) :lineTo(Grid.center(3, 7)):lineTo(Grid.center(3, 10)) :lineTo(Grid.center(2, 10)):addArrow(Grid.edge(2, 14, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("MACERATOR", 2, 12) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.CrushedToDustImpureMacerator[1].outputItems, 2, 14, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end -- 6. 热力离心机：洗净的矿石 -> 离心矿石 (4,7/8,10 汇合 -> 6,14) if proc.CrushedPurifiedToCrushedCentrifugedThermalCentrifuge then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(4, 7)) :lineTo(Grid.center(5, 7)):lineTo(Grid.center(5, 12)):lineTo(Grid.center(7, 12)) :lineTo(Grid.center(7, 10)):lineTo(Grid.center(8, 10)):move(Grid.center(6, 12)) :addArrow(Grid.edge(6, 14, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("THERMAL_CENTRIFUGE", 6, 12) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.CrushedPurifiedToCrushedCentrifugedThermalCentrifuge[1].outputItems, 6, 14, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) -- 粉碎机 补充路径：离心矿石 -> 粉 (6,14 -> 4,16) if proc.CrushedCentrifugedToDustMacerator then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(6, 14)):lineTo(Grid.center(4, 14)):addArrow(Grid.edge(4, 16, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("MACERATOR", 4, 14) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.CrushedCentrifugedToDustMacerator[1].outputItems, 4, 16, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end end -- 7. 筛选机：洗净的矿石 -> 筛选 (8,10 -> 10,5) if proc.CrushedPurifiedToAnySifter then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(8, 10)):lineTo(Grid.center(10, 10)):addArrow(Grid.edge(10, 5, "S")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("SIFTER", 10, 8) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.CrushedPurifiedToAnySifter[1].outputItems, 10, 5, 3, 3, "N", queryResults) end -- 8. 粉碎机：洗净的矿石 -> 洁净粉 (8,10 -> 10,14) if proc.CrushedPurifiedToDustPureMacerator then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(8, 10)):lineTo(Grid.center(10, 10)):addArrow(Grid.edge(10, 14, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("MACERATOR", 10, 12) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.CrushedPurifiedToDustPureMacerator[1].outputItems, 10, 14, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) -- 离心机 补充路径：洁净粉 -> 粉 (10,14 -> 8,16) if proc.DustPureToDustCentrifuge then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(10, 14)):lineTo(Grid.center(8, 14)):addArrow(Grid.edge(8, 16, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("CENTRIFUGE", 8, 14) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.DustPureToDustCentrifuge[1].outputItems, 8, 16, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end end -- 9. 离心机：含杂粉 -> 粉 (2,14 -> 0,16) if proc.DustImpureToDustCentrifuge then linesLayer = linesLayer .. LinesBuilder.new(Grid.center(2, 14)):lineTo(Grid.center(0, 14)):addArrow(Grid.edge(0, 16, "N")).html contentLayer = contentLayer .. drawMachine("CENTRIFUGE", 0, 14) contentLayer = contentLayer .. Component.drawSlotGroup(frame, proc.DustImpureToDustCentrifuge[1].outputItems, 0, 16, 1, 2, "S", queryResults) end -

local p = {}
function p.getProgressLeft(frame)
return 148
end
function p.getProgressTop(frame)
return 38
end
local function split(inputstr, sep)
if sep == nil then sep = "-" end
local t = {}
for str in string.gmatch(inputstr, "([^" .. sep .. "]+)") do
table.insert(t, mw.text.trim(str))
end
return t
end
function p.getLeft(frame)
local offset = tonumber(frame.args[1]) or 0
return 28 + 36 * offset
end
function p.getTop(frame)
local args = frame.args
local offset = tonumber(args[1]) or 0
local style = args["style"] or "divided"
return 4 + 36 * offset + (style ~= "merged" and offset >= 3 and 6 or 0)
end
-- 辅助函数：定义不同数字对应的行列布局偏移
-- 以布局的“中心”为原点 (0,0)
local layoutConfig = {
[1] = {{x=0, y=0}},
[2] = {{x=-0.5, y=0}, {x=0.5, y=0}}, -- 1行2列
[3] = {{x=-1, y=0}, {x=0, y=0}, {x=1, y=0}}, -- 1行3列
[4] = { -- 2行2列
{x=-0.5, y=-0.5}, {x=0.5, y=-0.5},
{x=-0.5, y=0.5}, {x=0.5, y=0.5}
},
[6] = { -- 2行3列
{x=-1, y=-0.5}, {x=0, y=-0.5}, {x=1, y=-0.5},
{x=-1, y=0.5}, {x=0, y=0.5}, {x=1, y=0.5}
},
[9] = { -- 3行3列
{x=-1, y=-1}, {x=0, y=-1}, {x=1, y=-1},
{x=-1, y=0}, {x=0, y=0}, {x=1, y=0},
{x=-1, y=1}, {x=0, y=1}, {x=1, y=1}
}
}
-- 模拟原有的 getLeft 和 getTop 逻辑
-- local function getLeft(offset) return 28 + 36 * offset end
-- local function getTop(offset)
-- -- 简化的 getTop，保持与你提供的 offset 逻辑一致
-- return 4 + 36 * offset + (offset >= 3 and 6 or 0)
-- end
function generateExtremeCraftingTableLayout()
result = {}
for i = 1, 9 do
for j = 1, 9 do
k = (i - 1) * 9 + j
result['固体输入' .. k .. "-top"] = 36 * i
result['固体输入' .. k .. "-left"] = 36 * j - 30
end
end
result["固体输出1-top"] = 36 * 5
result["固体输出1-left"] = 402
return result
end
function p.generateLayout(pattern)
if pattern == "extreme-crafting-table" then
return generateExtremeCraftingTableLayout()
end
local style =string.find(pattern, "merged") ~= nil and "merged" or ""
local numPart = pattern:match("%d+")
local result = {}
local types = {"固体输入", "流体输入", "固体输出", "流体输出"}
-- 解析 pattern (例如 "6161")
local counts = {}
for char in numPart:gmatch("%d") do
table.insert(counts, tonumber(char))
end
-- 遍历四个分类
local centerY1 = counts[2] >=4 and 1 or 1.5
local centerY2 = counts[2] >=4 and 3 or 3.5
for i, count in ipairs(counts) do
local label = types[i]
local coords = layoutConfig[count]
-- 确定该组的中心参考点 (centerX, centerY)
local centerX, centerY
local maxW = (count == 3 or count == 6 or count == 9) and 3 or (count == 2 or count == 4) and 2 or 1
if i == 1 then -- 固体输入
centerX, centerY = 3 - (maxW / 2), centerY1 -- 右侧中点是3，中心减去半格
elseif i == 2 then -- 流体输入
centerX, centerY = 3 - (maxW / 2), centerY2
elseif i == 3 then -- 固体输出
centerX, centerY = 5 + (maxW / 2), centerY1
elseif i == 4 then -- 流体输出
centerX, centerY = 5 + (maxW / 2), centerY2
end
-- 计算组内每个小格的坐标
if coords then
for j, pos in ipairs(coords) do
local finalX = centerX + pos.x - 0.5
local finalY = centerY + pos.y - 0.5
result[label .. j .. "-top"] = p.getTop{args={finalY, style=style}}
-- result[label .. j .. "-top"] = finalY
result[label .. j .. "-left"] = p.getLeft{args={finalX, style=style}}
-- result[label .. j .. "-left"] = finalX
end
end
end
return result
end
return p

local p = {}
-- 辅助函数：实现 Java 的 Math.tanh
local function tanh(x)
local e_pos = math.exp(x)
local e_neg = math.exp(-x)
return (e_pos - e_neg) / (e_pos + e_neg)
end
-- 辅助函数：实现向上取整并转为长整型逻辑
local function ceilLong(x)
return math.ceil(x)
end
function p.calcDecayTicks(frame)
-- 获取输入参数 x (放射性强度)
local x = tonumber(frame.args[1]) or 0
local mass = tonumber(frame.args[2]) or 1
local ret = 0
-- 核心逻辑还原
if x == 43 then
ret = 5000
elseif x == 61 then
ret = 4500
elseif x <= 100 then
-- ret = (8000 * tanh(-x / 20) + 8000) * 1000
ret = ceilLong((8000 * tanh(-x / 20) + 8000) * 1000)
else
-- ret = 8000 * tanh(-x / 65) + 8000
ret = ceilLong(8000 * tanh(-x / 65) + 8000)
end
-- 如果是长杆，外部逻辑通常是翻倍
ret = ret * mass
-- 返回秒数 (Ticks / 20)
-- 如果需要返回 Ticks，可以直接返回 ret
return ret / 20
end
return p

';model:' .. mw.text.split(selection, '::')[1] table.insert(formlist, selectionTable) end ------------------------------ --------add:sort-------- local sortlist = {} if args['sort'] then local sortkeys = mw.text.split(args['sort'], ',') local orders = {} -- initial order list if args['order'] then orders = mw.text.split(args['order'], ',') end for i, v in ipairs(sortkeys) do sortlist[v] = 1 if orders[i] == '-1' then sortlist[v] = -1 -- be ware of data type end end outputTable['sortkeys'] = sortlist end for i, compStr in ipairs(formlist) do -- 单个组件 local comp = {} local compOptionList = mw.text.split(compStr, ';') for k, compOptionStr in ipairs(compOptionList) do -- 组件的单个属性 local argKey = mw.text.split(compOptionStr, ':')[1] local argValue = mw.text.split(compOptionStr, ':')[2] if argKey ~= 'options' then comp[argKey] = argValue -- 如果不是option则扁平化处理 else comp[argKey] = {} -- 如果是option则再次分割 local options = mw.text.split(argValue, ',') for i, option in ipairs(options) do local oneOption = { value = mw.text.split(option, '-')[1], text = mw.text.split(option, '-')[2] } if mw.text.split(oneOption.text, '@')[2] == 'default' then oneOption.default = true oneOption.text = mw.text.split(oneOption.text, '@')[1] end table.insert(comp[argKey], oneOption) end end end table.insert(outputTable.forms, comp) end output = mw.text.jsonEncode(outputTable) return output end function p._defaultList(frame) local res = '
' local args = getArgs(frame) for i,v in pairs(args) do res = res ..'

' end return res..'
' end return p 复制展开

-- Module for building complex HTML (e.g. infoboxes, navboxes) using a fluent interface.
local HtmlBuilder = {}
local metatable = {}
metatable.__index = function(t, key)
local ret = rawget(t, key)
if ret then
return ret
end
ret = metatable[key]
if type(ret) == 'function' then
return function(...)
return ret(t, ...)
end
else
return ret
end
end
metatable.__tostring = function(t)
local ret = {}
t._build(ret)
return table.concat(ret)
end
metatable._build = function(t, ret)
if t.tagName then
table.insert(ret, '<' .. t.tagName)
for i, attr in ipairs(t.attributes) do
table.insert(ret, ' ' .. attr.name .. '="' .. attr.val .. '"')
end
if #t.styles > 0 then
table.insert(ret, ' style="')
for i, prop in ipairs(t.styles) do
if type(prop) == 'string' then -- added with cssText()
table.insert(ret, prop .. ';')
else -- added with css()
table.insert(ret, prop.name .. ':' .. prop.val .. ';')
end
end
table.insert(ret, '"')
end
if t.selfClosing then
table.insert(ret, ' /')
end
table.insert(ret, '>')
end
for i, node in ipairs(t.nodes) do
if node then
if type(node) == 'table' then
node._build(ret)
else
table.insert(ret, tostring(node))
end
end
end
if t.tagName and not t.unclosed and not t.selfClosing then
table.insert(ret, '</' .. t.tagName .. '>')
end
end
metatable.node = function(t, builder)

table.insert(t.nodes, builder)
end

end
metatable.wikitext = function(t, ...)

for i = 1, #vals do
if vals[i] then
table.insert(t.nodes, vals[i])
end
end
return t
end
metatable.newline = function(t)
table.insert(t.nodes, '\n')
return t
end
metatable.tag = function(t, tagName, args)
args = args or {}
args.parent = t
local builder = HtmlBuilder.create(tagName, args)
table.insert(t.nodes, builder)
return builder
end
local function getAttr(t, name)
for i, attr in ipairs(t.attributes) do
if attr.name == name then
return attr
end
end
end
metatable.attr = function(t, name, val)
if type(val) == 'string' or type(val) == 'number' then
-- if caller sets the style attribute explicitly, then replace all styles previously added with css() and cssText()
if name == 'style' then
t.styles = {val}
return t
end
local attr = getAttr(t, name)
if attr then
attr.val = val
else
table.insert(t.attributes, {name = name, val = val})
end
end
return t
end
metatable.addClass = function(t, class)
if class then
local attr = getAttr(t, 'class')
if attr then
attr.val = attr.val .. ' ' .. class
else
t.attr('class', class)
end
end
return t
end
metatable.css = function(t, name, val)
if type(val) == 'string' or type(val) == 'number' then
for i, prop in ipairs(t.styles) do
if prop.name == name then
prop.val = val
return t
end
end
table.insert(t.styles, {name = name, val = val})
end
return t
end
metatable.cssText = function(t, css)
if css then
table.insert(t.styles, css)
end
return t
end
metatable.done = function(t)
return t.parent or t
end
metatable.allDone = function(t)
while t.parent do
t = t.parent
end
return t
end
function HtmlBuilder.create(tagName, args)
args = args or {}
local builder = {}
setmetatable(builder, metatable)
builder.nodes = {}
builder.attributes = {}
builder.styles = {}
builder.tagName = tagName
builder.parent = args.parent
builder.unclosed = args.unclosed or false
builder.selfClosing = args.selfClosing or false
return builder
end
return HtmlBuilder

local p = {}
local Database = require("Module:Database")
function p.resolve(frame)
local names = {}
local fuzzyNames = {}
for k, v in pairs(frame.args) do
if type(k) == "number" then
table.insert(names, v)
end
end
-- 精确匹配
local results = Database.queryIngredients({translatedNames = names})
-- 模糊匹配：找出所有未匹配的，用 fuzzy 重试
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
if not results[name] then
table.insert(fuzzyNames, name)
end
end
if #fuzzyNames > 0 then
local fuzzyResults = Database.queryIngredients({translatedNames = fuzzyNames, fuzzy = true, fuzzyLimit = 3})
for name, item in pairs(fuzzyResults) do
if not results[name] then
results[name] = item
end
end
end
local out = {}
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
local item = results[name]
if item then
table.insert(out, item.key)
else
table.insert(out, "NOT_FOUND")
end
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
return p

-- This module implements {{Infobox}}
local p = {}
local HtmlBuilder = require('Module:HtmlBuilder')
local args = {}
local origArgs
local root
local function union(t1, t2)
-- Returns the union of the values of two tables, as a sequence.
local vals = {}
for k, v in pairs(t1) do
vals[v] = true
end
for k, v in pairs(t2) do
vals[v] = true
end
local ret = {}
for k, v in pairs(vals) do
table.insert(ret, k)
end
return ret
end
local function getArgNums(prefix)
-- Returns a table containing the numbers of the arguments that exist
-- for the specified prefix. For example, if the prefix was 'data', and
-- 'data1', 'data2', and 'data5' exist, it would return {1, 2, 5}.
local nums = {}
for k, v in pairs(args) do
local num = tostring(k):match('^' .. prefix .. '([1-9]%d*)$')
if num then table.insert(nums, tonumber(num)) end
end
table.sort(nums)
return nums
end
local function addRow(rowArgs)
-- Adds a row to the infobox, with either a header cell
-- or a label/data cell combination.
if rowArgs.header then
root
.tag('tr')
.addClass(rowArgs.rowclass)
.addClass('infobox-header')
.attr('id', rowArgs.rowid)
.tag('th')
.attr('colspan', 2)
.attr('id', rowArgs.headerid)
.css('padding','8px')
.addClass(rowArgs.class)
.addClass(args.headerclass)
.cssText(args.headerstyle)
.wikitext(rowArgs.header)
elseif rowArgs.data then
local row = root.tag('tr')
row.addClass(rowArgs.rowclass)
row.attr('id', rowArgs.rowid)
if rowArgs.label then
row
.tag('th')
.attr('scope', 'row')
.attr('id', rowArgs.labelid)
.addClass('infobox-label')
.css('width','90px')
.cssText(args.labelstyle)
.wikitext(rowArgs.label)
.done()
end
local dataCell = row.tag('td')
if not rowArgs.label then
dataCell
.attr('colspan', 2)
.css('text-align', 'center')
else
dataCell
.addClass('infobox-data')
end
dataCell
.attr('id', rowArgs.dataid)
.addClass(rowArgs.class)
.cssText(rowArgs.datastyle)
.newline()
.wikitext(rowArgs.data)
end
end
local function renderTitle()
if not args.title then return end
root
.tag('tr')
.addClass('infobox-title')
.tag('th')
.attr('colspan', 2)
.addClass(args.titleclass)
.css('padding','8px')
.cssText(args.titlestyle)
.wikitext(args.title)
end
local function renderAboveRow()
if not args.above then return end
root
.tag('tr')
.addClass('infobox-above')
.tag('td')
.attr('colspan', 2)
.css('padding','0.5em')
.addClass(args.aboveclass)
.cssText(args.abovestyle)
.wikitext(args.above)
end
local function renderBelowRow()

root
.tag('tr')
.addClass('infobox-below')
.tag('td')
.attr('colspan', '2')
.css('padding','0.5em')
.addClass(args.belowclass)
.cssText(args.belowstyle)
.newline()
.wikitext(args.below)
end
local function renderSubheaders()
if args.subheader then
args.subheader1 = args.subheader
end
if args.subheaderrowclass then
args.subheaderrowclass1 = args.subheaderrowclass
end
local subheadernums = getArgNums('subheader')
for k, num in ipairs(subheadernums) do
addRow({
data = args['subheader' .. tostring(num)],
datastyle = args.subheaderstyle or args['subheaderstyle' .. tostring(num)],
class = args.subheaderclass,
rowclass = args['infobox-item-title subheaderrowclass' .. tostring(num)]
})
end
end
local function renderImages()
if args.image then
args.image1 = args.image
end
if args.caption then
args.caption1 = args.caption
end
local imagenums = getArgNums('image')
for k, num in ipairs(imagenums) do
local caption = args['caption' .. tostring(num)]
local data = HtmlBuilder.create().wikitext(args['image' .. tostring(num)])
if caption then
data
.tag('div')
.addClass('infobox-caption')
.css('font-size','75%')
.css('font-weight','normal')
.css('padding','4px')
.cssText(args.captionstyle)
.wikitext(caption)
end
addRow({
data = tostring(data),
datastyle = args.imagestyle,
class = args.imageclass,
rowclass = args['infobox-img imagerowclass' .. tostring(num)]
})
end
end
local function renderRows()
-- Gets the union of the header and data argument numbers,
-- and renders them all in order using addRow.
local rownums = union(getArgNums('header'), getArgNums('data'))

local function preprocessSingleArg(argName)
-- If the argument exists and isn't blank, add it to the argument table.
-- Blank arguments are treated as nil to match the behaviour of ParserFunctions.
if origArgs[argName] and origArgs[argName] ~= '' then
args[argName] = origArgs[argName]
end
end
local function preprocessArgs(prefixTable, step)
-- Assign the parameters with the given prefixes to the args table, in order, in batches
-- of the step size specified. This is to prevent references etc. from appearing in the
-- wrong order. The prefixTable should be an array containing tables, each of which has
-- two possible fields, a "prefix" string and a "depend" table. The function always parses
-- parameters containing the "prefix" string, but only parses parameters in the "depend"
-- table if the prefix parameter is present and non-blank.
if type(prefixTable) ~= 'table' then
error("Non-table value detected for the prefix table", 2)
end
if type(step) ~= 'number' then
error("Invalid step value detected", 2)
end
-- Get arguments without a number suffix, and check for bad input.
for i,v in ipairs(prefixTable) do
if type(v) ~= 'table' or type(v.prefix) ~= "string" or (v.depend and type(v.depend) ~= 'table') then
error('Invalid input detected to preprocessArgs prefix table', 2)
end
preprocessSingleArg(v.prefix)
-- Only parse the depend parameter if the prefix parameter is present and not blank.
if args[v.prefix] and v.depend then
for j, dependValue in ipairs(v.depend) do
if type(dependValue) ~= 'string' then
error('Invalid "depend" parameter value detected in preprocessArgs')
end
preprocessSingleArg(dependValue)
end
end
end
-- Get arguments with number suffixes.
local a = 1 -- Counter variable.
local moreArgumentsExist = true
while moreArgumentsExist == true do
moreArgumentsExist = false
for i = a, a + step - 1 do
for j,v in ipairs(prefixTable) do
local prefixArgName = v.prefix .. tostring(i)
if origArgs[prefixArgName] then
moreArgumentsExist = true -- Do another loop if any arguments are found, even blank ones.
preprocessSingleArg(prefixArgName)
end
-- Process the depend table if the prefix argument is present and not blank, or
-- we are processing "prefix1" and "prefix" is present and not blank, and
-- if the depend table is present.
if v.depend and (args[prefixArgName] or (i == 1 and args[v.prefix])) then
for j,dependValue in ipairs(v.depend) do
local dependArgName = dependValue .. tostring(i)
preprocessSingleArg(dependArgName)
end
end
end
end
a = a + step
end
end
function p.infobox(frame)
-- If called via #invoke, use the args passed into the invoking template.
-- Otherwise, for testing purposes, assume args are being passed directly in.
if frame == mw.getCurrentFrame() then
origArgs = frame:getParent().args
else
origArgs = frame
end
-- Parse the data parameters in the same order that the old {{infobox}} did, so that
-- references etc. will display in the expected places. Parameters that depend on
-- another parameter are only processed if that parameter is present, to avoid
-- phantom references appearing in article reference lists.
preprocessSingleArg('child')
preprocessSingleArg('bodyclass')
preprocessSingleArg('subbox')
preprocessSingleArg('bodystyle')
preprocessSingleArg('title')
preprocessSingleArg('titleclass')
preprocessSingleArg('titlestyle')
preprocessSingleArg('above')
preprocessSingleArg('aboveclass')
preprocessSingleArg('abovestyle')
preprocessArgs({
{prefix = 'subheader', depend = {'subheaderstyle', 'subheaderrowclass'}}
}, 10)
preprocessSingleArg('subheaderstyle')
preprocessSingleArg('subheaderclass')
preprocessArgs({
{prefix = 'image', depend = {'caption', 'imagerowclass'}}
}, 10)
preprocessSingleArg('captionstyle')
preprocessSingleArg('imagestyle')
preprocessSingleArg('imageclass')
preprocessArgs({
{prefix = 'header'},
{prefix = 'data', depend = {'label'}},
{prefix = 'rowclass'},
{prefix = 'class'},
{prefix = 'dataid'},
{prefix = 'labelid'},
{prefix = 'headerid'},
{prefix = 'rowid'}
}, 50)
preprocessSingleArg('headerclass')
preprocessSingleArg('headerstyle')
preprocessSingleArg('labelstyle')
preprocessSingleArg('datastyle')
preprocessSingleArg('below')
preprocessSingleArg('belowclass')
preprocessSingleArg('belowstyle')
preprocessSingleArg('name')
args['italic title'] = origArgs['italic title'] -- different behaviour if blank or absent
preprocessSingleArg('decat')
return _infobox()
end
return p

".png" end result.icon = icon end if args['size'] ~= nil then result.size = tonumber(args['size']) end if args['link'] ~= nil then local link = args['link'] if link == "" then result.link = "" else result.link = args['link'] end end if args['amount'] ~= nil then result.amount = tonumber(args['amount']) end if args['tips'] ~= nil then local tips = args['tips'] if tips == "" then result.tips = nil else result.tips = args['tips'] end end if args['fluid_amount'] ~= nil then result.fluid_amount = tonumber(args['fluid_amount']) end return result end local function isURL(link) return link:match("^https?://") end local function stateToClasses(state) local class = { 'format-' .. state.color } if state.bold then table.insert(class, 'format-l') end if state.italic then table.insert(class, 'format-o') end if state.underline then table.insert(class, 'format-n') end if state.strikethrough then table.insert(class, 'format-m') end return table.concat(class, ' ') end local function processLine(line) local state = { color = 'f', bold = false, italic = false, underline = false, strikethrough = false } local fragments = {} local currentFragment = { text = '', state = mw.clone(state) } local i = 1 local len = mw.ustring.len(line) while i <= len do local char = mw.ustring.sub(line, i, i) if char == '§' and i < len then local code = mw.ustring.sub(line, i + 1, i + 1) i = i + 2 if currentFragment.text ~= '' then table.insert(fragments, currentFragment) currentFragment = { text = '', state = mw.clone(state) } end if code == 'r' then state = { color = 'f', bold = false, italic = false, underline = false, strikethrough = false } elseif mw.ustring.match(code, '[0-9a-f]') then state.color = code elseif code == 'l' then state.bold = true elseif code == 'm' then state.strikethrough = true elseif code == 'n' then state.underline = true elseif code == 'o' then state.italic = true end currentFragment.state = mw.clone(state) else currentFragment.text = currentFragment.text .. char i = i + 1 end end if currentFragment.text ~= '' then table.insert(fragments, currentFragment) end local htmlFragments = {} for _, fragment in ipairs(fragments) do local span = mw.html.create('span') :addClass(stateToClasses(fragment.state)) :wikitext(mw.text.nowiki(fragment.text)) table.insert(htmlFragments, tostring(span)) end return table.concat(htmlFragments) end local function colorizeLines(str) str = mw.text.unstrip(str) local lines = mw.text.split(str, '
') local processedLines = {} for _, line in ipairs(lines) do table.insert(processedLines, processLine(line)) end return table.concat(processedLines, '
') end local function genSpan(args, others) local tips = args.tips if tips == nil then return '' .. others .. '' end return '' .. others .. '
' .. colorizeLines(tips) .. '
' end local function genIcon(args) local result = mw.html.create('div') :addClass('item-icon') :css{ position = 'relative', display = 'inline-block' } result:wikitext(string.format( '[[File:%s|%dpx|link=%s]]', args.icon, args.size, args.link or '' )) if args.amount and args.amount ~= 0 then result:tag('div') :css{ position = 'absolute', ['font-family'] = 'Minecraftia', top = string.format('%dpx', args.size / 2), right = '0', ['font-size'] = string.format('%dpx', args.size / 2), color = 'white', opacity = '1', ['text-align'] = 'right' } :wikitext(tostring(args.amount)) end if args.fluid_amount and args.fluid_amount ~= 0 then result:tag('div') :css{ position = 'absolute', ['font-family'] = 'Minecraftia', top = string.format('%dpx', args.size * 5 / 8), left = '0', ['font-size'] = string.format('%dpx', args.size * 7 / 32), color = 'white', opacity = '1' } :wikitext(string.format('%d L', args.fluid_amount)) end return tostring(result) end local function genName(args) local link = args.link if isURL(link) then return '[' .. link .. ' ' .. args.name .. ']' end if link == "" then return "" end local name = args.name if name ~= link then return '[[' .. link .. '|' .. name .. ']]' end return '[[' .. name .. ']]' end function p.getItemIcon(frame) local args = initializeArgs(frame) return genSpan(args, genIcon(args)) end function p.getItemName(frame) local args = initializeArgs(frame) return genSpan(args, genName(args)) end function p.getItem(frame) local args = initializeArgs(frame) local result = genName(args) args.link = '' result = genIcon(args) .. ' ' .. result return genSpan(args, result) end return p 复制展开

-- 逻辑步骤 1：检查是否属于受保护的完整词组
for _, pattern in ipairs(protectionRules) do
if mw.ustring.find(full, pattern) then
return full -- 匹配到保护模式，直接返回原名
end
end
-- 逻辑步骤 2：执行缩写转换
for _, pattern in ipairs(abbreviationRules) do
local core = mw.ustring.match(full, pattern)
if core and core ~= "" then

end
end
-- 逻辑步骤 3：如果都没匹配上，返回原名
return full
end

text:

local p = {}
function buildCarousel(frame, params)
local html = mw.html.create()
local carousel = html:tag('span')
:addClass('carousel')
:cssText('width:' .. params.width .. 'px')
:attr('id', params.id)
:attr('data-ride', 'carousel')
:attr('data-interval', params.interval)
local wrapper = carousel:tag('div')
:addClass('carousel-inner')
:attr('role', 'listbox')
for index, it in ipairs(params.li) do
local cur = wrapper:tag('div')
:addClass('item')
:wikitext(frame:preprocess(it.image))
if it.active ~= nil then
cur:addClass(it.active)
end
end
return tostring(html)
end
function p.render(frame)
if frame:getParent() ~= nil then
frame = frame:getParent()
end
local liParams = parseLiParams(frame)
if #liParams == 0 then
return ''
end
local params = {}
params.id = genId()
params.interval = frame.args['interval']
if not params.interval or params.interval == '' then
params.interval = '1000'
end
params.width = frame.args['width']
if not params.width or params.width == '' then
params.width = '32'
end
params.li = {}
for index, image in ipairs(liParams) do
params.li[index] = { image = image }
if index == 1 then
params.li[index].active = 'active'
end
end
return buildCarousel(frame, params)
end
function parseLiParams(frame)
local parsedParams = {}
local index = 1
while frame.args[index] ~= nil do
local val = frame.args[index]
if val ~= '' then
parsedParams[#parsedParams + 1] = val
end
index = index + 1
end
return parsedParams
end
function genId()
return 'carousel-' .. os.clock() * 1e9
end
return p

这是一个支持wiki的MongoDB项目的模板或模块。详见Project:Database。 本文修正为缓存友好设计： 不以 action=parse 作为主链路； 异步查询走“page + 参数”接口样式，便于 CDN 命中； 不复制业务逻辑，直接复用现有 模块:ItemDisplay / 模块:TooltipCore 能力。 一、设计结论（先说结论） 接口层：异步请求应走稳定 URL（page + query 参数），不要以 parse wikitext 为主。 逻辑层：查询与 tooltip 组装复用现有代码，不新建“同逻辑副本模块”。 缓存层：前端内存缓存 + localStorage + CDN（URL 维度）三层协同。 二、为什么不把 action=parse 当主链路 action=parse 本质是执行型解析，缓存键不直观，CDN 命中与治理成本高。 相比之下，/wiki/某页面?name=...&key=...&nbt=... 这类稳定 URL 更容易被边缘缓存。 因此 parse 可保留为调试/兜底，但不应作为高频异步 tooltip 主通道。 三、复用策略（不重复造轮子） 现有模块中已经有关键能力： 模块:ItemDisplay：参数归一、查询优先级（key+nbt > key > name）等。 模块:TooltipCore：tooltip 文本构建与 Minecraft 样式格式化。 异步方案应做的是“抽公共函数并复用”，而不是复制实现。 建议抽取的公共函数（局部完整代码） -- 模块:ItemDisplay 内新增（或抽到共享模块后由 ItemDisplay/异步入口共同 require） function p.resolveIngredientByQuery(args) local key = normalizeNilToken(args.key) local nbt = normalizeNilToken(args.nbt) local name = resolveItemName(args.name or args[1]) -- 优先级：key+nbt > key > name if hasValue(key) then local ok, map = pcall(DatabaseInterfaces.getIngredients, { key }) if ok and type(map) == 'table' and type(map[key]) == 'table' then if hasValue(nbt) then for _, item in ipairs(map[key]) do if type(item) == 'table' and nbtMatches(item, nbt) then return item end end else return map[key][1] end end end if hasValue(name) then local ok, result = pcall(Database.queryIngredients, { translatedNames = { name } }) if ok and type(result) == 'table' then return result[name] end end return nil end function p.renderTooltipOnly(frame) local args = frame.args local name = resolveItemName(args.name or args[1]) local ingredient = p.resolveIngredientByQuery(args) local text = TooltipCore.buildTooltipFromIngredient(ingredient, name) return TooltipCore.formatMinecraftStyle(text) end 复制展开 上面两个入口可同时被： 页面同步渲染（原链路） 异步查询页（新链路） 共同复用。 四、页面保存时落下什么数据 保存后 HTML 中仍是异步占位节点，只保留最小查询上下文：
正在加载...
复制展开 五、前端请求链路（page+参数） 1) 请求方式 JS 读取 data-* 后，请求固定页面（示例名可按站点实际调整）： /wiki/模板:ItemTooltipAsyncEndpoint?name=...&key=...&nbt=...&lang=... 该 endpoint 页面内部仅做一件事：调用复用入口并输出 HTML。 endpoint 页面示例（局部完整代码） {{#invoke:ItemDisplay|renderTooltipOnly name={{{name|}}} key={{{key|}}} nbt={{{nbt|}}} lang={{{lang|zh}}} }} 复制展开 2) 前端 JS（局部完整代码） (function () { var memCache = Object.create(null); function cacheKey($n) { return $n.attr('data-cache-key') || ''; } function getLS(k) { if (!k) return null; try { var raw = localStorage.getItem('tt:' + k); if (!raw) return null; var obj = JSON.parse(raw); return obj && obj.html ? obj.html : null; } catch (e) { return null; } } function setLS(k, html) { if (!k || !html) return; try { localStorage.setItem('tt:' + k, JSON.stringify({ html: html, ts: Date.now() })); } catch (e) {} } function buildUrl($n) { var p = new URLSearchParams(); p.set('name', $n.attr('data-name') || ''); p.set('key', $n.attr('data-key') || ''); p.set('nbt', $n.attr('data-nbt') || ''); p.set('lang', $n.attr('data-lang') || 'zh'); return '/wiki/模板:ItemTooltipAsyncEndpoint?' + p.toString(); } function renderOne($n) { var k = cacheKey($n); if (k && memCache[k]) { $n.html(memCache[k]).removeClass('huiji-tt-preload'); return; } var hit = getLS(k); if (hit) { memCache[k] = hit; $n.html(hit).removeClass('huiji-tt-preload'); return; } fetch(buildUrl($n), { credentials: 'same-origin' }) .then(function (r) { return r.text(); }) .then(function (html) { // 视 endpoint 输出格式决定是否取 body 子节点；这里假定直接可嵌入 if (k) memCache[k] = html; setLS(k, html); $n.html(html).removeClass('huiji-tt-preload'); mw.hook('wikipage.content').fire($n); }); } mw.hook('wikipage.content').add(function ($content) { $content.find('.async-minecraft-tt').not('.is-loaded').each(function () { var $n = $(this); $n.addClass('is-loaded'); renderOne($n); }); }); })(); 复制展开 六、缓存与失效 1) cacheKey 结构 v2|mode|key|nbt|name|lang 2) 三层缓存 页面内存（同页重复悬浮秒回） localStorage（跨页面会话） CDN（由 endpoint URL + query 参数命中） 3) 失效策略 Tooltip 结构变化：v2 -> v3 单条清理：删 tt: 批量升级：依赖版本前缀自然失效 七、链路总览 编辑保存 -> ItemDisplay 输出 async 节点 + data-name/key/nbt/lang/cacheKey 用户交互 -> Common.js 先查 mem/localStorage -> miss 后请求 endpoint(page+参数 URL) -> endpoint 调用 ItemDisplay.renderTooltipOnly（复用 TooltipCore） -> 返回 HTML -> 前端回填 + 写缓存 -> 下次同 key 直接命中（本地或 CDN） 复制展开 八、参数示例 硅岩 硅岩 硅岩|sync-tooltips-rendering=0}} local p = {} local itemAbbr = require("Module:ItemAbbreviation") local DatabaseInterfaces = require("Module:DatabaseInterfaces") local Database = require("Module:Database") local TooltipCore = require("Module:TooltipCore") local DatabaseIcon = require("Module:DatabaseIcon") -- 统一默认配置（为什么集中在这里：后续改策略只改这一处） local DEFAULTS = { item = { size = 17, tooltipEnabled = false, renderMode = "sync", }, icon = { size = 48, tooltipEnabled = true, renderMode = "sync", }, } local memo = {} local function hasValue(v) return v ~= nil and tostring(v) ~= "" end local function trim(s) if s == nil then return "" end return tostring(s):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end -- 检测无等号标记参数： -- 例如 {{item|物品名|noabbr}} 中的 noabbr 会作为匿名参数传入。 -- 同时兼容 |noabbr=任意值 的命名参数形式；只要参数存在即视为开启。 local function hasFlag(args, flag) if args[flag] ~= nil then return true end for k, v in pairs(args) do if type(k) == "number" and trim(v) == flag then return true end end return false end local function removePngSuffix(s) s = trim(s) if s:lower():match("%.png$") then return s:sub(1, -5) end return s end local function normalizeNilToken(s) s = trim(s) if s == "nil" or s == "NULL" then return "" end return s end local function getArgs(frame) local args = {} local parent = frame:getParent() if parent and parent.args then for k, v in pairs(parent.args) do args[k] = v end end for k, v in pairs(frame.args or {}) do if not hasValue(args[k]) then args[k] = v end end return args end local function resolveItemName(raw) return removePngSuffix(normalizeNilToken(raw)) end local function resolveIconName(name, iconOverride, mode) if hasValue(iconOverride) then return removePngSuffix(iconOverride) end if mode == "item" then local ok, converted = pcall(itemAbbr.convertFromAbbreviation, { args = { name } }) if ok and hasValue(converted) then return removePngSuffix(converted) end end return removePngSuffix(name) end local function resolveTargetLink(name, linkOverride, mode, noabbr) local link = normalizeNilToken(linkOverride) if hasValue(link) then return link end -- noabbr 存在时直接使用完整物品名作为链接目标， -- 仅跳过 convertToAbbreviation，不影响图标名、显示名或其它解析逻辑。 if noabbr then return name end if mode == "item" or mode == "icon" then local ok, converted = pcall(itemAbbr.convertToAbbreviation, { args = { name } }) if ok and hasValue(converted) then return converted end end return name end local function buildIconWikitext(iconName, size, linkTarget, nolink) local file = removePngSuffix(iconName) .. ".png" local px = tostring(size) if nolink then return string.format("[[File:%s|%spx|link=]]", file, px) end return string.format("[[File:%s|%spx|link=%s]]", file, px, linkTarget) end local function buildTextWikitext(name, linkTarget, nolink) if nolink then return name end if linkTarget:sub(1, 4) == "http" then return string.format("[%s %s]", linkTarget, name) end return string.format("[[%s|%s]]", linkTarget, name) end local function queryIngredientByName(name, version) local ok, result = pcall(Database.queryIngredients, { translatedNames = { name }, version = version }) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then return nil end return result[name] end local function nbtMatches(item, nbt) if not hasValue(nbt) then return true end local n = trim(nbt) return tostring(item.nbt or "") == n or tostring(item.tag or "") == n or tostring(item.meta or "") == n end -- 统一实体解析： -- 为什么按 key+nbt > key > name： -- - key/nbt 是编辑者显式给出的“更强约束”，优先级应最高。 -- - name 容易同名歧义，只适合兜底。 local function resolveIngredient(args) -- @key 前缀：第一参数直接作为 key 查询 local rawFirst = args[1] or "" if string.sub(rawFirst, 1, 1) == "@" then args.key = string.sub(rawFirst, 2) args[1] = args.key end local key = normalizeNilToken(args.key) local name = resolveItemName(args[1] or args.name) local memoKey = table.concat({ key, name, args.version or "" }, "||") if memo[memoKey] ~= nil then return memo[memoKey] end local found = nil if hasValue(key) then local ok, map = pcall(DatabaseInterfaces.getIngredients, { key }, { version = args.version }) if ok and type(map) == "table" and type(map[key]) == "table" then found = map[key][1] end end if not found and hasValue(name) then found = queryIngredientByName(name, args.version) end if not found then local target = key ~= "" and key or name error('未找到名称 "' .. tostring(target) .. '" 对应的任何标识符。[[分类:无法索引至数据库物品条目]]') end memo[memoKey] = found return found end -- Tooltip 内容决策顺序： -- 1) tooltip 赋值 disabled 或 nil 强行关闭 -- 2) tooltipText存在时强行开启，不查库 -- 3) tooltip 赋值 enabled 或 存在ingredient 或 DEFAULTS[mode].tooltipEnabled为真：强行查库 local function resolveTooltip(args, mode, fallbackName) if args.extraTooltipText and args.extraTooltipText ~= "" then args.tooltip = "enabled" end if args.tooltip == "disabled" then return nil end -- 兼容旧 ATCI：tooltip=nil 表示关闭 tooltip。 if trim(args.tooltip) == "nil" then return nil end if args.tooltip ~= nil and args.tooltip ~= "enabled" then args.tooltipText = args.tooltip end if args.tooltipText ~= nil and tostring(args.tooltipText) ~= "" then return tostring(args.tooltipText) end local defaultEnabled = DEFAULTS[mode].tooltipEnabled if args.tooltip ~= "disabled" and (args.tooltip == "enabled" or args.ingredient or defaultEnabled) then local ingredient = args.ingredient or resolveIngredient(args) args.ingredient = ingredient if args.extraTooltipText then ingredient.tooltips = (ingredient.tooltips or fallbackName) .. "
§7" .. args.extraTooltipText end -- 检测是否有多内容变体（tooltipsShift/tooltipsCtrl/tooltipsShiftAndCtrl） local hasMulti = ingredient and (ingredient.tooltipsShift or ingredient.tooltipsCtrl or ingredient.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl) if hasMulti then return TooltipCore.buildMultiVariantTooltip(ingredient, fallbackName) end return TooltipCore.buildTooltipFromIngredient(ingredient, fallbackName) end return nil end local function resolveRenderMode(args, mode) if hasValue(args["sync-tooltips-rendering"]) then if tostring(args["sync-tooltips-rendering"]) == "0" then return "async" end return "sync" end return DEFAULTS[mode].renderMode end -- 目前先提供 sync 成品，确保“不改 JS 也能用”。 -- 为什么 async 暂不在这里实现： -- - 当前环境下 JS 需管理员改动才能完整接 cacheKey 协议； -- - 先保证功能正确、可上线，再迭代性能优化。 local function maybeWrapTooltip(content, tooltipText, renderMode) if not hasValue(tooltipText) then return content end if renderMode == "async" then -- 这里先退化为 sync，确保无 JS 依赖也可工作。 return TooltipCore.wrapSync(content, tooltipText) end return TooltipCore.wrapSync(content, tooltipText) end function p.renderCommon(args, mode) local name = resolveItemName(args[1] or args.name) if not hasValue(name) then return "" end local size = tonumber(args.size) or DEFAULTS[mode].size -- 兼容旧 ATCI：link=nil 表示无链接。 -- nolink 兼容三种写法： -- 1) |nolink=1（命名参数） -- 2) |nolink（历史常用的无等号写法，会落到第二位置参数） -- 3) link=nil（ATCI 历史语义） local nolink = (args.nolink ~= nil) or (trim(args[2]) == "nolink") or (trim(args.link) == "nil") -- noabbr 是纯标记参数： -- 写 |noabbr 即开启，不写即关闭；不要求赋值为 1。 -- 开启后仅禁止自动缩写链接目标，不影响名称、图标和 tooltip。 local noabbr = hasFlag(args, "noabbr") local iconName = resolveIconName(name, args.icon or args.image, mode) local linkTarget = resolveTargetLink(name, args.link, mode, noabbr) -- 查库：外部预传 ingredient 则跳过查询，只回填字段 if args.ingredient then name = args.ingredient.translatedName or name iconName = args.ingredient.iconName or iconName linkTarget = resolveTargetLink(name, args.link, mode, noabbr) elseif args.tooltip ~= "disabled" and (args.tooltip == "enabled" or DEFAULTS[mode].tooltipEnabled or ((args[1] or ""):sub(1, 1) == "@")) then args.ingredient = resolveIngredient(args) if args.ingredient then name = args.ingredient.translatedName or name iconName = args.ingredient.iconName or iconName linkTarget = resolveTargetLink(name, args

html:tag('div'):addClass('is_main'):cssText('display:none;') -- 搜索栏（Lua 只放占位 div，JS 动态生成 input/button） local bar = top:tag('div'):addClass('is_bar') bar:tag('div'):addClass('is_bar_input') :attr('data-input-type', 'text') :attr('data-input-placeholder', '输入物品中文名搜索，如"钛"、"电路"……') bar:tag('div'):addClass('is_bar_btn') :attr('data-input-type', 'button') :attr('data-input-name', '搜索') :attr('data-input-class', 'search') bar:tag('div'):addClass('is_bar_btn') :attr('data-input-type', 'button') :attr('data-input-name', '重置') :attr('data-input-class', 'reset') -- 精确搜索复选框占位 bar:tag('div'):addClass('is_bar_checkbox') :attr('data-input-type', 'checkbox') :attr('data-input-label', '精确匹配') :attr('data-input-param', 'exact') -- 结果容器 top:tag('div'):addClass('is_result') return tostring(html) end ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 搜索 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function p.search(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local name = mw.text.trim(args.name or args[1] or '') local page = tonumber(args.page) or 1 if page < 1 then page = 1 end local overrideLimit = tonumber(args.limit) local pageSize = overrideLimit or 24 local maxPage = overrideLimit and 1 or 25 if page > maxPage then page = maxPage end local html = mw.html.create() -- 空搜索 → 提示 if name == '' then html:tag('div'):addClass('is_empty') :wikitext('请输入物品名称进行搜索。') return tostring(html) end -- 一次 $facet 聚合同时拿分页数据 + 总数（仿照 queryRecipeDetailed） local isExact = args.exact == '1' local raw, summary = Database.queryIngredients{ translatedNames = { name }, fuzzy = not isExact, skip = (page - 1) * pageSize, limit = pageSize, } -- 去重 local seen = {} local items = {} for _, item in pairs(raw) do local k = item.key if k and not seen[k] then seen[k] = true table.insert(items, item) end end local total = summary.total if total == 0 then html:tag('div'):addClass('is_empty') :wikitext('未找到匹配「' .. mw.text.encode(name) .. '」的物品。') return tostring(html) end -- 分页 local totalPages = math.ceil(total / pageSize) if page > totalPages then page = totalPages end -- 结果统计 local searchMode = isExact and '精确搜索' or '搜索' html:tag('div'):addClass('is_info') :wikitext(searchMode .. '「' .. mw.text.encode(name) .. '」，共找到 ' .. total .. ' 个物品。') -- 超过 25 页时提示（仅完整模式，嵌入模式不提示） if not overrideLimit and total > maxPage * pageSize then html:tag('div'):addClass('is_info') :wikitext('最多提供 ' .. maxPage .. ' 页的查询结果，如未能找到需要的物品，请打开精确搜索模式。') end -- 翻页（嵌入模式不显示） if not overrideLimit and totalPages > 1 then html:node(_pageSelector(page, math.min(totalPages, maxPage))) end -- 结果网格（items 已是当前页，直接遍历） local grid = html:tag('div'):addClass('is_grid') for _, item in ipairs(items) do grid:node(_itemCard(item)) end -- 翻页（列表后） if not overrideLimit and totalPages > 1 then html:node(_pageSelector(page, math.min(totalPages, maxPage))) end return tostring(html) end ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 单个物品卡片 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function _itemCard(item) local name = item.translatedName or item.key or '???' local mod = item.mod or '' local originalName = item.originalName or '' local defaultTooltip = (item.tooltips or ''):gsub('
', '\n') local key = item.key or '' -- 构建 tooltips 对象（含 shift/ctrl 变体） local neiTooltips = { default = defaultTooltip } if item.tooltipsShift then neiTooltips.shift = item.tooltipsShift:gsub('
', '\n') end if item.tooltipsCtrl then neiTooltips.ctrl = item.tooltipsCtrl:gsub('
', '\n') end if item.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl then neiTooltips.shiftAndCtrl = item.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl:gsub('
', '\n') end -- 构建 NEI 内联 JSON local neiData = { name = name, mod = mod, originalName = originalName, tooltips = neiTooltips, key = key, } -- 携带额外字段（如果存在） if item.NC ~= nil then neiData.NC = item.NC end if item.chance ~= nil then neiData.chance = item.chance end if item.amount ~= nil then neiData.amount = item.amount end if item.aspect then neiData.aspect = item.aspect end -- 图标（frameCount/size 字段名和 ItemDisplay 保持一致） local iconName = item.iconName or '' local framecount = tonumber(item.frameCount) or 1 local framesize = tonumber(item.size) or 16 local jsonStr = mw.text.jsonEncode(neiData) local card = mw.html.create():tag('div'):addClass('is_card nei-tt') card:tag('span'):addClass('nei-data'):cssText('display:none;'):wikitext(jsonStr) -- 图标 if iconName ~= '' then local iconHtml = DatabaseIcon.render{ iconName = iconName, size = 32, link = '', framecount = framecount, framesize = framesize, } card:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_icon'):wikitext(iconHtml) end -- key 挂在卡片上，也展示在卡片内 card:attr('data-item-key', key) local body = card:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_body') body:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_name'):wikitext(name) if originalName ~= '' then body:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_original'):wikitext(originalName) end body:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_key'):wikitext(key) if mod ~= '' then body:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_mod'):wikitext(mod) end -- ── 底部操作按钮 ── -- 进入条目：用 ItemAbbreviation 找到页面名 local ok, abbr = pcall(itemAbbr.convertToAbbreviation, { args = { name } }) local pageName = (ok and abbr and abbr ~= '') and abbr or name local entryHtml = '[[' .. pageName .. '|进入条目]]' -- 查询配方 / 查询用途 → CustomSearch local baseUrl = 'https://gtnh.huijiwiki.com/wiki/CustomSearch' local encoded = mw.uri.encode(name) local recipeUrl = baseUrl .. '?output=' .. encoded local usageUrl = baseUrl .. '?input=' .. encoded body:tag('div'):addClass('is_card_actions plainlinks') :wikitext(entryHtml .. ' ') :wikitext('[' .. recipeUrl .. ' 查询配方] ') :wikitext('[' .. usageUrl .. ' 查询用途]') return card end ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 翻页组件 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- function _pageSelector(current, total) local showRange = 2 local div = mw.html.create():tag('div'):addClass('is_pager') -- 第一页 if current - showRange > 1 then div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_btn'):attr('data-page', 1):wikitext('1') end if current - showRange > 2 then div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_ellipsis'):wikitext('...') end -- 前一簇 for n = current - showRange, current - 1 do if n > 0 then div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_btn'):attr('data-page', n):wikitext(tostring(n)) end end -- 当前页 div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_btn is_page_current'):wikitext(tostring(current)) -- 后一簇 for n = current + 1, current + showRange do if n <= total then div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_btn'):attr('data-page', n):wikitext(tostring(n)) end end -- 最后一页 if current + showRange < total - 1 then div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_ellipsis'):wikitext('...') end if current + showRange < total then div:tag('span'):addClass('is_page_btn'):attr('data-page', total):wikitext(tostring(total)) end return div end return p 复制展开
