模块_MaterialDetails
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:MaterialDetails/doc创建 local p = {} -- 引入外部依赖 local Database = require('Module:Database') local MaterialParts = require('Module:Grid/Material Parts') local OreProcessing = require('Module:Grid/Ore_Processing') local MaterialAttribute = require("Module:材料属性") -- [[ 1. 扫描逻辑：针对 Parts 的旧版 OrePrefixes 适配 ]] local function scanIngredientKeysForParts(materialData) local keys = {} local seen = {} for _, itemID in pairs(materialData.OrePrefixes or {}) do if type(itemID) == "table" then for _, subID in pairs(itemID) do if type(subID) == "string" and subID ~= "" and not seen[subID] then table.insert(keys, subID) seen[subID] = true end end elseif type(itemID) == "string" and itemID ~= "" and not seen[itemID] then table.insert(keys, itemID) seen[itemID] = true end end return keys end -- [[ 2. 聚合扫描器：根据开关状态收集 Key ]] local function collectAllIngredientKeys(materialData, config) local allKeys = {} local seen = {} local function addKeys(keyList) for _, k in ipairs(keyList) do if k and not seen[k] then table.insert(allKeys, k) seen[k] = true end end end -- 只有未禁用 Parts 时才扫描其依赖 if not config.noParts then addKeys(scanIngredientKeysForParts(materialData)) end -- 只有未禁用 OreProcessing 且数据存在时才扫描其依赖 if not config.noOreProc and materialData.OreProcessing then addKeys(OreProcessing.scanIngredientKeys(materialData)) end return allKeys end -- [[ 3. 主函数 ]] function p.main(frame) local args = frame:getParent().args local name = args[1] local ticName = (args[2] and args[2] ~= "") and args[2] or name local debugging = args["debugging"] and true or false -- 获取手动关闭参数 (传入非空字符串即视为 true) local config = { noTitle = (args["no-title"] and args["no-title"] ~= "") and true or false, noParts = (args["no-material-parts"] and args["no-material-parts"] ~= "") and true or false, noOreProc = (args["no-ore-processing"] and args["no-ore-processing"] ~= "") and true or false, noAttrib = (args["no-material-attribute"] and args["no-material-attribute"] ~= "") and true or false } if name then name = mw.text.unstrip(name) end -- 跳过逻辑 if name == "none" then return "" end -- 数据查询 local ok_mat, materialData = pcall(Database.queryMaterial, name) materialData = (ok_mat and materialData) or {} local ok_tic, ticMaterialData = pcall(Database.queryTicMaterial, ticName) ticMaterialData = (ok_tic and ticMaterialData) or {} -- 聚合扫描并获取元数据 local keysToQuery = collectAllIngredientKeys(materialData, config) local ingredients = {} if #keysToQuery > 0 then local ok_ing, ingData = pcall(Database.queryIngredients, { keys = keysToQuery }) ingredients = (ok_ing and ingData) or {} end -- 渲染开始 local result = "" if not config.noTitle then result = result .. "=== 材料零件与矿物处理 ===\n" end -- 判定数据是否存在 local hasParts = not config.noParts and ok_mat and materialData.OrePrefixes and next(materialData.OrePrefixes) local hasOreProc = not config.noOreProc and ok_mat and materialData.OreProcessing and next(materialData.OreProcessing) if hasParts or hasOreProc then -- 添加最外层 Flex 包装 -- align-items: flex-start 确保两个盒子顶部对齐，不会因为高度不同而互相拉伸 result = result .. '
' -- 绘制 Parts 部分 if hasParts then result = result .. '
' -- 包装零件图 result = result .. MaterialParts.main(frame, materialData, ingredients) result = result .. '
' end -- 绘制矿物处理部分 if hasOreProc then result = result .. '
' -- 包装流程图 result = result .. OreProcessing.render(frame, materialData, ingredients) result = result .. '
' end result = result .. '
\n' -- 闭合外层 Flex 容器 else -- 两者都不存在时的正文提示 result = result .. "无材料零件与矿物处理数据。\n" end -- 绘制属性 if not config.noAttrib then result = result .. MaterialAttribute.renderAll(materialData, ticMaterialData) end -- 调试输出 if debugging then result = result .. "\n=== DEBUG ===\n" .. mw.dumpObject(materialData) .. mw.dumpObject(ingredients) end return result end return p 复制展开

title: 模块_MeteorCalc
text:
此模块的文档可以在模块:MeteorCalc/doc创建 local p = {} -- 辅助函数：四舍五入 local function round(num) return math.floor(num + 0.5) end -- 求真实体积 local function getVolume(r) local count = 0 local limit = (r + 0.5) * (r + 0.5) for i = -r, r do for j = -r, r do for k = -r, r do if (i*i + j*j + k*k) < limit then count = count + 1 end end end end return count end -- 求被试剂稀释后的真实概率 (计算权重占比) local function getDilutedChance(itemWeight, totalWeight, baseFiller, penalty, isFiller) local baseChance = (itemWeight / totalWeight) * 100 local newTotalFiller = 100 * (baseFiller + penalty) / (100 + penalty) if isFiller then if baseFiller == 0 then return 0 end return newTotalFiller * (baseChance / 100) else local originalOre = 100 - baseFiller if originalOre == 0 then return 0 end return (100 - newTotalFiller) * (baseChance / 100) end end -- ====== 血之宝珠分级定义 ====== local ORB_TIERS = { { name = "{{Item|法师气血宝珠|nolink}}（≤150,000）", maxLp = 150000, css = "background-color:cornflowerblue; color:black;" }, { name = "{{Item|导师气血宝珠|nolink}}（≤1,000,000）", maxLp = 1000000, css = "background-color:#AFA016; color:black;" }, { name = "{{Item|贤者气血宝珠|nolink}}（≤10,000,000）", maxLp = 10000000, css = "background-color:MediumVioletRed; color:white;" }, { name = "{{Item|透明气血宝珠|nolink}}（≤30,000,000）", maxLp = 30000000, css = "background-color:#4C004C; color:white;" }, { name = "{{Item|邪术气血宝珠|nolink}}（≤80,000,000）", maxLp = 80000000, css = "background-color:midnightblue; color:white;" }, { name = "{{Item|阿蒙克气血宝珠|nolink}}（≤2,147,483,647）", maxLp = 2147483647, css = "background-color:#730000; color:white;" }, } -- ====== 重点祭品定义 ====== local RECOMMENDED_ITEMS = { ['进阶扫描仪 IV'] = true, ['纯净的硅岩粉'] = true, ['精英质量发生器 II'] = true, ['进阶作物合成机 VII'] = true, } local PLANET_ITEMS = { ['重型合金锭 T1'] = true, ['重型合金锭 T2'] = true, ['重型装甲板'] = true, ['4阶重型装甲板'] = true, ['5阶重型装甲板'] = true, ['6阶重型装甲板'] = true, ['7阶重型装甲板'] = true, ['8阶重型装甲板'] = true, ['木卫四岩石'] = true, } -- 格式化祭品：根据祭品类型加颜色 local function formatCatalyst(itemName) if RECOMMENDED_ITEMS[itemName] then return '{{Item|' .. itemName .. '|nolink}}' elseif PLANET_ITEMS[itemName] then return '{{Item|' .. itemName .. '|nolink}}' else return '{{Item|' .. itemName .. '|nolink}}' end end local function getOrbTier(lp) for _, tier in ipairs(ORB_TIERS) do if lp <= tier.maxLp then return tier end end return ORB_TIERS[#ORB_TIERS] end -- ====== 主渲染函数 ====== function p.renderTable(frame) local title = mw.title.new('Data:MeteorWeight.json') if not title or not title.exists then return 'Lua 错误：找不到数据页面 Data:MeteorWeight.json' end local rawContent = title:getContent() local data = mw.text.jsonDecode(rawContent) -- 将 LP 字符串转为数字排序 local function parseLP(lpStr) local clean = lpStr:gsub(',', '') return tonumber(clean) end -- 创建一个副本并按 LP 排序 local sorted = {} for _, m in ipairs(data.meteors) do table.insert(sorted, m) end table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return parseLP(a.lp) < parseLP(b.lp) end) local out = '' local currentOrbTier = nil local groupIndex = 0 for _, meteor in ipairs(sorted) do local lpNum = parseLP(meteor.lp) local tier = getOrbTier(lpNum) -- 如果进入新宝珠分级，输出分级标题 if not currentOrbTier or currentOrbTier.name ~= tier.name then currentOrbTier = tier out = out .. '
' .. tier.name .. '
\n' end groupIndex = groupIndex + 1 local r = meteor.baseRadius local volBase = getVolume(r) local volPlus1 = getVolume(r + 1) local volPlus2 = getVolume(r + 2) -- 计算矿石和填充物的总权重 local totalOreWeight = 0 for _, ore in ipairs(meteor.ores) do totalOreWeight = totalOreWeight + ore.weight end local totalFillerWeight = 0 local fillerCount = 0 if meteor.fillers then for _, filler in ipairs(meteor.fillers) do totalFillerWeight = totalFillerWeight + filler.weight end fillerCount = #meteor.fillers end -- 展开/折叠按钮的 ID (用 LP 保证唯一) local toggleId = 'meteor-' .. lpNum -- 每个陨石一个折叠块：始终可见摘要 + 可折叠详情表格 out = out .. '
\n' -- ===== 始终可见的摘要行 ===== out = out .. '
\n' out = out .. '🩸 ' .. meteor.lp .. ' LP\n' out = out .. '' .. formatCatalyst(meteor.item) .. '\n' out = out .. '📐 半径: ' .. r .. '\n' out = out .. '点击展开详情 ▸\n' out = out .. '
\n' -- ===== 可折叠详情 ===== out = out .. '
\n' out = out .. '{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; text-align:center; font-size:13px; margin:0;"\n' out = out .. '|-\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 产物类型\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 产物\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 权重\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 概率\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 期望数量\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 半径+1期望\n' out = out .. '! style="background-color:#12364B; color:white; padding:6px;" | 半径+2期望\n' -- ====== 矿石部分 ====== for _, ore in ipairs(meteor.ores) do local chanceBase = (ore.weight / totalOreWeight) * (100 - meteor.baseFiller) local chancePlus1 = getDilutedChance(ore.weight, totalOreWeight, meteor.baseFiller, 10, false) local chancePlus2 = getDilutedChance(ore.weight, totalOreWeight, meteor.baseFiller, 20, false) local expBase = round(volBase * (chanceBase / 100)) local expPlus1 = round(volPlus1 * (chancePlus1 / 100)) local expPlus2 = round(volPlus2 * (chancePlus2 / 100)) out = out .. '|-\n' out = out .. '| 矿石 || {{Item|' .. ore.name .. '|nolink}} || ' .. ore.weight .. ' || ' .. string.format("%.2f", chanceBase) .. '% || ' .. expBase .. ' || ' .. expPlus1 .. ' || ' .. expPlus2 .. '\n' end -- ====== 填充物部分 ====== if meteor.fillers then for _, filler in ipairs(meteor.fillers) do local chanceBase = (filler.weight / totalFillerWeight) * meteor.baseFiller local chancePlus1 = getDilutedChance(filler.weight, totalFillerWeight, meteor.baseFiller, 10, true) local chancePlus2 = getDilutedChance(filler.weight, totalFillerWeight, meteor.baseFiller, 20, true) local expBase = round(volBase * (chanceBase / 100)) local expPlus1 = round(volPlus1 * (chancePlus1 / 100)) local expPlus2 = round(volPlus2 * (chancePlus2 / 100)) out = out .. '|-\n' out = out .. '| 填充方块 || {{Item|' .. filler.name .. '|nolink}} || ' .. filler.weight .. ' || ' .. string.format("%.2f", chanceBase) .. '% || ' .. expBase .. ' || ' .. expPlus1 .. ' || ' .. expPlus2 .. '\n' end end out = out .. '|}\n' out = out .. '
\n' out = out .. '
\n' end return frame:preprocess(out) end return p 复制展开

local p = {}
-- 给数字加上分号
local function add_comma_to_number(number)
local formatted = tostring(number)
local integer_part, decimal_part = formatted:match("^(%-?%d+)(%.%d*)$")
integer_part = integer_part or formatted -- 如果没有小数部分，则整数部分就是全部
decimal_part = decimal_part or "" -- 如果没有小数部分，小数部分为空
local result = ""
local counter = 0
for i = #integer_part, 1, -1 do
local char = integer_part:sub(i, i)
result = char .. result
counter = counter + 1
if counter == 3 and i > 1 then
result = "," .. result
counter = 0
end
end
return result .. decimal_part
end
-- 格式化数值
function p.format_num(frame)
local args = frame.args
return add_comma_to_number(args[1])
end
return p

-- Ordered Table
-- Written by Rici Lake. The author disclaims all rights and responsibilities,
-- and relinquishes the software below to the public domain.
-- Have fun with it.
-- The function Ordered creates a table which can iterate in order of its
-- entries. You'll need to modify pairs as indicated on the Lua wiki
-- (GeneralizedPairsAndIpairs) in order to use this feature.
-- Since stock Lua does not have constructors, you cannot "seed" the
-- table with an initializer. A patch for this is forthcoming; this function
-- was extracted from the tests for that patch.
-- The table does not allow deletion, so it might not be appropriate
-- for all cases. You can set a key to nil, which removes it from
-- the iteration, but the key is actually permanently in the table,
-- and setting it to a new value will restore it to its original place
-- in the table. Obviously, that's not ideal, but it was simple and
-- efficient, and it is always possible to compact a table by copying it.
-- Rather than use what seems to be the classic implementation, with
-- three tables: <key->ordinal, ordinal->key, ordinal->value>, we
-- use a regular key->value table, with an auxiliary linked list
-- key->nextkey.
-- The advantage of this setup is that we don't need to invoke a
-- metamethod for any case other than setting a new key (or a key
-- which has been previously set to nil), which is a significant
-- speed-up. It also makes it easy to implement the stability
-- guarantee. The disadvantage is that there is effectively a
-- memory-leak.
-- The table is fully stable; during an iteration, you can perform
-- an arbitrary modification (since keys are not ever actually deleted).
local function Ordered()
-- nextkey and firstkey are used as markers; nextkey[firstkey] is
-- the first key in the table, and nextkey[nextkey] is the last key.
-- nextkey[nextkey[nextkey]] should always be nil.
local key2val, nextkey, firstkey = {}, {}, {}
nextkey[nextkey] = firstkey
local function onext(self, key)
while key ~= nil do
key = nextkey[key]
local val = self[key]
if val ~= nil then return key, val end
end
end
-- To save on tables, we use firstkey for the (customised)
-- metatable; this line is just for documentation
local selfmeta = firstkey
-- record the nextkey table, for routines lacking the closure
selfmeta.__nextkey = nextkey
-- setting a new key (might) require adding the key to the chain
function selfmeta:__newindex(key, val)
rawset(self, key, val)
if nextkey[key] == nil then -- adding a new key
nextkey[nextkey[nextkey]] = key
nextkey[nextkey] = key
end
end
-- if you don't have the __pairs patch, use this:
-- local _p = pairs; function pairs(t, ...)
-- return (getmetatable(t).__pairs or _p)(t, ...) end
function selfmeta:__pairs() return onext, self, firstkey end
return setmetatable(key2val, selfmeta)
end
return Ordered

local p = {}
local Database = require('模块:Database')
-- 运行时缓存：同一页面解析周期内，避免重复执行昂贵聚合查询。
local CACHE = nil
local function trim(s)
return mw.text.trim(s or '')
end
local function normalizeKey(s)
-- 数据源里可能混入全角句点，统一为半角，避免同一 key 被拆成两份。
return trim((s or ''):gsub('．', '.'))
end
local function safeAggregate(pipeline)
-- Why: wiki 线上偶发查询异常时，公共模块不应让页面整体报错。
-- How: 用 pcall 包裹 aggregate，失败时返回空表，让上层走空数据回退路径。
local ok, res = pcall(mw.huiji.db.aggregate, pipeline)
if not ok or type(res) ~= 'table' then
return {}
end
return res
end
local function fetchDynamicDocValues(docId)
-- Why: Data:xxx.json 顶层字段是动态 key，Lua 直接处理会导致多处重复代码。
-- How: 统一转换为 {entryKey, entryValue} 行结构，后续逻辑只处理“数组行”。
return safeAggregate({
{ ['$match'] = { ['_id'] = docId } },
{ ['$project'] = { ['rows'] = { ['$objectToArray'] = '$$ROOT' } } },
{ ['$unwind'] = '$rows' },
{ ['$match'] = { ['rows.k'] = { ['$ne'] = '_id' } } },
{ ['$project'] = { ['_id'] = 0, ['entryKey'] = '$rows.k', ['entryValue'] = '$rows.v' } }
})
end
local function fetchDimensions()
local rows = fetchDynamicDocValues('Data:Gtnhdimension.json')
local out = {}
for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
local abbr = trim(row.entryKey)
local v = row.entryValue or {}
if abbr ~= '' then
out[abbr] = {
abbreviatedName = abbr,
localizedName = trim(v.localizedName),
internalName = trim(v.internalName),
fullName = trim(v.fullName),
originalName = trim(v.originalName),
tier = tonumber(v.tier) or 0
}
end
end
return out
end
local function buildDimensionLookups(dimensionsByAbbr)
local planetToDim, planetToDimLower, byAbbr = {}, {}, {}
for abbr, d in pairs(dimensionsByAbbr) do
byAbbr[abbr] = true
local aliases = { d.localizedName, d.internalName, d.fullName, d.originalName, abbr }
for _, alias in ipairs(aliases) do
local a = trim(alias)
if a ~= '' then
-- Why: 页面输入来源复杂（中文名/英文名/缩写/大小写），这里一次性建全索引，
-- 避免每个业务模块重复做 normalize + fallback。
planetToDim[a] = abbr
planetToDimLower[mw.ustring.lower(a)] = abbr
end
end
end
return planetToDim, planetToDimLower, byAbbr
end
local function formatDimLabel(abbr, dimensionsByAbbr)
local d = dimensionsByAbbr[abbr]
if not d then
return abbr
end
local name = d.localizedName ~= '' and d.localizedName or abbr
local tier = tonumber(d.tier) or 0
-- 维度标签和历史页面写法保持一致。
if abbr == 'Ne' then
return '下界(蒸汽)'
end
if abbr == 'TF' then
return '暮色森林(LV)'
end
if abbr == 'ED' then
return '末地(HV)'
end
if abbr == 'EA' then
return '末地小行星(HV)'
end
if tier <= 0 then
return name
end
return string.format('%s(T%d)', name, tier)
end
local function formatDimWithProbability(abbr, probability, dimensionsByAbbr)
local d = dimensionsByAbbr[abbr]
if not d then
return string.format('%s(%.1f%%)', abbr, probability or 0)
end
local name = d.localizedName ~= '' and d.localizedName or abbr
local tier = tonumber(d.tier) or 0
local pcent = tonumber(probability) or 0
-- Why: “矿脉与矿石”需求要求展示“维度(Tn, p%)”，
-- 且下界/暮色/末地沿用历史文案（蒸汽/LV/HV），避免破坏用户认知。
if abbr == 'Ne' then
return string.format('下界(蒸汽, %.1f%%)', pcent)
end
if abbr == 'TF' then
return string.format('暮色森林(LV, %.1f%%)', pcent)
end
if abbr == 'ED' then
return string.format('末地(HV, %.1f%%)', pcent)
end
if abbr == 'EA' then
return string.format('末地小行星(HV, %.1f%%)', pcent)
end
if tier <= 0 then
return string.format('%s(%.1f%%)', name, pcent)
end
return string.format("%s('''T%d''', %.1f%%)", name, tier, pcent)
end
local function fetchUndergroundFluidRows()
-- 兼容新结构：{ undergroundfluids = { fluidKey = [{dimension,chance,...}] } }
return safeAggregate({
{ ['$match'] = { ['_id'] = 'Data:Gtundergroundfluid.json' } },
{ ['$project'] = { ['fluids'] = { ['$objectToArray'] = '$undergroundfluids' } } },
{ ['$unwind'] = '$fluids' },
{ ['$project'] = { ['fluid'] = '$fluids.k', ['entries'] = '$fluids.v' } },
{ ['$unwind'] = '$entries' },
{ ['$project'] = {
['_id'] = 0,
['fluid'] = '$fluid',
['dimension'] = '$entries.dimension',
['chance'] = '$entries.chance',
['minAmount'] = '$entries.minAmount',
['maxAmount'] = '$entries.maxAmount'
} }
})
end
local function collectMaterialKeys(veins, smallVeins)
local keys, seen = {}, {}
local function push(k)
k = trim(k)
if k ~= '' and not seen[k] then
seen[k] = true
table.insert(keys, k)
end
end
for _, v in ipairs(veins) do
push(v.primary)
push(v.secondary)
push(v.between)
push(v.sporadic)
end
for _, v in ipairs(smallVeins) do
push(v.material)
end
return keys
end
local function buildMaterialDisplayMaps(materialKeys)
local byMaterial = {}
local oreKeyByMaterial = {}
if #materialKeys == 0 then
return byMaterial, oreKeyByMaterial
end
-- Why: 按材料逐条查询会非常慢；这里先批量拿材料对象，再批量查矿石物品翻译名。
local mats = Database.queryMaterialsByNames and (Database.queryMaterialsByNames(materialKeys) or {}) or {}
local oreKeys, seenOre = {}, {}
for _, key in ipairs(materialKeys) do
local m = mats[key]
local zh = m and trim(m.LocalizedName) or ''
if zh == '' then
zh = key
end
byMaterial[key] = zh
local oreKey = normalizeKey(m and m.OrePrefixes and m.OrePrefixes.ore or '')
oreKeyByMaterial[key] = oreKey
if oreKey ~= '' and not seenOre[oreKey] then
seenOre[oreKey] = true
table.insert(oreKeys, oreKey)
end
end
local oreNameMap = {}
if #oreKeys > 0 then
local rows = Database.queryIngredients({ keys = oreKeys }) or {}
for _, oreKey in ipairs(oreKeys) do
local row = rows[oreKey]
if row and row.translatedName and row.translatedName ~= '' then
oreNameMap[oreKey] = row.translatedName
end
end
end
-- Why: 页面展示是“矿石名”而非材料名；优先取物品翻译名可以与 NEI 更一致。
-- How: 先查 oreKey 对应 translatedName，查不到再用“材料中文名 + 矿石”回退。
local byOre = {}
for _, material in ipairs(materialKeys) do
local oreKey = oreKeyByMaterial[material]
local oreName = oreKey ~= '' and oreNameMap[oreKey] or ''
if oreName == '' then
local fallback = byMaterial[material] or material
if mw.ustring.find(fallback, '矿石$') or mw.ustring.find(fallback, '矿砂$') then
oreName = fallback
else
oreName = fallback .. '矿石'
end
end
byOre[material] = oreName
end
return byMaterial, byOre
end
local function buildFluidNameMap(undergroundRows)
local keys, seen = {}, {}
for _, row in ipairs(undergroundRows) do
local raw = normalizeKey(row.fluid)
if raw ~= '' then
local k = 'fluid.' .. raw
if not seen[k] then
seen[k] = true
table.insert(keys, k)
end
end
end
local result = (#keys > 0) and (Database.queryIngredients({ keys = keys }) or {}) or {}
local out = {}
for _, row in ipairs(undergroundRows) do
local raw = normalizeKey(row.fluid)
local k = 'fluid.' .. raw
local d = result[k] or result[raw]
out[raw] = (d and d.translatedName and d.translatedName ~= '') and d.translatedName or raw
end
return out
end
local function normalizeVeinBaseName(name)
local n = trim(name)
if n == '' then
return nil
end
n = n:gsub('矿脉$', ''):gsub('矿$', ''):gsub('Vein$', '')
n = trim(n)
if n == '' then
return nil
end
return n
end
local function buildCache()
-- Why: 公共模块被多个业务模块复用，集中在这里一次建模，保证口径统一。
-- How: 按“原始数据 -> 映射字典 -> 按维度索引 -> 概率与排序”四步构建。
local dimMap = fetchDimensions()
local planetToDim, planetToDimLower, byAbbr = buildDimensionLookups(dimMap)
local oreRowsRaw = fetchDynamicDocValues('Data:Gtorevein.json')
local smallRowsRaw = fetchDynamicDocValues('Data:Gtsmallorevein.json')
local undergroundRows = fetchUndergroundFluidRows()
local oreRows = {}
for _, row in ipairs(oreRowsRaw) do
local v = row.entryValue or {}
table.insert(oreRows, {
entryKey = normalizeKey(row.entryKey),
key = normalizeKey(v.key or row.entryKey),
localizedName = trim(v.localizedName),
primary = trim(v.primary),
secondary = trim(v.secondary),
between = trim(v.between),
sporadic = trim(v.sporadic),
size = tonumber(v.size) or 0,
density = tonumber(v.density) or 0,
weight = tonumber(v.weight) or 0,
minY = tonumber(v.minY) or 0,
maxY = tonumber(v.maxY) or 0,
dims = v.dims or {}
})
end
local smallRows = {}
for _, row in ipairs(smallRowsRaw) do
local v = row.entryValue or {}
table.insert(smallRows, {
entryKey = normalizeKey(row.entryKey),
key = normalizeKey(v.key or row.entryKey),
material = trim(v.material),
amountPerChunk = tonumber(v.amountPerChunk) or 0,
minY = tonumber(v.minY) or 0,
maxY = tonumber(v.maxY) or 0,
dims = v.dims or {}
})
end
local materialKeys = collectMaterialKeys(oreRows, smallRows)
local materialZhMap, materialOreNameMap = buildMaterialDisplayMaps(materialKeys)
local fluidZhMap = buildFluidNameMap(undergroundRows)
local totalWeightByDim = {}
for _, row in ipairs(oreRows) do
for _, dim in ipairs(row.dims or {}) do
-- Why: 概率分母统一定义为“该维度所有矿脉权重总和”，
-- 与星系页现有概率口径保持一致。
totalWeightByDim[dim] = (totalWeightByDim[dim] or 0) + (row.weight or 0)
end
end
local veinsByDim = {}
local dimProbabilityByVeinKey = {}
for _, row in ipairs(oreRows) do
local baseName = normalizeVeinBaseName(row.localizedName)
if not baseName then
baseName = materialZhMap[row.primary] or row.primary or row.key
end
local displayName = baseName .. '矿脉'
dimProbabilityByVeinKey[row.key] = {}
for _, dim in ipairs(row.dims or {}) do
local total = totalWeightByDim[dim] or 0
-- How: 概率 = 当前矿脉权重 / 维度总权重。
local prob = (total > 0) and ((row.weight or 0) * 100.0 / total) or 0
dimProbabilityByVeinKey[row.key][dim] = prob
veinsByDim[dim] = veinsByDim[dim] or {}
table.insert(veinsByDim[dim], {
key = row.key,
name = displayName,
weight = row.weight,
probability = prob,
minY = row.minY,
maxY = row.maxY,
density = row.density,
size = row.size,
primary = materialOreNameMap[row.primary] or row.primary,
secondary = materialOreNameMap[row.secondary] or row.secondary,
between = materialOreNameMap[row.between] or row.between,
sporadic = materialOreNameMap[row.sporadic] or row.sporadic,
dims = row.dims
})
end
end
for _, list in pairs(veinsByDim) do
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
if a.weight == b.weight then
return (a.name or '') < (b.name or '')
end
return (a.weight or 0) > (b.weight or 0)
end)
end
local smallVeinsByDim = {}
for _, row in ipairs(smallRows) do
local oreName = materialOreNameMap[row.material] or materialZhMap[row.material] or row.material
local base = oreName:gsub('矿石$', ''):gsub('矿砂$', '')
local name = '贫瘠' .. base .. '矿'
for _, dim in ipairs(row.dims or {}) do
smallVeinsByDim[dim] = smallVeinsByDim[dim] or {}
table.insert(smallVeinsByDim[dim], {
key = row.key,
name = name,
ore = oreName,
amountPerChunk = row.amountPerChunk,
minY = row.minY,
maxY = row.maxY,
dims = row.dims
})
end
end
for _, list in pairs(smallVeinsByDim) do
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
return (a.name or '') < (b.name or '')
end)
end
local fluidTotalByDim = {}
for _, row in ipairs(undergroundRows) do
local dim = trim(row.dimension)
if dim ~= '' then
fluidTotalByDim[dim] = (fluidTotalByDim[dim] or 0) + (tonumber(row.chance) or 0)
end
end
local fluidsByDim = {}
for _, row in ipairs(undergroundRows) do
local dim = trim(row.dimension)
if dim ~= '' then
local rawFluid = normalizeKey(row.fluid)
local total = fluidTotalByDim[dim] or 0
local chance = tonumber(row.chance) or 0
fluidsByDim[dim] = fluidsByDim[dim] or {}
table.insert(fluidsByDim[dim], {
key = rawFluid,
name = fluidZhMap[rawFluid] or rawFluid,
chance = chance,
-- Why: 流体概率口径与矿脉同理，按维度内 chance 占比计算。
probability = (total > 0) and (chance * 100.0 / total) or 0,
minAmount = tonumber(row.minAmount) or 0,
maxAmount = tonumber(row.maxAmount) or 0
})
end
end
for _, list in pairs(fluidsByDim) do
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
if a.chance == b.chance then
return (a.name or '') < (b.name or '')
end
return (a.chance or 0) > (b.chance or 0)
end)
end
return {
-- dimensionsByAbbr: 维度元数据字典。
-- 示例: dimensionsByAbbr["Ve"] -> {localizedName="金星", tier=4, ...}
dimensionsByAbbr = dimMap,
-- planetToDim: 行星名称到维度缩写（精确大小写）。
-- 示例: planetToDim["金星"] == "Ve"
planetToDim = planetToDim,
-- planetToDimLower: 行星名称到维度缩写（小写归一化）。
-- 示例: planetToDimLower["venus"] == "Ve"
planetToDimLower = planetToDimLower,
-- byAbbr: 维度缩写集合，用于快速判断输入是否已是缩写。
-- 示例: byAbbr["Ow"] == true
byAbbr = byAbbr,
-- oreRows: 原始矿脉行（统一字段后的数组）。
-- 示例元素: {key="ore.mix.gold", weight=160, dims={"Ow","TF",...}, ...}
oreRows = oreRows,
-- smallRows: 原始贫瘠矿行。
-- 示例元素: {material="Iron", amountPerChunk=16, dims={"Ow","En"}, ...}
smallRows = smallRows,
-- materialZhMap: 材料英文键 -> 材料中文名。
-- 示例: materialZhMap["Iron"] == "铁"
materialZhMap = materialZhMap,

-- Author: gjfLeo
local getArgs = require("Module:Arguments").getArgs
local p = {}
function p.random(frame)
math.randomseed(tostring(os.clock()*1000000):reverse():sub(1, 7))
local a = frame.args[1] or getArgs(frame)[1]
local b = frame.args[2] or getArgs(frame)[2]
local min = b and tonumber(a) or 0
local max = (b and tonumber(b) or 999) or (a and tonumber(a)) or 999
return math.random(min, max)
end
function p.choose(frame)
local args = {}
local i = 1
while (frame.args[i] or getArgs(frame)[i]) do
table.insert(args, frame.args[i] or getArgs(frame)[i])
i = i + 1
end
if #args == 0 then return end
math.randomseed(tostring(os.clock()*1000000):reverse():sub(1, 7))
return args[math.random(#args)]
end
return p

mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"\n' -- res = res .. "|+ 机器类别与模板名对照表\n" res = res .. "! type字段 !! 对应模板名\n" for _, name in ipairs(names) do local templatePath = MACHINE_MAPPING[name] res = res .. "|-\n" res = res .. "| " .. name .. "\n" res = res .. "| " .. templatePath .. "\n" end res = res .. "|}" return res end --[[ 渲染函数：负责处理渲染逻辑与 Pager 包装。 @param data table: 需要渲染的配方数据数组 @param renderArgs table: 渲染配置，如 { ["use-pager"] = true, ["height"] = "300" } --]] function p.renderRecipe(frame, data, renderArgs) if not data or #data == 0 then error("存在相关物品，但未找到相关配方信息。若确定该配方存在，请检查配方类型名称。[[分类:缺失配方或模板的合成表模板]]") end local renderArgs = renderArgs or {} local results = {} local usePager = (renderArgs["use-pager"] and renderArgs["use-pager"] ~= "") local contentHeight = renderArgs["content-height"] local lang = renderArgs["lang"] local pagerId = "" -- local firstTemplateName = nil local validPages = 0 -- 1. 预遍历：判定分页合法性 -- 只有当用户要求分页，且数据中所有机器类型一致并存在对应模板时，才激活 Pager if usePager then local seed = tostring(os.clock()) .. tostring(math.random()) pagerId = "pager" .. mw.hash.hashValue('crc32', seed) -- 为pager生成唯一id for _, recipeData in ipairs(data) do local templateName = MACHINE_MAPPING[recipeData["机器类型"]] or FALLBACK_MACHINE if not templateName then usePager = false -- 缺失模板，降级为平铺渲染 break end -- if firstTemplateName == nil then -- firstTemplateName = templateName -- elseif templateName ~= firstTemplateName then -- usePager = false -- 机器类型不统一，降级为平铺渲染 -- break -- end validPages = validPages + 1 end end -- 2. 执行模板渲染 for i, recipeData in ipairs(data) do local templateName = MACHINE_MAPPING[recipeData["机器类型"]] or FALLBACK_MACHINE if templateName then -- 如果最终确定使用分页，注入分页参数 if usePager then recipeData["pager-id"] = pagerId recipeData["current-page"] = i recipeData["total-pages"] = validPages end -- 如果用户传入 content-height，则强制覆盖高度 if contentHeight and contentHeight ~= "" then recipeData["content-height"] = contentHeight end if lang then recipeData["lang"] = lang end if renderArgs["sync-tooltips-rendering"] and renderArgs["sync-tooltips-rendering"] ~= "" then recipeData["sync-tooltips-rendering"] = renderArgs["sync-tooltips-rendering"] end recipeData["steam"] = renderArgs["steam"] recipeData["oc"] = (renderArgs["oc"] and renderArgs["oc"] ~= "") and renderArgs["oc"] or "0" if (renderArgs["oc"] and renderArgs["oc"] ~= "") or (renderArgs["steam"] and renderArgs["steam"] ~= "") then recipeData["noted-title"] = 1 end table.insert(results, frame:expandTemplate{ title = templateName, args = recipeData }) else -- 兜底逻辑：如果找不到对应机器的模板 error("配方信息已找到，但未找到用于绘制配方类型 \"" .. tostring(recipeData["机器类型"]) .. "\" 的模板。[[分类:缺失配方或模板的合成表模板]]") end end -- 3. 组装输出 if usePager then local pagerArgs = { id = pagerId } -- 将渲染出的每一个机器模板作为匿名参数传入 GMPP for k, v in ipairs(results) do pagerArgs[k] = v end return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grid/GeneralMachineProcessPager', args = pagerArgs } else -- 正常平铺渲染 return table.concat(results) end end --[[ 默认入口函数：查库 -> 截取范围 -> 渲染 --]] function p.searchAndRenderRecipe(frame) local data = DatabaseInterfaces.searchRecipe(frame) local args = frame.args -- 检查是否使用了批量查询参数 if args.query and args.query ~= "" then local flattenedData = {} -- 遍历返回的外层数组（每次单独查询的结果集） for _, resultGroup in ipairs(data) do local recipesToMerge = resultGroup -- 兼容处理：如果某次查询启用了 detailedSearching，结果会被包在 {data = [...], total = ...} 中 if type(resultGroup) == "table" and resultGroup.data then recipesToMerge = resultGroup.data end -- 将内层数组（具体的配方）逐个提取并插入到新数组中 if type(recipesToMerge) == "table" then for _, recipe in ipairs(recipesToMerge) do table.insert(flattenedData, recipe) end end end -- 替换原有的 data，现在它是一个干净的一维数组了 data = flattenedData end -- 准备渲染参数对象 local renderArgs = { ["use-pager"] = args["use-pager"], ["content-height"] = args["content-height"], ["sync-tooltips-rendering"] = args["sync-tooltips-rendering"], ["lang"] = args["lang"], ["steam"] = args["steam"], ["oc"] = args["oc"], } -- 渲染 return p.renderRecipe(frame, data, renderArgs) end return p 复制展开

"-1" itemName = recipeData[nameKey] end if itemName and itemName ~= "" then local ncKey = nameKey .. "-不消耗" local nc = tonumber(recipeData[ncKey]) or 0 if nc == 0 then local amountKey = nameKey .. "-数量" local amount = tonumber(recipeData[amountKey]) or 1 local chanceKey = nameKey .. "-几率" local chance = (tonumber(recipeData[chanceKey]) or 100 ) / 100 local amount = tonumber(recipeData[amountKey]) or 1 local extraKey = nameKey .. '-1'] end if name and name ~= '' and not seen[name] then table.insert(out, name) seen[name] = true end end end return table.concat(out, ',') end return {input=names({'固体输入', '流体输入'}), output=names({'固体输出', '流体输出'}), type=data['机器类型']} end local function convert(frame, data, req) local itemMap = {} local rec = { name = req.name or data['机器类型'] or '未命名配方', type = data['机器类型'], time = tonumber(data['时间']) or 0, eut = tonumber(data['功率']) or 30, specialValue = data['特殊值'], machineTier = data['等级'], branch = req.branch or {}, branches = req.branches, hierarchy = req.hierarchy, config = req.config, inputs = {}, outputs = {}, fusion_threshold = data['启动能量'], assemblyLength = data['装配线长度'], databaseQuery=fullQuery(data) } extractSlots(data, '固体输入', rec.inputs, itemMap, false) extractSlots(data, '流体输入', rec.inputs, itemMap, true) extractSlots(data, '固体输出', rec.outputs, itemMap, false) extractSlots(data, '流体输出', rec.outputs, itemMap, true) local items = {} for name, isFluid in pairs(itemMap) do table.insert(items, {id = name, fluid = isFluid}) end return {recipe = rec, items = items, html = Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, {data}, {['sync-tooltips-rendering'] = '1'})} end local function payload(className, value) return '
' .. mw.text.encode(mw.text.jsonEncode(value)) .. '
' end local function readConfig(text) local ok, config = pcall(mw.text.jsonDecode, text or '') if not ok or type(config) ~= 'table' or type(config.recipeQuery) ~= 'table' then error('配置必须包含 recipeQuery 数组') end if #config.recipeQuery > 300 then error('沙盒最多支持 300 条配方') end return config end function p.initDataSource(frame) local parent = frame:getParent() local args = frame.args local raw = args[1] or (parent and parent.args[1]) local ok, config = pcall(readConfig, raw) if not ok then return '
' .. mw.text.encode(tostring(config)) .. '

'"' .. ' data-source-title="' .. mw.text.encode(title.prefixedText) .. '"' .. ' data-display-title="' .. mw.text.encode(display) .. '"' return '

    ' .. mw.uri.encode(raw, 'PATH') .. '
    ' .. '
      ' .. table.concat(templates) .. '
    ' .. '
    正在加载在线编辑沙盒。若未出现计算器，请点击上方“加载在线编辑沙盒”。
    ' end function p.search(frame) local ok, result = pcall(function() local q = mw.text.jsonDecode(mw.uri.decode(frame.args.q or '', 'PATH')) if type(q) ~= 'table' then error('查询参数无效') end local args = {limit='6', index=math.max(0, math.min(600, tonumber(q.index) or 0)), version=q.version or DEFAULT_VERSION} for _, key in ipairs({'input', 'output', 'type', 'preference'}) do if type(q[key]) == 'string' then if #q[key] > 400 then error('查询条件过长') end args[key] = mw.text.trim(q[key]) end end if (args.input or '') == '' and (args.output or '') == '' then error('请填写输入或输出物料') end local found = DBInterface.searchRecipe({args=args}) local out = {results={}, offset=args.index, version=args.version} for i, data in ipairs(found) do local query = fullQuery(data) if args.preference and args.preference ~= '' then query.preference = args.preference end query.name = data['机器类型'] .. ' · ' .. (args.output and args.output ~= '' and args.output or args.input or '') local entry = convert(frame, data, query) entry.query = query table.insert(out.results, entry) end return out end) if not ok then return payload('rce-search-data', {error=tostring(result)}) end -- Recipe.renderRecipe contains wikitext links. Let MediaWiki finish rendering -- cards outside the JSON, otherwise link expansion inserts unescaped quotes. local cards = {} for i, entry in ipairs(result.results) do table.insert(cards, '
    ' .. entry.html .. '
    ') entry.html = nil end return payload('rce-search-data', result) .. '

local p = {}
local DB = require('Module:DatabaseInterfaces')
function p.query(frame)
local q = frame.args.query or '[{"type":"核聚变反应堆","limit":"5"}]'
local results = DB.searchRecipe({ args = { query = q } })
local out = {}
for i, recipeList in ipairs(results) do
if recipeList and #recipeList > 0 then
local r = recipeList[1]
local item = {
machine = r["机器类型"] or "",
time = tonumber(r["时间"]) or 0,
eut = tonumber(r["功率"]) or 0,
tier = r["等级"] or "",
startup = tonumber(r["启动能量"] or "0") or 0,
special = r["特殊值"] or "",
}
for j = 1, 10 do
local fi = r["流体输入"..j]
if fi and fi ~= "" then
local amt = tonumber(r["流体输入"..j.."-数量"]) or 0
if not item.inputs then item.inputs = {} end
table.insert(item.inputs, {name=fi, amount=amt})
end
local fo = r["流体输出"..j]
if fo and fo ~= "" then
local amt = tonumber(r["流体输出"..j.."-数量"]) or 0
if not item.outputs then item.outputs = {} end
table.insert(item.outputs, {name=fo, amount=amt})
end
end
table.insert(out, item)
end
end
return mw.text.jsonEncode(out)
end

}
for j = 1, 10 do
local fi = r["流体输入"..j]
if fi and fi ~= "" then
local amt = tonumber(r["流体输入"..j.."-数量"]) or 0
if not item.inputs then item.inputs = {} end
table.insert(item.inputs, {name=fi, amount=amt})
end
local fo = r["流体输出"..j]
if fo and fo ~= "" then
local amt = tonumber(r["流体输出"..j.."-数量"]) or 0
if not item.outputs then item.outputs = {} end
table.insert(item.outputs, {name=fo, amount=amt})
end
end
table.insert(out, item)
end
end
end
return mw.text.jsonEncode(out)
end
return p

local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local p = {}
function p.render(frame)
local args = getArgs(frame)
local tabParams = p.parseTabParams(args)
if #tabParams == 0 then
return ''
end
local class = args.class or 'nav-tabs'
local onClass = 'active'
local html = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('tabber richtab')
local header = html:tag('ul'):addClass('nav tabber-filter ' .. class):attr('role', 'tablist')
local headerType = args.prefix or 'richtab'
for tabIndex, tabItem in ipairs(tabParams) do
local li = header:tag('li'):addClass('tabber-filter-item' .. (tabIndex == 1 and ' ' .. onClass or '')):attr('data-type', headerType):attr('data-' .. headerType, tabIndex):wikitext(tabItem.header)
end
local content = html:tag('div'):addClass('tab-content tabber-content')
for tabIndex, tabItem in ipairs(tabParams) do
local div = content:tag('div'):addClass('tab-pane tabber-item'):attr('data-' .. headerType, tabIndex)
div:wikitext(tabItem.content)
end
return html
end
function p.parseTabParams(args)
local index = 1
local parsedParams = {}
while args[index] ~= nil and args[index + 1] ~= nil do
table.insert(parsedParams, {
header = args[index],
content = args[index + 1],
})
index = index + 2
end
return parsedParams
end
return p

mw.text.trim(tostring(value)) end local function getArgs(frame) local args = {} -- 从模板调用时读取模板参数 local parent = frame:getParent() if parent and parent.args then for k, v in pairs(parent.args) do args[k] = v end end -- 同时允许直接 #invoke，且直接传入的参数优先 for k, v in pairs(frame.args or {}) do if trim(v) ~= "" then args[k] = v end end return args end local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue, fallback) local n = tonumber(value) if not n then return fallback end if n < minValue then return minValue end if n > maxValue then return maxValue end return n end local function makeLink(target, text) target = trim(target) text = trim(text) if target == "" then return text end if target:match("^https?://") then return string.format("[%s %s]", target, text) end return string.format("[[%s|%s]]", target, text) end local function parseColumns(value) local raw = trim(value) -- 不填写（或填写“自动”）时沿用自动排版 if raw == "" or raw == "自动" then return nil end local n = tonumber(raw) if not n then return nil end n = math.floor(n) if n < 1 then n = 1 elseif n > 4 then n = 4 end return n end -- ========================================================= -- 主颜色 -- ========================================================= local COLOR_PRESETS = { -- 默认 / 中性色 ["银灰"] = "#626b73", ["银灰色"] = "#626b73", ["银"] = "#626b73", ["灰"] = "#626b73", ["灰色"] = "#626b73", -- 蓝色系 ["蓝"] = "#356a96", ["蓝色"] = "#356a96", ["科技蓝"] = "#356a96", -- 紫色系 ["紫"] = "#66508f", ["紫色"] = "#66508f", -- 红色系 ["红"] = "#914a4a", ["红色"] = "#914a4a", -- 绿色系 ["绿"] = "#4f7657", ["绿色"] = "#4f7657", -- 青色系 ["青"] = "#39767a", ["青色"] = "#39767a", -- 橙色系 ["橙"] = "#a06338", ["橙色"] = "#a06338", -- 金色系 ["金"] = "#8b7138", ["金色"] = "#8b7138", -- 黑色系 ["黑"] = "#40454a", ["黑色"] = "#40454a", } local DEFAULT_COLOR = COLOR_PRESETS["银灰"] local function resolveColor(value) local color = trim(value) -- 未填写时默认银灰 if color == "" then return DEFAULT_COLOR end -- 中文预设 if COLOR_PRESETS[color] then return COLOR_PRESETS[color] end -- 允许高级用户直接传入十六进制颜色 if color:match("^#%x%x%x$") or color:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return color end -- 无法识别时回退到银灰 return DEFAULT_COLOR end -- ========================================================= -- 参数读取 -- ========================================================= local function getNumberedValue(args, number, suffix) suffix = suffix or "" local numericKey local stringKey = tostring(number) .. suffix if suffix == "" then numericKey = number end if numericKey and args[numericKey] ~= nil then return trim(args[numericKey]) end return trim(args[stringKey]) end local function collectCards(args) local cards = {} local indexes = {} local seen = {} -- 读取完整模式： -- |1=物品 -- |1说明=... -- |1标签=... -- |1链接=... -- |1图标=... for key, value in pairs(args) do local number if type(key) == "number" then number = key elseif type(key) == "string" then number = tonumber(key:match("^(%d+)$")) end if number and number >= 1 and trim(value) ~= "" and not seen[number] then table.insert(indexes, number) seen[number] = true end end table.sort(indexes) for _, number in ipairs(indexes) do local name = getNumberedValue(args, number) if name ~= "" then local link = getNumberedValue(args, number, "链接") local icon = getNumberedValue(args, number, "图标") local desc = getNumberedValue(args, number, "说明") local tag = getNumberedValue(args, number, "标签") if link == "" then link = name end if icon == "" then icon = name end table.insert(cards, { name = name, link = link, icon = icon, desc = desc, tag = tag, }) end end -- 简洁模式： -- |物品=A,B,C,D -- 仅在没有编号项目时启用 if #cards == 0 then local rawList = trim(args["物品"]) if rawList ~= "" then rawList = rawList:gsub("，", ",") for item in rawList:gmatch("[^,]+") do local name = trim(item) if name ~= "" then table.insert(cards, { name = name, link = name, icon = name, desc = "", tag = "", }) end end end end return cards end -- ========================================================= -- 图标 -- ========================================================= local function renderIcon(frame, iconName, linkTarget, size) -- 图标、物品数据与链接解析交给现有 Template:Icon return frame:expandTemplate { title = "Icon", args = { [1] = iconName, size = tostring(size), link = linkTarget, } } end local function renderEditButton(parent, target) target = trim(target) if target == "" then return end local title = mw.title.new(target) if not title then return end local button = parent:tag("span") :addClass("showcase-edit-button") :addClass("plainlinks") :attr("style", "flex:0 0 auto") -- 沿用 Navbar 的写法， 用外链维基文本生成链接 button:wikitext("[" .. title:fullUrl("action=edit") .. " ") local label = button:tag("span") :addClass("showcase-edit-button-label") :attr("title", "编辑“" .. title.prefixedText .. "”") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "display:inline-flex", "align-items:center", "gap:4px", "padding:4px 9px", "box-sizing:border-box", "color:#ffffff", "background:rgba(0,0,0,0.08)", "border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.55)", "border-radius:0", "font-size:87%", "font-weight:600", "line-height:1.4", "text-decoration:none", "white-space:nowrap", }, ";") ) label:tag("span") :attr("aria-hidden", "true") :wikitext("✎") label:wikitext(" 编辑") button:wikitext("]") end -- ========================================================= -- 单张卡片 -- ========================================================= local function renderCard(frame, parent, card, options) local accent = options.accent local iconSize = options.iconSize local node = parent:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-card") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "display:flex", "align-items:center", "gap:12px", "min-width:0", "min-height:82px", "padding:10px 12px", "box-sizing:border-box", "background:#f6f7f8", "border:1px solid #b8bec5", }, ";") ) -- 图标区域 local iconBox = node:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-card-icon") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "flex:0 0 " .. tostring(iconSize + 8) .. "px", "text-align:center", "line-height:1", }, ";") ) iconBox:wikitext( renderIcon(frame, card.icon, card.link, iconSize) ) -- 文字区域 local body = node:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-card-body") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "flex:1 1 auto", "min-width:0", "line-height:1.4", }, ";") ) -- 名称 body:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-card-title") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "font-size:1.03em", "font-weight:700", "line-height:1.3", }, ";") ) :wikitext(makeLink(card.link, card.name)) -- 分类标签：不用胶囊，只保留一行强调色文字 if card.tag ~= "" then body:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-card-tag") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "margin-top:2px", "font-size:78%", "line-height:1.35", "font-weight:600", "color:" .. accent, }, ";") ) :wikitext(card.tag) end -- 说明 if card.desc ~= "" then body:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-card-desc") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "margin-top:4px", "font-size:88%", "line-height:1.45", "color:#626a73", }, ";") ) :wikitext(card.desc) end end -- ========================================================= -- 主入口 -- ========================================================= function p.main(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local cards = collectCards(args) if #cards == 0 then return 'Showcase：没有提供展示项目。' end local title = trim(args["标题"]) local intro = trim(args["简介"]) local editTarget = trim(args["编辑链接"]) if title == "" then title = "内容展示" end -- 新参数优先使用 |主颜色= -- 旧的 |主题色= 继续兼容 local colorArg = trim(args["主颜色"]) if colorArg == "" then colorArg = trim(args["主题色"]) end local accent = resolveColor(colorArg) local cardWidth = clamp( args["卡片宽度"], 160, 420, 240 ) local iconSize = clamp( args["图标大小"], 24, 96, 56 ) -- |列数=1～4 表示“最大列数”，而不是强制列数。 -- 卡片会优先保持 |卡片宽度= 指定的最小宽度；空间不足时自动减少列数。 local columns = parseColumns(args["列数"]) -- 兼容性回退： -- 不支持 CSS min()/max() 的浏览器仍可按卡片宽度自动换列。 local gridColumnsFallback = "repeat(auto-fit,minmax(" .. tostring(cardWidth) .. "px,1fr))" local gridColumnsResponsive if columns then local totalGap = (columns - 1) * 8 -- 一行最多 columns 列；卡片尽量不低于 cardWidth。 -- 如果容器连 cardWidth 都放不下，则单列收缩到 100%。 gridColumnsResponsive = "repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,max(" .. tostring(cardWidth) .. "px,calc((100% - " .. tostring(totalGap) .. "px) / " .. tostring(columns) .. "))),1fr))" else -- 自动模式没有列数上限，只按卡片最小宽度决定能排几列。 gridColumnsResponsive = "repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%," .. tostring(cardWidth) .. "px),1fr))" end -- 整体展板 local root = mw.html.create("div") :addClass("showcase") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "margin:1em 0", "overflow:hidden", "background:#eef0f2", "border:2px solid #6b737c", }, ";") ) -- 标题区：纯色、直角、无渐变 local header = root:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-header") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "display:flex", "align-items:center", "justify-content:space-between", "flex-wrap:wrap", "gap:8px 12px", "padding:9px 13px", "color:#ffffff", "background:" .. accent, "border-bottom:2px solid #3f464d", }, ";") ) local headerText = header:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-header-text") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "flex:1 1 12em", "min-width:0", }, ";") ) headerText:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-title") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "font-size:1.15em", "font-weight:700", "line-height:1.3", }, ";") ) :wikitext(title) if intro ~= "" then headerText:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-intro") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "margin-top:3px", "font-size:87%", "line-height:1.4", "color:#f0f0f0", }, ";") ) :wikitext(intro) end renderEditButton(header, editTarget) -- 卡片网格 local grid = root:tag("div") :addClass("showcase-grid") :attr( "style", table.concat({ "display:grid", -- 第一条是旧浏览器回退；支持现代 CSS 的浏览器使用第二条。 "grid-template-columns:" .. gridColumnsFallback, "grid-template-columns:" .. gridColumnsResponsive, "gap:8px", "padding:9px", }, ";") ) for _, card in ipairs(cards) do renderCard( frame, grid, card, { accent = accent, iconSize = iconSize, } ) end return tostring(root) end return p 复制展开

-- 通用
local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local p = {}
-- 设定好轮播区尺寸，图片自动居中
p.main = function (frame)
local params = p.check_params(getArgs(frame))
if #params.images_list > 0 then
return p.create_swap(params)
else
return '【没有有效参数，请检查】'
end
end
p.check_params = function (args)
-- 生成新参数
local params = {
images_list = {},
speed = tonumber(args.speed) or 3,
width = tonumber(args.width) or -1,
height = tonumber(args.height) or -1,
}
-- 检查图片参数
for i, v in ipairs(args) do
local file_name = v or ''
local link = args['l'..i] or args['link'..i] or args.link or ''
local width = tonumber(args['w'..i] or args['width'..i] or '') or -1
local className = args['c'..i] or args['class'..i] or ''
if file_name ~= '' then
table.insert(params.images_list, {
name=file_name,
link=link,
width=width,
className=className
})
end
end
return params
end
p.create_swap = function (params)
local html = mw.html.create()
local top_div = html:tag('div'):addClass('swap-images'):attr('data-speed', params.speed)
if (params.width > -1) then
top_div:css('width', params.width..'px')
end
if (params.height > -1) then
top_div:css('height', params.height..'px')
end
for _, image_info in ipairs(params.images_list) do
local div = top_div:tag('div')
if (image_info.className ~= '') then
div:addClass(image_info.className)
end
local width = ''
if (image_info.width > -1) then
width = image_info.width .. 'px'
end
div:wikitext('[[File:'..image_info.name..(width ~= '' and '|'..width..'px' or '')..'|link='..image_info.link..']]')
end
return html
end
-- 内部调用
p.main_sized = function(frame)
local params = p.check_params(getArgs(frame))
if #params.images_list > 0 then
return p.create_swap(params)
else
return '【没有有效参数，请检查】'
end
end
p.check_params_sized = function(args)
-- 生成新参数
local params = {
images_list = {},
speed = tonumber(args.speed) or 3,
width = tonumber(args.width) or -1,
}
-- 检查图片参数
for i, v in ipairs(args) do
local file_name = v or ''
local link = args['l' .. i] or args['link' .. i] or args.link or ''
if file_name ~= '' then
table.insert(params.images_list, {
n = file_name,
l = link
})
end
end
return params
end
p.create_swap_sized = function(params)
local html = mw.html.create()
local top_div = html:tag('div'):addClass('swap-images'):attr('data-speed', params.speed)
for _, image_info in ipairs(params.images_list) do
top_div:wikitext('[[File:' ..
image_info.n .. (params.width > -1 and '|' .. params.width .. 'px' or '') ..
'|link=' .. image_info.l .. '|class=img-fit]]')
end
return html
end
p.split_swap = function(img, pre, suf, link, size)
local deli = ','
link = link or ''
local params = {
images_list = {},
speed = 3,
width = size or -1,
}
for _, file_name in ipairs(mw.text.split(img, deli)) do
file_name = tostring(file_name)
if file_name ~= '' then
file_name = pre .. file_name .. suf
table.insert(params.images_list, {
n = file_name,
l = link
})
end
end
return p.create_swap_sized(params)
end
return p

"=" .. trim(content)) return true end local function appendIndexedTabs(parts, args) local count = 0 for index = 1, 100 do local label = args["tab" .. index] or args["标签" .. index] or args["title" .. index] local content = args["content" .. index] or args["内容" .. index] if label ~= nil or content ~= nil then if appendTab(parts, label, content) then count = count + 1 end elseif index > 20 then break end end return count end local function appendPairTabs(parts, args) local count = 0 local index = 1 while args[index] ~= nil do if appendTab(parts, args[index], args[index + 1]) then count = count + 1 end index = index + 2 end return count end function p.render(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local parts = {} local body = args.body or args.content or args.tabs local extraClass = trim(args.class or args.extraClass or args["额外类"]) local class = "homepage-overview" if extraClass ~= "" then extraClass = extraClass:gsub("[^%w%s_-]", "") class = class .. ', ''):gsub('
$', '') raw = mw.text.trim(raw) local lines = mw.text.split(raw, '\n') local html = mw.html.create() local currentTable for _, line in ipairs(lines) do line = mw.text.trim(line) local prefix = mw.ustring.sub(line, 1, 2) if line:sub(1, 2) == '{|' then currentTable = html:tag('table') local attrs = line:match('{|%s*(.-)%s*$') if attrs then for k, v in mw.ustring.gmatch(attrs, '([%w-]+)="(.-)"') do currentTable:attr(k, v) end end elseif line:sub(1, 2) == '|+' then currentTable:tag('caption'):wikitext(line:sub(3)) elseif line:sub(1, 2) == '|-' then currentRow = currentTable:tag('tr') elseif line:sub(1, 2) == '||' or line:sub(1, 1) == '|' then for cell in mw.text.gsplit(line:sub(2), '||', true) do currentRow:tag('td'):wikitext(cell) end elseif line:sub(1, 2) == '!!' or line:sub(1, 1) == '!' then for cell in mw.text.gsplit(line:sub(2), '!!', true) do currentRow:tag('th'):wikitext(cell) end elseif line:sub(1, 2) == '|}' then end end return tostring(html) end function p.templateTables(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local start = string.format( '', args["class"] or "wikitable", args["style"] or args["css"] or "" ) -- 如果没有传入具体表头参数，只返回 table 开头 if args[1] == nil then return start end local str = start .. ""; end local function _TemplateRow(args, isTitle) local str = ""; local i = 1; local all_s = args["all_s"] while(args[i] ~= nil) do local tag = isTitle and "th" or "td" local current_s = args["s" .. i] local final_s = "" if all_s and current_s then final_s = all_s .. ";" .. current_s elseif all_s then final_s = all_s elseif current_s then final_s = current_s end local style = final_s ~= "" and string.format(' style="%s"', final_s) or "" local colspan = args["c" .. i] and string.format(' colspan="%s"', args["c" .. i]) or "" local rowspan = args["r" .. i] and string.format(' rowspan="%s"', args["r" .. i]) or "" str = str .. string.format('<%s%s%s%s>%s', tag, style, colspan, rowspan, args[i], tag); i = i + 1; end return str .. '
§7' .. ingredient.originalName end if ingredient and isGiven(ingredient.mod) then out = out .. '
§9§o' .. ingredient.mod end if doAppendQuery then return appendQueryButtons(name, out) else return out end end -- 构建多内容 tooltip 表。 -- 如果 ingredient 包含 tooltipsShift/tooltipsCtrl/tooltipsShiftAndCtrl， -- 则为每个存在的变体生成格式化 HTML 并附加 kbd 按钮。 -- @return table { default=html, shift=html|nil, ctrl=html|nil, shiftAndCtrl=html|nil } -- 若只有默认 tooltips，shift/ctrl/shiftAndCtrl 键为 nil。 -- 构建多内容 tooltip 数据表（不含 kbd，kbd 由 anchorTooltip 统一附加）。 function p.buildMultiVariantTooltip(ingredient, fallbackName) local name = fallbackName or '' if ingredient and isGiven(ingredient.translatedName) then name = ingredient.translatedName end local function buildOne(tooltipsField) local ing = {} if ingredient then for k, v in pairs(ingredient) do ing[k] = v end end ing.tooltips = tooltipsField return p.buildTooltipFromIngredient(ing, name) end local result = {} result.default = p.formatMinecraftStyle(buildOne(ingredient and ingredient.tooltips)) if isGiven(ingredient and ingredient.tooltipsShift) then result.shift = p.formatMinecraftStyle(buildOne(ingredient.tooltipsShift)) end if isGiven(ingredient and ingredient.tooltipsCtrl) then result.ctrl = p.formatMinecraftStyle(buildOne(ingredient.tooltipsCtrl)) end if isGiven(ingredient and ingredient.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl) then result['shift-and-ctrl'] = p.formatMinecraftStyle(buildOne(ingredient.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl)) end return result end -- 根据 tooltips table 中存在哪些变体，生成统一的 kbd 按钮 HTML。 -- 规则：Shift 按钮需要 shift 或 shift-and-ctrl 至少一个存在；Ctrl 同理。 local function buildKbd(tooltips) local hasShift = isGiven(tooltips.shift) or isGiven(tooltips['shift-and-ctrl']) local hasCtrl = isGiven(tooltips.ctrl) or isGiven(tooltips['shift-and-ctrl']) local kbdShift = hasShift and 'Shift' or '' local kbdCtrl = hasCtrl and 'Ctrl' or '' local parts = {} if kbdShift ~= '' then table.insert(parts, kbdShift) end if kbdCtrl ~= '' then table.insert(parts, kbdCtrl) end return #parts > 0 and ('
' .. table.concat(parts, ' ')) or '' end -- 锚定函数：将 target 内容与 tooltip 数据绑定为 NEI-tooltip 结构。 -- 这是全站生成 .nei-tt 相关 HTML 的唯一入口。kbd 按钮在此统一附加。 -- @param target string 被锚定的可见内容（HTML） -- @param tooltips string|table 单 § 文本 或 {default=html, shift=html|nil, …} -- @return string 完整的 .nei-tt 包裹 HTML function p.anchorTooltip(target, tooltips) if type(tooltips) ~= 'table' and not isGiven(tooltips) then return target end local root = mw.html.create('span') :addClass('nei-tt') :wikitext(target) if type(tooltips) == 'table' then local kbd = buildKbd(tooltips) for _, variant in ipairs({'default', 'shift', 'ctrl', 'shift-and-ctrl'}) do if tooltips[variant] then root:tag('span') :addClass('nei-' .. variant .. ' nei-tt-style') :wikitext(tooltips[variant] .. kbd) end end else root:tag('span') :addClass('nei-default nei-tt-style') :wikitext(p.formatMinecraftStyle(tooltips)) end return tostring(root) end -- 向后兼容别名 function p.wrapSync(contentWikitext, tooltips) return p.anchorTooltip(contentWikitext, tooltips) end -- 构建异步 JSON tooltip 数据（Lua 不做任何拼装，只把原始数据放进 JSON，JS 负责全部渲染） -- @param ingredient 物品数据（tooltips / tooltipsShift 等，可选） -- @param environment 配方上下文（name / chance / NC / extra / amount / liquid / mod / originalName，均可选） function p.buildTooltipJSON(ingredient, environment) environment = environment or {} local function def(val, dflt) if val == nil then return nil end if dflt ~= nil and val == dflt then return nil end return val end local json = { name = environment.name or (ingredient and ingredient.translatedName) or '', tooltips = {}, chance = def(environment.chance, 100), NC = def(environment.NC, 0), extra = def(environment.extra, 1), amount = def(environment.amount, 1), liquid = def(environment.liquid, ''), mod = environment.mod or (ingredient and ingredient.mod), originalName = environment.originalName or (ingredient and ingredient.originalName), } local function escape(s) if not s then return nil end return (s:gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">")) end if ingredient and ingredient.aspect then json.aspect = ingredient.aspect end if ingredient and isGiven(ingredient.tooltips) then json.tooltips["default"] = escape(ingredient.tooltips) end if ingredient and isGiven(ingredient.tooltipsShift) then json.tooltips["shift"] = escape(ingredient.tooltipsShift) end if ingredient and isGiven(ingredient.tooltipsCtrl) then json.tooltips["ctrl"] = escape(ingredient.tooltipsCtrl) end if ingredient and isGiven(ingredient.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl) then json.tooltips["shiftAndCtrl"] = escape(ingredient.tooltipsShiftAndCtrl) end if next(json.tooltips) == nil then json.tooltips = nil end return mw.text.jsonEncode(json) end return p 复制展开

function p.sub(str,length)
local listAddI = {[0] = 0,[1] = 2, [2] = 1};
if not length or length <= 0 then return str;end -- 只有length>1才尝试截
-- local str1 = string.gsub(str,",","");
local arr = {};
local str2 = string.rep("i",listAddI[#str % 3]) .. str
for i = 1, #str2/3 do
arr[i] = string.sub(str2,i*3-2,i*3);
end
arr[1] = string.gsub(arr[1],"i","");
return table.concat(arr,",");
end
-- {{#invoke:Util|delPng|文本}}
function p.delPng(frame)
local input = frame.args[1];
if not input then return "";end
if string.sub(input,-4) == ".png" then return string.sub(input,1,-5);end
return input;

-- 辅助函数：解析 YYMMDD 字符串
local function parse_yymmdd(date_str)
-- 确保输入是6位数字
if not date_str or not tostring(date_str):match("^%d%d%d%d%d%d$") then
return nil, "格式错误（需为6位数字，如 230512）"
end
local yy = tonumber(date_str:sub(1, 2))
local mm = tonumber(date_str:sub(3, 4))
local dd = tonumber(date_str:sub(5, 6))
-- 年份自动判定逻辑：
-- 00-69 判定为 2000-2069
-- 70-99 判定为 1970-1999
local yyyy = (yy >= 70) and (1900 + yy) or (2000 + yy)
-- 构造时间表
local time_table = {year = yyyy, month = mm, day = dd, hour = 0, min = 0, sec = 0}
local timestamp = os.time(time_table)
-- 验证日期是否合法（例如防止 02-30 这种日期）
local check = os.date("*t", timestamp)
if check.month ~= mm or check.day ~= dd then
return nil, "无效日期（如2月30日）"
end
return timestamp
end
-- 供维基文本调用的主函数
function p.diffYYMMDD(frame)
-- 获取参数，支持 {{#invoke:DateDiff|diff|YYMMDD1|YYMMDD2}}
local args = frame.args
if not args[1] or not args[2] then
args = frame:getParent().args
end
local t1, err1 = parse_yymmdd(args[1])
local t2, err2 = parse_yymmdd(args[2])
-- 如果解析失败，返回错误信息
if not t1 then return "错误1: " .. err1 end
if not t2 then return "错误2: " .. err2 end
-- 计算差异（秒转换为天）
local diff_seconds = os.difftime(t2, t1)
local diff_days = math.floor(diff_seconds / 86400)
-- 返回绝对值（如果你需要区分先后，可以去掉 math.abs）
return math.abs(diff_days)
end
return p

-- Function allowing for consistent treatment of boolean-like wikitext input.
-- It works similarly to the template {{yesno}}.
return function (val, default)
-- If your wiki uses non-ascii characters for any of "yes", "no", etc., you
-- should replace "val:lower()" with "mw.ustring.lower(val)" in the
-- following line.
val = type(val) == 'string' and val:lower() or val
if val == nil then
return nil
elseif val == true
or val == 'yes'
or val == 'y'
or val == 'true'
or val == '是'
or tonumber(val) == 1
then
return true
elseif val == false
or val == 'no'
or val == 'n'
or val == 'false'
or val == '否'
or tonumber(val) == 0
then
return false
else
return default
end
end

} local TABX_ID = { ['$regex'] = 'Data:单方块机器.tabx#.*' } local function trim(s) if not s then return nil end s = mw.text.trim(s) if s == "" then return nil end return s end -- 兼容传入列表 local function getTypeArg(frame) local value = trim(frame.args.type) or trim(frame.args[1]) local parent = frame:getParent() if not value and parent then value = trim(parent.args.type) or trim(parent.args[2]) or trim(parent.args[1]) end return value end local function splitTypes(value) local types = {} value = trim(value) if not value then return types end for part in mw.ustring.gmatch(value, "[^,，]+") do part = trim(part) if part then table.insert(types, part) end end return types end local function queryByType(machineType) if not machineType or machineType == "" then return nil end return mw.huiji.db.findOne({ ['_id'] = TABX_ID, type = machineType }) end local function queryByTypes(value) local docs = {} local missing = {} for _, machineType in ipairs(splitTypes(value)) do local doc = queryByType(machineType) if doc then table.insert(docs, doc) else table.insert(missing, machineType) end end return docs, missing end local function collectEntries(doc) if not doc then return {} end local entries = {} for _, tier in ipairs(TIERS) do local name = doc[tier] if name then table.insert(entries, { type = doc.type, tier = tier, name = name }) end end return entries end local function collectEntriesFromDocs(docs) local entries = {} for _, doc in ipairs(docs) do for _, entry in ipairs(collectEntries(doc)) do table.insert(entries, entry) end end return entries end function p.findType(name) if not name then return nil end local docs = mw.huiji.db.find({ ['_id'] = TABX_ID }) for _, doc in ipairs(docs) do if doc.type and doc.type == name then return doc.type end end return nil end function p.list(frame) local typeArg = getTypeArg(frame) local docs, missing = queryByTypes(typeArg) if #docs == 0 then return mw.text.jsonEncode({ error = "未找到机器类型：" .. (typeArg or "") }) end local result = {} for _, doc in ipairs(docs) do for _, entry in ipairs(collectEntries(doc)) do if #docs == 1 then table.insert(result, { tier = entry.tier, name = entry.name }) else table.insert(result, { type = entry.type, tier = entry.tier, name = entry.name }) end end end if #missing > 0 then return mw.text.jsonEncode({ result = result, missing = missing }) end return mw.text.jsonEncode(result) end function p.IconList(frame) local typeArg = getTypeArg(frame) local docs = queryByTypes(typeArg) if #docs == 0 then return "" end -- 收集所有实际存在的电压等级，按 TIERS 顺序排列 local usedTiers = {} for _, tier in ipairs(TIERS) do for _, doc in ipairs(docs) do if doc[tier] then table.insert(usedTiers, tier) break end end end if #usedTiers == 0 then return "" end local headerCells = {} for _, tier in ipairs(usedTiers) do table.insert(headerCells, "" .. mw.text.encode(tier) .. "") end local htmlParts = {} table.insert(htmlParts, '') table.insert(htmlParts, "" .. table.concat(headerCells) .. "") for _, doc in ipairs(docs) do local dataCells = {} for _, tier in ipairs(usedTiers) do local name = doc[tier] if name then local iconHtml = frame:expandTemplate{ title = "DBIcon", args = { name } } table.insert(dataCells, "") else table.insert(dataCells, "") end end table.insert(htmlParts, "" .. table.concat(dataCells) .. "") end table.insert(htmlParts, "
" .. iconHtml .. "
") local html = table.concat(htmlParts) return frame:expandTemplate{ title = "DatabaseWrapper", args = { html = html } } end function p.Recipe(frame) local typeArg = getTypeArg(frame) local docs = queryByTypes(typeArg) local entries = collectEntriesFromDocs(docs) if #entries == 0 then return "" end local earlyItems = {} local mainItems = {} for _, e in ipairs(entries) do local item = { output = e.name, type = "有序合成,有序奥术合成,奥术注魔,组装机,装配线加工" } if e.tier == "青铜" or e.tier == "钢" then table.insert(earlyItems, item) else table.insert(mainItems, item) end end local out = {} if #earlyItems > 0 then table.insert(out, frame:expandTemplate{ title = "Recipe", args = { ["use-pager"] = "1", ["async-rendering"] = "1", query = mw.text.jsonEncode(earlyItems) }, }) end if #mainItems > 0 then table.insert(out, frame:expandTemplate{ title = "Recipe", args = { ["use-pager"] = "1", ["async-rendering"] = "1", query = mw.text.jsonEncode(mainItems) }, }) end return table.concat(out, "\n") end function p.Tabber(frame) local typeArg = getTypeArg(frame) local docs = queryByTypes(typeArg) local entries = collectEntriesFromDocs(docs) if #entries == 0 then return "" end local args = {} local multiType = #docs > 1 for i, e in ipairs(entries) do local label = e.tier if multiType then label = (e.type or "") .. " " .. e.tier end args[i] = label .. "," .. e.name end return frame:expandTemplate{ title = "ImageRichTab", args = args } end return p 复制展开

local override = getOverride(frame, '启用数学公式')
if override == '是' then
return '1'
elseif override == '否' then
return ''
end
local source = getPageSource()
local markers = { '$$', '\\frac', '\\(', '\\[' }
for _, marker in ipairs(markers) do
if source:find(marker, 1, true) then
return '1'
end
end
if source:find('%$[^%$\n]+%$') then
return '1'
end
local lowerSource = source:lower()
if lowerSource:find('{{%s*math[%s|}]')
or lowerSource:find('{{%s*mathvar[%s|}]') then
return '1'
end
return ''
end
function p.hasReferences(frame)
local override = getOverride(frame, '显示注释')
if override == '是' then
return '1'
elseif override == '否' then
return ''
end
local source = getPageSource():lower()
if source:find('<ref[%s/>]')
or source:find('{{%s*efn[%s|}]')
or source:find('{{%s*refn[%s|}]') then
return '1'
end
return ''
end
return p

text: 此模块的文档可以在模块:搅拌烧制冷却流程/doc创建 local p = {} local DatabaseInterfaces = require('Module:DatabaseInterfaces') local GetCoil = require('Module:GetCoil') local Recipe = require('Module:Recipe') -- 常见的保护气原名列表 local GAS_NAMES = { ["Oganesson"] = "鿫(Og)", ["Xenon"] = "氙(Xe)", ["Krypton"] = "氪(Kr)", ["Neon"] = "氖(Ne)", ["Radon"] = "氡(Rn)", ["Argon"] = "氩(Ar)", ["Helium"] = "氦(He)", ["Nitrogen"] = "氮(N)", ["Oxygen"] = "氧(O)" } --- 检查配方输入中是否包含不想要的物品 --- @param recipe table 配方数据 --- @param pattern string 匹配模式（如 "^磁化"） --- @return boolean 如果包含黑名单物品则返回 true local function shouldFilterRecipe(recipe, pattern) -- 遍历固体输入槽位（1-9） for i = 1, 9 do local prefix = "固体输入" .. i -- 兼容轮播逻辑：如果是轮播，检查第一个；否则检查普通槽位 local name = recipe[prefix .. "-1"] or recipe[prefix] if name and mw.ustring.match(name, pattern) then return true end end return false end --- 快捷展开 Item 模板 local function expandItem(frame, name) if not name or name == "" then return "" end return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'item', args = { name } } end --- 提取搅拌机配方中的原料并生成描述文本（兼容轮播） local function getMixerIngredientText(frame, recipe) local ingredients = {} for i = 1, 9 do local prefix = "固体输入" .. i local name = nil local rawName = nil -- 逻辑：如果存在 "固体输入x-1"，说明是轮播，取第一个 if recipe[prefix .. "-1"] then name = recipe[prefix .. "-1"] rawName = recipe[prefix .. "-1-原名"] else -- 否则是普通条目 name = recipe[prefix] rawName = recipe[prefix .. "-原名"] end -- 排除不存在的输入和编程电路 if name and rawName and rawName ~= "Programmed Circuit" then table.insert(ingredients, expandItem(frame, name)) end end local outputName = recipe["固体输出1"] or "未知粉末" return "需要用" .. table.concat(ingredients, "、") .. "搅拌成" .. outputName .. "。" end --- 生成带“无保护气”对比的表格 local function renderGasTable(gasRecipes, hasDefault, defaultTime) local tableWiki = '{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;"\n|-\n! 保护气' if hasDefault then tableWiki = tableWiki .. " !! 无" end for _, g in ipairs(gasRecipes) do tableWiki = tableWiki .. " !! " .. g.name end tableWiki = tableWiki .. "\n|-\n| 配方耗时/s" if hasDefault then tableWiki = tableWiki .. " || " .. (defaultTime or "未知") end for _, g in ipairs(gasRecipes) do tableWiki = tableWiki .. " || " .. g.time end tableWiki = tableWiki .. "\n|} " return tableWiki end function p.main(frame) local args = frame:getParent().args local outputBase = args[1] or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text outputBase = outputBase:gsub("锭$", ""):gsub("粉$", "") local step_mixer = args["搅拌"] == "1" local step_ebf = args["烧制"] == "1" local step_freezer = args["冷却"] == "1" if not (args["搅拌"] or args["烧制"] or args["冷却"]) then step_ebf = true step_freezer = true end local valid = false if step_mixer and step_ebf and step_freezer then valid = true elseif not step_mixer and step_ebf and step_freezer then valid = true elseif step_mixer and step_ebf and not step_freezer then valid = true elseif not step_mixer and step_ebf and not step_freezer then valid = true end if not valid then return '错误：目前仅支持“搅拌+烧制+冷却”、“烧制+冷却”、“搅拌+烧制”或“烧制”组合。' end local ingotName = outputBase .. "锭" local dustName = outputBase .. "粉" local ebfOutput = step_freezer and ("热" .. ingotName) or ingotName local resultText = {} local mixerData, ebfData, freezerData -- 查询数据 if step_mixer then mixerData = DatabaseInterfaces.searchRecipe({ args = { output = dustName, type = "搅拌机" } }) end if step_ebf then ebfData = DatabaseInterfaces.searchRecipe({ args = { output = ebfOutput, type = "工业高炉", limit = 10 } }) -- 配方过滤 if ebfData then local filteredData = {} for _, recipe in ipairs(ebfData) do -- 排除名字以“磁化”开头的配方 if not shouldFilterRecipe(recipe, "^磁化") then table.insert(filteredData, recipe) end end ebfData = filteredData end end if step_freezer then freezerData = DatabaseInterfaces.searchRecipe({ args = { output = ingotName, type = "真空冷冻机"} }) end -- 渲染逻辑开始 local targetHeight = 280 -- 1. 搅拌部分渲染 (如果是全流程，它独占上方文字+Grid) if step_mixer and mixerData and #mixerData > 0 then table.insert(resultText, getMixerIngredientText(frame, mixerData[1])) -- 如果不是并排场景（即全流程场景），搅拌机配方直接紧跟文字 if step_freezer then table.insert(resultText, Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, mixerData)) end end -- 2. 烧制文字描述 if step_ebf and ebfData and #ebfData > 0 then local minHeat = 999999 local hasDefault = false local defaultTime = nil local gasRecipes = {} for _, recipe in ipairs(ebfData) do local currentHeat = tonumber(recipe["热容"]) or tonumber(recipe["特殊值"]) or 0 if currentHeat > 0 and currentHeat < minHeat then minHeat = currentHeat end local gasNameRaw = recipe["流体输入1-原名"] if gasNameRaw and GAS_NAMES[gasNameRaw] then table.insert(gasRecipes, { name = GAS_NAMES[gasNameRaw], time = recipe["时间"] }) else if not hasDefault then defaultTime = recipe["时间"] end hasDefault = true end end local coilName = GetCoil.getCoil({["args"]={[1]=minHeat}}) or "未知" local burnDesc = string.format("%s需要在%s中烧制", ingotName, expandItem(frame, "工业高炉")) if step_freezer then burnDesc = burnDesc .. string.format("，然后在%s中冷却", expandItem(frame, "真空冷冻机")) end if minHeat >= 13501 then burnDesc = burnDesc .. string.format("。要求的最低热容为 %dK（永恒+）。", minHeat, coilName) else burnDesc = burnDesc .. string.format("。要求的最低热容为 %dK（%s或更高等级）。", minHeat, expandItem(frame, coilName .. "线圈方块")) end table.insert(resultText, burnDesc) if #gasRecipes > 0 then local gasIntro = hasDefault and "该配方支持无保护气烧制，但使用保护气可以提高效率。具体数据如下：" or "该配方必须在保护气环境下烧制。使用更高级的保护气可以提高效率。具体数据如下：" table.insert(resultText, gasIntro) table.insert(resultText, renderGasTable(gasRecipes, hasDefault, defaultTime)) else table.insert(resultText, "该配方不支持使用保护气加速。") end end -- 3. 底部 Grid 流程区域 if step_mixer and step_ebf and step_freezer then -- 场景：全流程 (搅拌机已在上方渲染，此处仅并排高炉和冷冻机) local isMultiple = (#ebfData > 1) local pagerArgs = { ["use-pager"] = (isMultiple and "1" or ""), ["content-height"] = targetHeight } table.insert(resultText, Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, ebfData, pagerArgs) .. Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, freezerData, pagerArgs)) elseif step_ebf and step_freezer then -- 场景：烧制+冷却并排 local isMultiple = (#ebfData > 1) local pagerArgs = { ["use-pager"] = (isMultiple and "1" or ""), ["content-height"] = targetHeight } table.insert(resultText, Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, ebfData, pagerArgs) .. Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, freezerData, pagerArgs)) elseif step_mixer and step_ebf then -- 场景：搅拌+烧制并排 (此时搅拌文字在最上方，Grid 在这里并排) local isMultiple = (#mixerData > 1 or #ebfData > 1) local pagerArgs = { ["use-pager"] = (isMultiple and "1" or ""), ["content-height"] = targetHeight } table.insert(resultText, Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, mixerData, pagerArgs) .. Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, ebfData, pagerArgs)) elseif step_ebf then -- 场景：纯烧制 local isMultiple = (#ebfData > 1) local pagerArgs = { ["use-pager"] = (isMultiple and "1" or ""), ["content-height"] = targetHeight } table.insert(resultText, Recipe.renderRecipe(frame, ebfData, pagerArgs)) end return table.concat(resultText, "\n") end return p 复制展开

local p = {}
-- Data module is expected to be cached by mw.loadData.
local data = mw.loadData('模块:星系/InjectData/Data')
local function asList(t)
if type(t) ~= 'table' then
return {}
end
-- Some environments return tables with numeric keys that are not always
-- safe to consume with ipairs/# directly; normalize once before rendering.
local kv = {}
local allNumeric = true
for k, v in pairs(t) do
if type(k) ~= 'number' then
allNumeric = false
end
table.insert(kv, { k = k, v = v })
end
if allNumeric then
table.sort(kv, function(a, b) return a.k < b.k end)
end
local out = {}
for _, row in ipairs(kv) do
table.insert(out, row.v)
end
return out
end
local function normalizePlanetName(v)
v = mw.text.trim(v or '')
v = v:gsub('^"(.*)"$', '%1')
v = v:gsub("^'(.*)'$", '%1')
v = v:gsub('^%[%[([^%]|]+)%|([^%]]+)%]%]$', '%2')
v = v:gsub('^%[%[([^%]]+)%]%]$', '%1')
v = v:gsub("'''", '')
v = v:gsub("''", '')
return mw.text.trim(v)
end
local function readArg(args, parentArgs)
return args[1]
or args['1']
or args.planet
or args['行星']
or args.name
or args['名称']
or parentArgs[1]
or parentArgs['1']
or parentArgs.planet
or parentArgs['行星']
or parentArgs.name
or parentArgs['名称']
or ''
end
local function getPlanetArg(frame)
local args = (frame and frame.args) or frame or {}
local parentArgs = {}
if frame and frame.getParent then
local ok, parent = pcall(frame.getParent, frame)
if ok and parent and parent.args then
parentArgs = parent.args
end
end
return normalizePlanetName(readArg(args, parentArgs))
end
local function resolveDim(planetName)
if not planetName or planetName == '' then
return nil
end
return data.planetToDim[planetName]
or data.planetToDimLower[mw.ustring.lower(planetName)]
or (data.byAbbr[planetName] and planetName)
or nil
end
local function renderLines(list, formatter)
local lines = {}
for _, row in ipairs(asList(list)) do
table.insert(lines, formatter(row))
end
if #lines == 0 then
return '*无'
end
return table.concat(lines, '\n')
end
function p.listVeins(frame)
local dim = resolveDim(getPlanetArg(frame))
if not dim then
return '*无'
end
return renderLines(data.veinsByDim[dim], function(v)
return string.format('* %s (%d, %.1f%%)', v.name, v.weight or 0, v.probability or 0)
end)
end
function p.listSmallVeins(frame)
local dim = resolveDim(getPlanetArg(frame))
if not dim then
return '*无'
end
return renderLines(data.smallVeinsByDim[dim], function(v)
return string.format('* %s (%d)', v.name, v.amountPerChunk or 0)
end)
end
function p.listFluids(frame)
local dim = resolveDim(getPlanetArg(frame))
if not dim then
return '*无'
end
return renderLines(data.fluidsByDim[dim], function(v)
return string.format('* %s (%d-%d, %.1f%%)', v.name, v.minAmount or 0, v.maxAmount or 0, v.probability or 0)
end)
end
function p.debug(frame)
local rawPlanet = getPlanetArg(frame)
local dim = resolveDim(rawPlanet)
local veins = asList((dim and data.veinsByDim[dim]) or {})
local small = asList((dim and data.smallVeinsByDim[dim]) or {})
local fluids = asList((dim and data.fluidsByDim[dim]) or {})
return mw.dumpObject({
normalizedPlanet = rawPlanet,
resolvedDim = dim,
dataSource = 'loadData',
counts = {
veins = #veins,
small = #small,
fluids = #fluids,
},
})
end
return p

此模块的文档可以在模块:材料/doc创建 local p = {} local db = require('Module:Database') local function stripMCColor(text) if not text then return "" end -- mw.ustring.gsub 处理多字节字符更安全 -- [0-9a-fk-orA-FK-OR] 匹配所有合法的 MC 颜色和格式代码 return mw.ustring.gsub(text, "§[0-9a-fk-orA-FK-OR]", "") end -- 业务逻辑封装：处理数据注入 local function injectData(frame, parentArgs) local finalArgs = {} -- 1. 获取并还原查询 Key, 处理 Nowiki 占位符 (如果用户使用了 #tag:nowiki) local rawInput = parentArgs['数据源'] or parentArgs['名称'] if rawInput then rawInput = mw.text.unstrip(rawInput) end -- 如果用户显式指定数据源为 none，则跳过数据库逻辑，直接进行参数转发 if rawInput == "none" then for k, v in pairs(parentArgs) do if v ~= "" then finalArgs[k] = v end end return finalArgs end local queryKey = rawInput or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text -- 2. 查询数据库 (此处若内部报错会被 xpcall 捕获) local gtData = db.queryMaterial(queryKey) or {} -- 3. 注入数据库字段 local rawFormula = gtData.ChemicalFormula or "" finalArgs['db_化学式'] = mw.text.nowiki(rawFormula) finalArgs['db_英文名'] = gtData.DefaultName local rawMod = gtData.Mod if type(rawMod) == 'table' then -- 如果是 table，先合并再清洗，或者遍历清洗 local modNames = {} for i, v in ipairs(rawMod) do table.insert(modNames, (stripMCColor(v))) end finalArgs['db_来源模组'] = table.concat(modNames, ", ") else -- 如果是字符串，直接清洗 finalArgs['db_来源模组'] = stripMCColor(rawMod or "") end -- 4. 检测是否包含unicode自定义字符 if rawFormula ~= "" then local charCount = mw.ustring.len(rawFormula) local hasCustomChar = false for i = 1, charCount do local c = mw.ustring.codepoint(rawFormula, i) if c and c >= 0xE000 and c <= 0xF8FF then hasCustomChar = true break end end if hasCustomChar then local classes = 'overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap max-w-[185px] scrollbar-none text-[14px] hover:cursor-move active:cursor-grabbing [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_right,black_85%,transparent_100%)]' local style = 'font-family: Minecraftia; scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none; display: block;' finalArgs['db_MC化学式'] = string.format('
%s
', classes, style, mw.text.encode(rawFormula)) end end -- 5. 转发并覆盖手动参数 for k, v in pairs(parentArgs) do if v ~= "" then finalArgs[k] = v end end return finalArgs end function p.main(frame) local parentArgs = frame:getParent().args local finalArgs = {} local errorMessage = nil -- 使用 xpcall 捕获最外层错误 -- success: 执行成功为 true，失败为 false -- result: 成功时为返回的 table，失败时为错误堆栈字符串 local success, result = xpcall(function() return injectData(frame, parentArgs) end, debug.traceback) if success then -- 正常渲染 finalArgs = result else -- 发生错误：生成错误提示脚本 errorMessage = frame:expandTemplate{ title = '需要帮助', args = { '这篇文章的脚本出错了，错误信息如下。' .. frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'HuijiCollapsed', args = { ['title'] = '错误信息', ['ID'] = '模块/材料', ['text'] = tostring(result), ['title-class'] = 'bg-danger', ['body-style'] = 'margin-bottom:0px;' } } } } -- 回退：仅注入用户手动填写的参数 for k, v in pairs(parentArgs) do if v ~= "" then finalArgs[k] = v end end end -- 执行模板渲染 local renderedContent = frame:expandTemplate{ title = '材料/显示', args = finalArgs } -- 返回结果（报错信息在前） return (errorMessage or "") .. renderedContent end return p 复制展开
